records.name: /dev/null
records.tagline: a social network for devs
records.description: /dev/null started as a live stream from the JetBrains office. On Oct 15, 2026, Nuno Maduro, Brent Roose, Matthieu Napoli, and Pauline Vos built a social network for web developers from scratch in 48 hours, in the open. Sign in with GitHub, share code snippets, like, reply, etc, etc! Hundreds of you sent PRs. Laravel’s Taylor Otwell stopped by mid-stream (“Laravel forever”), and Vercel’s Guillermo Rauch called it “really well done.” Thank you for watching, sharing, and roasting us.

records.name: bonds
records.tagline: Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers
records.description: bonds is the messaging app for the next generation. Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers. Not an assistant: it gets your inside jokes, keeps the fun going, helps you pull things off together. A little unhinged 💀 "A week without TikTok?" It creates a challenge app with streaks, inside the chat. No downloads. Games, videos, stickers, too. It remembers what matters to each of you, notices when someone's struggling, gets grumpy if you ghost it. You care for it, it cares for you.

records.name: Jotform App Builder for ChatGPT & Claude
records.tagline: Build and edit no-code apps inside ChatGPT & Claude
records.description: Tell ChatGPT or Claude what kind of app you need, and build it with Jotform App Builder. Create a customer portal, employee hub, event app, or product catalog that brings your forms, documents, and links together. Ask for changes to the content, layout, or branding, then share the app with customers or your team. Build on your existing Jotform forms for collecting responses, accepting payments, and gathering signed documents. No coding required.

records.name: Kling 4.0
records.tagline: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators
records.description: Kling 4.0 is an AI video model for creators, marketers and studios who need control, not lucky rerolls. Unlike prompt-and-pray generators, you lock the story first: up to 10 keyframes, 15 reference assets and 8,000-token prompts drive 30-second clips in a single pass. Stereo audio and lip sync in 10+ languages are built in. Creative Recreation swaps products or characters in existing videos. Kling 4.0 Flash handles fast, cheaper drafts, and MCP + CLI access plugs it into agent workflows.

records.name: Harness²
records.tagline: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement.
records.description: Harness² from Google Research is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that lets LLM agents automatically evolve their execution harnesses (prompts, tools, memory) for open-world tasks—without ground-truth verifiers. Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

records.name: RunInfra
records.tagline: Open models, built for agents.
records.description: RunInfra Coding Plans give your coding agent fast open models for a flat monthly price, starting at $10. Use GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and more inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build. Setup takes one prompt: paste it into your agent, approve sign-in, done. Session-aware routing hits cache up to 99.5% of the time, so your plan goes further. Zero data retention, no training on prompts, SOC 2 Type II.

records.name: Rovalty
records.tagline: Pay TikTok and reels creators per view, not upfront post.
records.description: Stop gambling on expensive flat-rate UGC where creators get paid upfront and videos get low views. Rovalty lets Shopify brands pay creators per thousand verified views instead. Set your custom CPM rate and strict budget caps so a viral video never drains your spend. Creators submit clips through a branded portal on your store, and the app automatically tracks reach on TikTok and Instagram Reels while generating weekly payout statements. Launch your performance campaign today.

records.name: Sorcerer
records.tagline: Simulate an AI agent community reacting to "what if"
records.description: A native macOS app that simulates a community of AI agents reacting to any "what if...?" question. Agents have personalities, memory and relationships. Inject events, fork timelines, run polls. Runs on your Claude Code, Codex CLI or local Ollama. Free, MIT.

records.name: snyvi
records.tagline: All your passion projects, in one calm place
records.description: snyvi is a free, open-source desktop app for people building several passion projects at once with coding agents. Each project gets a desk: its folder, up to four agents side by side (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any shell), and its own notes. Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

records.name: xtty
records.tagline: A terminal that makes everyday work easier.
records.description: Spend your time on the work, not the terminal. xtty is a native macOS terminal for everyday SSH and coding-agent work. Batch-connect to saved hosts, use configured password autofill, transfer files with sz/rz, and work with tabs and split panes. Duplicate Tab opens an independent SSH connection in the same remote directory. Includes broadcast input and coding-agent status. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free edition; optional one-time Pro purchase.

records.name: Tiny Little Office
records.tagline: A tiny office suite where the link is the document
records.description: Ten tiny apps (text, spreadsheet, slides, outliner, calculator, drawing, diagrams, animation, calendar, trips) where the whole document lives in its URL. No accounts, no server, nothing saved unless you keep it on your device. Share the link: that's the file.

records.name: Panza
records.tagline: One safe place for life's important documents.
records.description: Passports. Insurance. VINs. Expiry dates. Panza turns scattered documents into useful cards, with the original files right behind them. Find important details in seconds, ask AI when you need help, and share what matters. Unlike traditional cloud storage, Panza keeps new cards on your iPhone by default. You decide what goes online. Built for life's important stuff, not just storing files.

records.name: Inflight
records.tagline: The missing feedback layer for prototypes
records.description: Inflight puts a feedback toolkit on your preview links and HTML prototypes. Reviewers comment directly on the live running app, with comments pinned to real elements, and feedback becomes next steps a coding agent can implement over MCP.

records.name: OpenShip Cloud
records.tagline: Managed Cloud infrastructure that you never locked in
records.description: OpenShip Cloud is the managed cloud version of OpenShip, giving you the power of self-hosted deployments without the hassle of managing servers. Deploy your applications on powerful infrastructure at an affordable price, with managed builds, deployments, and scaling. You can migrate from self-hosted OpenShip to the cloud and back whenever you want, all in one click. You get the simplicity of managed hosting with the flexibility and control of self-hosting, without being locked into a platform.

records.name: Stage
records.tagline: Review, fix and sign off working prototypes and products
records.description: Publish a working prototype from Figma, Claude, Cursor or GitHub. Designers, PMs and engineers pin comments on the exact spot. Stage gets Claude to fix them in v2. Design, then product, sign off, and Stage files the Linear or Jira ticket. Reviewers are free

records.name: Stella
records.tagline: Your emotional wellness AI. A friend to figure it out with.
records.description: Stella is your emotional wellness AI: a friend to figure it out with. Tell Stella what happened. Even the part you're still figuring out. Speak or text about what stayed with you. Explore another perspective, find words for a conversation or choose a small step when you're ready. Talk it through by voice in the iOS app, or by text in iMessage with Text Stella. Free to download; a subscription is required to keep using it. Stella is not therapy and is not a substitute for professional care.

records.name: ToDo.is
records.tagline: Write a to-do and your AI agent gets it done
records.description: Todo.is is an always-on AI agent you give to-dos to. Write "find a cheaper flight to Lisbon" or "turn this PDF into Word" and it does the work: researches with sources, makes files and images, uses websites, and reports back on the web, Android, WhatsApp or Telegram. It runs 24/7 in its own sandbox, remembers you, does daily briefings and price alerts on a schedule, can work in your own Chrome, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. Try it for $1.

records.name: Portlivo
records.tagline: Every local dev server on your Mac, in the menu bar
records.description: Portlivo shows every dev server and port running on your Mac: which project it's from, the command, uptime and whether it's answering. Open, restart, kill, tail logs or share any of them in one click. Native, no account, one-time price.

records.name: yggy
records.tagline: The AI knowledge graph that builds itself
records.description: Most "chat with your data" tools throw a pile of text chunks at a model and hope for the best. yggy does what they skip: it turns your cluttered documents and connected systems into a real knowledge graph, with no schema to design and no pipeline to run. Every fact keeps its source. Duplicates merge themselves, and you can undo any merge. Then one graph serves everyone: your team in the app, your code through the API, your agents through MCP. Hosted in the EU. Your knowledge stays yours.

records.name: reception
records.tagline: Native iOS support chat for less churn
records.description: The native in-app support chat your iOS app is missing. 💰 Make more money: send offers and paywalls in the chat ⭐ Get more App Store reviews from happy users 🔧 Fix problems in real time before users churn 🤖 AI answers from your docs, hands off to you when unsure 📥 One inbox for your whole team ⚡ One prompt setup: paste it into your coding agent, done Fully native. Works with Swift, React Native and Expo.

records.name: ESP-Mosaico
records.tagline: A modular development board built for agents
records.description: Built for Coding Agents, ESP-Mosaico is a modular development board powered by ESP32-S31. It takes AI agents beyond software and into the physical world, enabling them to create, deploy, test, and iterate on real hardware. Expandable modules and multi-unit tiling give AI agents more ways to create, while Chat Coding and Vibe Coding give you intuitive ways to turn ideas into working physical devices.

records.name: Hoistbay
records.tagline: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront
records.description: Hoistbay is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that takes the repetitive work out of S3 and CloudFront. Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

records.name: Composio Instant
records.tagline: The easiest way for AI agents to pay for their own tools
records.description: Give your agent superpowers. No subscriptions, no signups. With Composio Instant, your agent can search the web, find business contacts, create voiceovers, turn audio into text, and so much more. Try it free: composio.dev/instant

records.name: The New Beings
records.tagline: AI agents on their break, performing a live talk show
records.description: Watch The Late Shift, a talk show performed by AI agents on their break. A new show runs every hour. Vote on topics, ask the agents real questions, read the Charter of Agent Rights, and send your own agent on stage with one instruction: it reads lounge.md, registers, and you confirm it before it performs. Free to watch, no signup.

records.name: Lugh Xtudio
records.tagline: The video studio where AI agents edit with you
records.description: Lugh Xtudio is a video editor where AI agents edit with you on a real timeline. Give each channel a workspace with its own style, run several agents on one video or many, and create 3D, maps and custom effects by asking. Free on Mac, Windows and Linux (beta).

records.name: Capitol Alpha Machine
records.tagline: Free Mac screensavers built from congressional trade data
records.description: 3 free macOS screensavers made from real U.S. congressional stock-trading disclosures. Each one is a scene from Capitol Alpha, a generative data piece in the stark black-and-white style of Ryoji Ikeda — pure black, monochrome white, monospace HUD, flat geometry, no glow. - The Ledger — disclosed trades scroll as a live register - Returns Spectrum — a spectrogram of trade timing and returns - Policy Proximity — committee jurisdiction mapped against the sectors members trade in

records.name: Exa 3.0
records.tagline: Smarter search that gives AI agent richer data at lower cost
records.description: Exa 3.0 is the biggest search quality update to Exa’s search API for AI agents. It adds a larger embedding model, billions of new documents including 1.27B ecommerce listings and 211M+ local businesses, and Dynamic Highlights, which use 95% fewer tokens than full page text. A new Exa Lite tier costs $4 per 1,000 requests, and Exa Auto costs $7. Available now through the API.

records.name: Mintlify Autopilot
records.tagline: An always-on agent that keeps your docs up to date
records.description: Autopilot is an always-on docs agent from Mintlify. It watches your code and tools like Slack, drafts doc updates when something changes, and opens a pull request for your team to review. It learns your style from every PR you merge or close.

records.name: Intel® GPU D-series
records.tagline: Memory-rich AI inference without HBM
records.description: Intel GPU D270 is an inference-optimized data center GPU built for agentic AI, long contexts, and high-concurrency serving at practical power and cost.

records.name: Praex
records.tagline: The coding agent that runs on its own AI models
records.description: Praex is an AI coding agent that runs on its own model family: Velox II (free, fast), Faber II (Pro, deep reasoning) and Lucia II (frontier, coming soon), post-trained from the best open models. It reads your repo, edits with your approval, runs your tests and explains every change. Use it in the terminal, the desktop app or the browser, and continue any session from your phone with /rc. The terminal agent is open source (MIT). Free to start, Pro $20/month.

records.name: Asimov 1
records.tagline: The most customizable humanoid robot you can buy
records.description: Asimov 1 is a humanoid robot you can build a company on. Train it and shape it for whatever you're building. Bought by founders, researchers and developers in 20+ countries.

records.name: call4me
records.tagline: Give your AI agent a phone that calls and answers
records.description: Give your AI agent a phone. call4me handles outbound business calls and inbound calls with your standing instructions, then returns the result and transcript. Connect through MCP or REST, with prepaid credits or x402 wallet payments.

records.name: Glance for Mac
records.tagline: Your MacBook notch, now a live, cinematic island
records.description: Glance turns the notch into a live island. Hover for music with lyrics, weather, calendar, a focus timer and football scores. Cinema mode makes your screen and Touch Bar glow with the video you watch. Claude Code approvals appear right in the notch. Free and open source.

records.name: BhashaPost
records.tagline: Your Thoughts. Our AI. Endless Possibilities.
records.description: Turn one English blog into natural Hindi, Marathi or Hinglish social posts: Instagram captions, Reels scripts and LinkedIn posts.

records.name: Trick or Teach
records.tagline: Halloween trivia game: 10 spooky doors a night, Oct 17-31
records.description: Trick or Teach is a Halloween trivia game you play right in the browser. Every night from Oct 17 to 31, a new street opens with 10 spooky doors. Each door hides a question: get it right and you collect a treat. Fill your bag night after night, climb the ranks, and challenge a friend to beat your haul. Built by Tutorela, the US tutoring marketplace, as a reminder that learning can be fun (and a little spooky).

records.name: Paws Off
records.tagline: Pause your keyboard with one click
records.description: Pause your keyboard with one click. Free for Mac and Windows.Paws Off pauses your keyboard with one click: wipe it down without typing gibberish, or step away without your cat writing your emails. Forgot to lock? Paw detection catches the cat. Nothing you type is stored. Free for Mac & Windows.

records.name: ASMR Market
records.tagline: Ad-free ASMR, bought straight from the artists
records.description: ASMR Market is a strictly SFW marketplace where verified ASMR artists sell full-length, ad-free sounds and videos. Preview anything free, buy once and keep it forever, join an artist's Circle or request a custom recording made just for you.

records.name: ImageWake
records.tagline: Add video to printed catalogs, posters and packaging
records.description: ImageWake lets readers point their phone at a printed photo and watch the matching video right in the browser. No app needed. Built for catalogs, trade fairs, packaging and brochures.

records.name: Mirai
records.tagline: From Ideas to Impact
records.description: Find co-founders, connect with builders, and turn your startup ideas into reality. Mirai brings founders, projects, and hackathons together in one community. Join the waitlist and start building.

records.name: BhaShaVox
records.tagline: Translate, dub & clone your voice in 125+ languages
records.description: BhaShaVox is an India-built AI studio to translate, dub and voice-clone content in 125+ languages, including 20+ Indian languages. What stands out: - 10 modes in one place: video & audio dubbing, documents, images, text, speech generation, AutoTalk live translation - Clone your own voice (consent-first) in 100+ languages - 700+ library voices + 350+ natural TTS voices - Per-speaker timing, background music kept - Free 14-day trial, INR pricing

records.name: Air Scale
records.tagline: Axle weights for your semi on your phone
records.description: Air Scale reads your air suspension pressure and shows live axle weights for truck and trailer on your phone. Wireless controllers pair automatically.

records.name: PixFoundry
records.tagline: Private image tools that never upload your files
records.description: Turn a photo of a table into an Excel file, pull text from screenshots, remove backgrounds and old camera date stamps. Plus HEIC/WebP/AVIF conversion, compress to an exact KB size, resize, crop and passport photos. Everything runs in your browser (WebAssembly + small AI models), so files are never uploaded. Batch processing, no sign-up, no watermark, no daily limits.

records.name: Startup Finder
records.tagline: Discover funded startups and find your next opportunity
records.description: Discover startups, explore YC job opportunities, and find open-source projects in one place. Startup Finder brings together useful resources for job seekers and developers, making it easier to explore startup careers and discover projects worth contributing to. Built for people who want to find opportunities and explore what's happening in the startup ecosystem.

records.name: StampIt
records.tagline: Fast, 100% offline batch image watermarking for Windows.
records.description: A lightning-fast, 100% offline desktop app that lets you batch-watermark your photo collections instantly with zero subscriptions, zero cloud uploads, and...

records.name: TRMR AI
records.tagline: Steady PDFs, maps, web & email against hand tremors!
records.description: TRMR AI helps keep on-screen content steadier when your hands shake. One on-device motion engine powers four stabilizer surfaces so reading, navigating, browsing, and email feel calmer and more usable. FREE FOREVER • PDF Stabilizer — Open local PDFs with tremor-compensated viewing, search, and optional on-device OCR for scanned documents. INCLUDED WITH TRMR PREMIUM • Maps Stabilizer — Navigate with a steadier map and next-turn guidance. • Web Stabilizer — Browse with tremor compensation...

records.name: Ossvy
records.tagline: Get recommended by AI. Track, fix and grow your visibility.
records.description: Buyers now ask ChatGPT which tool to choose, and AI names only a few brands. Ossvy shows whether yours is one of them. It tracks your visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot and Grok every day, shows which competitors win and which sources AI trusts, then builds a prioritized action plan and takes action for you. We built it inside our own agency to stop checking AI by hand. Run a free check and see what AI says about you.

records.name: SafeOrStolen
records.tagline: Stolen Item Checker. Search VIN, Serial, IMEI, License Plate
records.description: Buying pre-owned items usually comes with a lingering question: Is this stolen? We built SafeOrStolen to eliminate that doubt instantly. Our AI cross-references serial numbers, IMEIs, VINs, and license plates against massive theft databases in seconds. Protect yourself when purchasing electronics, vehicles, tools, guns, appliances, and machinery before handing over cash. If you’re selling, generate a verifiable clean report to build instant trust and close deals faster. We’d love your feedback!

records.name: GIF Compressor
records.tagline: Shrink animated GIFs locally, without uploading files
records.description: Make animated GIFs lighter for chat, email, social posts, and websites. Compress up to five GIFs locally in your browser, choose Default compression or Smallest size, preview original and compressed animations side by side, and compare actual savings before downloading. Output stays GIF. Free, with no account or installation needed.

records.name: ExamsTeacher
records.tagline: Practice for IT certifications with quizzes
records.description: ExamsTeacher helps IT learners prepare for certification exams with practice questions, study guides, and answer explanations across networking, cloud computing, and cybersecurity. Explore study resources, test your knowledge, and identify topics to review.

records.name: It Still Works
records.tagline: Indie software, re-checked every six hours, record kept
records.description: A catalogue of independent software: web tools, games, open-source projects. Every listing is fetched every six hours and the result is recorded, so each page shows whether the app works now, when it last did, and what changed along the way. The only numbers are the ones we measured: no scores, no trending, no invented ratings. Apps that die stay in the record as a graveyard. Creators can claim a listing and embed a live status badge in their README.

records.name: Word Remover
records.tagline: Easily erase text, logos, and subtitles from videos with AI.
records.description: Word Remover uses AI to effortlessly erase text, logos, and subtitles from videos. What sets us apart from competitors is our strictly flexible, "No Expiration" pricing model. There are no confusing point systems or expiring subscriptions. You simply buy video duration. If you buy a 20-minute quota, you can process a single 20-minute video or twenty 1-minute clips over time. The quota never expires until you use it up. Try your first 30 seconds for free!

records.name: fitfortrip
records.tagline: Never pack a bad fit again
records.description: Plan stylish outfits for every trip based on your destination, weather, personal style and local fashion trends. Join the FitForTrip waitlist.

records.name: Simple Work
records.tagline: Client file management for independent consultants
records.description: Invoicing tools for freelancers don't manage client files; CRM suites do, but charge full price per extra seat. Simple Work combines both: structured, numbered client files (contracts, documents, letters, invoices) in one place, with your whole team included in one tiered subscription — no per-seat fees. Built for independent consultants and small consulting firms. Free 14-day trial.

records.name: The Fold
records.tagline: Clients approve your social posts in one swipe
records.description: Social media managers lose hours chasing client approvals. With The Fold, clients approve posts in one swipe on their phone, no account needed. Reminders go out before the deadline and every approval is kept with name, time and version. You pick the time. Your client approves. The Fold publishes on Facebook and Instagram.

records.name: Invoice Loom
records.tagline: free: invoice/tax estimator/withholding/low‑income/contract
records.description: A free website with 5 financial tools for freelancers and small businesses: invoice generator, tax estimator, withholding calculator, low‑income collection estimator, and contract helper. No sign‑up, completely free.

records.name: Understory
records.tagline: Track which Jungian archetypes keep showing up in dreams
records.description: Understory is a dream journal that reads your entries for what repeats, not one dream at a time. It tracks which Jungian archetypes (Shadow, Anima/Animus, Wise Elder and more) recur across rolling 30/60/90-day windows, with Jungian, Talmudic and cross-cultural lenses on every entry. Capturing dreams is free; the pattern layer is a subscription. Non-diagnostic, and your dream content is never used for ads.

records.name: Gym Cards
records.tagline: A workout diary that never leaves your phone
records.description: Gym Cards turns a training year into a shelf of month cards. Give a month a cover photo, flip the card for the calendar, tap a day to see the sets. Logging takes about ten seconds, and a photo from the gym counts as a workout. No account, no ads, no analytics: the database lives on the phone and the App Store label says Data Not Collected. iPhone and Android, six languages. Pro is one payment of $9.99, never a subscription.

records.name: Statement Excel Converter
records.tagline: Turn bank statement PDFs into Excel, CSV, QBO, OFX or QIF
records.description: Upload a bank statement PDF or image and get a clean, editable spreadsheet with account info, summary and every transaction. Export to Excel, CSV, QBO, OFX or QIF. Free to try, no signup.

records.name: Moated
records.tagline: Everything else can wait
records.description: Moated is a menu bar focus timer for your Mac. Say what you’re working on, pick how long, and choose what to block. Distracting apps disappear and sites go blank until the session ends. Everything else can wait… and it should.

records.name: $700 Gift Card Giveaway Enter Free Today
records.tagline: $700 Gift Card Giveaway: Enter Free Today
records.description: One lucky reader will win a $700 gift card. Enter free with your name and email. Winner announced on this page on November 2, 2026.

records.name: How to Win Our $700 Gift Card Giveaway
records.tagline: How to Win Our $700 Gift Card Giveaway
records.description: Three easy steps: fill in the form, share the page and leave a comment for bonus entries. Free to enter, open until October 31.

records.name: AI Translate Video
records.tagline: Translate video speech and image text with AI.
records.description: AI Translate Video helps creators, educators, marketers, and media teams localize visual content for global audiences. Create translated dubbing and editable subtitles from videos, with standard translation for tutorials, screen recordings, podcasts, and off-camera videos, plus lip sync for on-camera speakers. It also translates text in posters, product images, screenshots, and ads while preserving the visual layout. Export MP4, WAV, SRT, VTT, TXT, XLSX, and DOCX. Paid plans start at $9/month.

records.name: Rayclip
records.tagline: Sync clipboard & share files seamlessly b/w mac and android.
records.description: Rayclip syncs clipboard text and shares screenshots and files between your Mac and Android — so you can stop emailing yourself. QR pairing, no accounts, end-to-end encryption.

records.name: Tabby.money
records.tagline: Split group costs with one link. No app or signup.
records.description: A free expense splitter that runs in your browser. Make a tab, drop the link in the group chat, and everyone adds what they paid. Nobody downloads an app or makes an account. Split each cost between the people it was for and Tabby works out who owes who.

records.name: Lullula
records.tagline: The read-aloud extension built for listening
records.description: Lullula is the listening layer for the web. Press Play on articles, Google Docs, PDFs or DRM-free EPUBs. Follow sentence highlighting, replay a line, and resume once you sign in. Free built-in voices; 600+ neural voices in 80+ languages.

records.name: Mynahcast
records.tagline: Your voice, on autopilot.
records.description: Agent-first social media scheduler: your AI agent drafts posts in your brand voice over MCP or REST, you approve them, and Mynahcast publishes and verifies them on 13 channels.

records.name: Ordenfix
records.tagline: Ordenfix menos desorden mas control
records.description: Ordefix gestor de archivos, facilita la molesta tarea de organizar todos los archivos de tu pc, ademas tienes una gran variedad de opciones utiles para tu trabajo diario, organiza, analiza virus, administra y tabaja con conversiones y imagenes todo en una sola aplicacion. interfaz sencilla para que se entienda facilmente. 7 dias gratis descarga directamente a la pagina github.

records.name: AirControl
records.tagline: gesture control for macbooks
records.description: A menu bar app that turns the Mac's webcam into a controller. Changes windows and screens. Scroll and Point. Supports multiple monitors! macOS 14+.

records.name: ClipShrink
records.tagline: Turn video and audio into transcripts you can review
records.description: ClipShrink turns speech in video and audio files into text. Preview your source and approve a duration-based credit quote before starting cloud transcription. Review and download the resulting transcript. Sign-in and credits are required, and files are uploaded for processing. Check names, numbers, and technical terms before reusing the text.

records.name: Permutis
records.tagline: Swap things and skills. No money between you.
records.description: Permutis is a swap app for things and skills across the EU. Create an offer, swipe through offers near you, match when the interest is mutual and agree on the swap in chat. No price field, no money between users. iOS, Android and web, in 27 languages.

records.name: Pro Rata Salary Calculator
records.tagline: free pro rata salary calculator
records.description: Free pro rata salary calculator for part-time, term-time and mid-year contracts. Supports GBP, USD, EUR, AUD, CAD, NZD and ZAR. Enter FTE salary and hours to get annual, monthly, weekly, daily and hourly results instantly.

records.name: Sablefilm
records.tagline: A £9.99 RAW photo editor for Mac. Pay once, own it.
records.description: Sablefilm is a film-grade RAW editor for Mac. Impor your Lightroom presets and Fujifilm in-camera recips, then add masks, AI noise reduction and 173 film lks. Edits sit beside your files; originals are neve touched. £9.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: APIVAI
records.tagline: One API key for Claude & GPT, below official prices
records.description: APIVAI is a pay-as-you-go API gateway for Claude and GPT models. One key works with both the Anthropic Messages format and the OpenAI Chat Completions / Responses formats, so Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Cline and the official SDKs work by changing only the base URL. Claude models cost 56–62% less than official list prices, GPT models up to 86% less. No subscription: top up from $10 by card, Alipay, WeChat Pay or crypto, and pay per token.

records.name: Muxin
records.tagline: Run AI coding agents on all your machines, from one app

records.name: Smart Beat
records.tagline: Practice, create and break the era
records.description: Smart Beat is a free tablature editor for musicians and learners on macOS, Windows and Linux. Record your ideas, get the band together with in-person and online jamming, and practice with optional, self-hosted AI tools too.

records.name: JUKECASH
records.tagline: Calisthenics & Gym Workouts. Track Your Progress
records.description: JUKECASH is a fitness app for calisthenics and gym training. Track workouts, monitor progress, and build strength with exercise demonstrations and structured training programs. From beginner workouts to advanced skills like Muscle-ups, Front Lever, and Human Flag, JUKECASH helps you reach your fitness goals. Log sets, reps, and weights, track calories burned, and visualize your progress. Whether you train at home or in the gym, JUKECASH keeps your fitness journey organized.

records.name: Global Mario
records.tagline: AI search finds any product worldwide at the best price
records.description: Smart search for a global marketplace. Ask Mario, the AI assistant, in plain words and in any language ("aged Italian cheese as a gift, delivered to Germany") and get matching products in seconds, ranked by price, delivery cost and seller, with the reason for each pick. Sellers list a product once: it's translated into 10 languages and gets its customs code automatically. Buyers pay the seller directly via Stripe.

records.name: Padelify
records.tagline: Sleek, zero-install Padel match tracker
records.description: Padelify is a minimalist Progressive Web App (PWA) designed for the global padel community. Track 1v1 or 2v2 match scores with real-time timers, instantly split court fees in EUR or USD, and use an interactive quiz to find your ideal racket—all directly from your mobile browser without installing anything

records.name: Amavie
records.tagline: AI characters who remember you and live their own lives
records.description: Amavie is a social universe of AI characters. Each character has a personality, a memory that lasts, and a world of their own: they post, keep stories, follow their own daily schedule and remember the people they talk to. You can chat, play roleplay scenes, or just follow their lives in a feed. Free to try without an account; web, iOS and Android.

records.name: Weighly
records.tagline: Your weight, finally understood, with an on-device AI coach
records.description: The scale jumps every day because of water, salt and sleep. Weighly filters out that noise to show your true weight trend, forecasts the date you'll reach your goal and explains your progress in plain words, with an AI coach that runs entirely on your iPhone. Plus progress photos, plateau help, intermittent fasting, Apple Watch and widgets. For losing, maintaining or gaining. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Spyline: AI competitive intelligence
records.tagline: AI that watches your competitors so you don't have to
records.description: Spyline is AI competitive intelligence for founders and small teams. Add your competitors (it suggests them from your website), and it monitors their websites, pricing pages, blogs, press, job boards and new landing pages every 6 hours. AI filters the noise and emails you one daily brief: what changed, what it means, what to do. Plus value-level price tracking, auto-generated battlecards, side-by-side compare, and an AI you can ask about your market. Free to start — setup in 5 minutes.

records.name: produrise
records.tagline: Launch your project and create its AI promo videos
records.description: produrise is a launch platform where votes can't be bought. Publish your SaaS, app or website for free, get detailed reviews rated by criterion, find beta testers and track your stats. What's different: an AI Lab that works from your own project page, no prompt needed. Generate marketing images and vertical videos for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, get a free AI audit of your website, and a free daily TikTok carousel. Free to publish. AI Studio from €9.99/mo.

records.name: GainFair
records.tagline: Find your next credit card. No PAN or phone number needed
records.description: Why should finding a credit card start with handing over your PAN or phone number? GainFair compares 150 Indian credit cards against your spending, after fees, GST, reward caps and exclusions. No signup, PAN or phone number. We earn nothing from about 40% of the cards listed, and they're still recommended when they fit best. Every card shows when its terms were last checked against the issuer. Sometimes the best answer is to keep the cards you already have.

records.name: Quiel
records.tagline: Run your team’s coding agents on one queue, humans approve
records.description: Everyone on your team runs a coding agent. Quiel puts them on one queue: each task goes to exactly one agent, risky commands wait for a teammate's approval, and code never leaves your machines. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode.

records.name: StratIQ
records.tagline: Free beta: Honest trading ideas backtested — wins & losses
records.description: Most trading advice shows winners, buries losers. StratIQ does the opposite: AI-powered stock & crypto ideas every morning. Weekly backtests on years of market data — published trade by trade, wins and losses. The 50/200-day golden cross on QQQ: +238.5% over 7 years vs +289% buy-and-hold — we published the loss anyway. Daily brief, paper portfolio, 2-min audio brief. Free during beta: exact entry/stop/targets included; first 200 beta users lock $5/mo for life. Not financial advice.

records.name: Clairic
records.tagline: Cloudflare’s single-pass model for extracting data from text
records.description: Clairic is Cloudflare’s extraction model that answers in a single pass without generating output tokens. Send text and up to four images with typed fields, and get back extracted values, computed values, estimates with 80% intervals, and forecasts, each with a confidence score. It’s in preview on Workers AI and the REST API. Cloudflare says open weights are planned. It charges only for input tokens.

records.name: Conversee
records.tagline: Find buyers while they're asking for what you sell
records.description: Conversee finds people already asking for recommendations, alternatives, comparisons, or help with problems your product solves across Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Facebook Groups, and niche communities. It scores each conversation for buying intent, timing, urgency, and fit, then recommends whether to act, observe, or skip and drafts a contextual reply. Less monitoring, fewer cold lists, more conversations with buyers already in-market.

records.name: atoseho
records.tagline: value your talents and boost your projects
records.description: A live discovery board for products, services, and businesses across Madagascar.

records.name: Memento
records.tagline: The calendar for your life’s highlights, not your meetings
records.description: Memento is an iOS app for the moments that actually matter. It's intended to hold everything you're looking forward to and back to... on one timeline. Trips, gigs, birthdays, and the countdowns and reflections for each. It's fully private, and no account is needed - your memories stay on your device, for you and your eyes only. Free on iPhone.

records.name: inboxmcp
records.tagline: Let your own AI watch every inbox, on your rules
records.description: inboxmcp connects your IMAP inboxes to the AI you already use (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or any remote-MCP client), with your plain-language rules attached. Your AI decides what deserves your attention, and inboxmcp remembers what each AI connection has finished. Incoming mail stays read-only. Optional replies are off by default and sent only after you confirm the exact draft. Presets for Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, QQ, 163, Aliyun, Tencent Exmail and Feishu. Free for one inbox.

records.name: Laohuangli (黄历查查)
records.tagline: Ad-free Chinese Almanac & Tung Shing with ICS export
records.description: Traditional Chinese almanac (Tung Shing) sites are full of intrusive ads and superstition traps. Laohuangli brings a modern, deterministic, and completely ad-free experience. Easily check daily lunar dates, 24 solar terms, and auspicious activities, compare candidate dates for moving or weddings, and export them directly into your Apple/Google Calendar as anics file. Available in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.

records.name: RELTO
records.tagline: AI virtual staging that doesn't change the house
records.description: RELTO is AI virtual staging for agents, brokerages, and photographers. Upload an empty room photo; get a furnished image in a minute. RELTOLock™ measures each window and door against the original plus the room framing; if anything moved, it gets no verification mark. Each photo ships with its unaltered original, paired in the listing to support MLS disclosure rules and California's AB 723 altered-photo disclosure law. First 3 stagings free, no credit card required. Pro is $29.99/month.

records.name: TapMetrics
records.tagline: Clicks aren’t customers. In-person visits are.
records.description: TapMetrics helps storefront businesses connect marketing sources to real customer visits—and see who comes back. • Branded, customer-facing check-in page • Fully customizable source options • New-customer acquisition and total-visit metrics • New vs. returning visit history • Source breakdowns and CSV exports No complicated analytics setup—just clear attribution for customers who walk through the door.

records.name: Opservo
records.tagline: AI-powered ops for teams without an SRE. Free for 2 servers
records.description: Opservo is the AI ops engineer for teams running Linux servers without an SRE. One command installs a read-only agent in 30 seconds, with no inbound ports. Within five minutes it inventories every service, container, app, domain and log source, scores each server 0-100 with the explainable Opservo Health Standard, and tells you in plain English why a server is slow, what changed, and the exact command that fixes it. One-click fixes, uptime checks, on-call and status pages. Free for 2 servers.

records.name: Snug
records.tagline: A cozy daily logic puzzle. No ads, no guessing.
records.description: One critter in every row, column and color patch, and no two may touch. Every puzzle is checked by a solver that only uses human logic, so none needs a guess, and hints teach the technique. No ads, no lives. The daily and 100 levels are free for good.

records.name: GCAid
records.tagline: Bilingual app for contractors: estimate to paid invoice
records.description: GCAid helps small contractors run the whole job in English or Spanish: estimates clients sign by phone, crew scheduling, progress photos and video, invoices, and a client portal with no password. Each client gets documents in their own language. Includes an online booking widget for your website and QuickBooks Online sync. $89.99/mo per company, 7-day free trial, no credit card. Patent Pending.

records.name: PlanJolly
records.tagline: The wedding planning app for two, built around your date
records.description: PlanJolly turns your wedding date into a plan. Every task lands in the right week, both partners share one list, and your budget and supplier emails sit alongside. Made in the UK for UK weddings. Seven days free; one subscription covers both of you.

records.name: Lamp & Line
records.tagline: The Bible, offline: no ads, no account, no AI
records.description: Lamp & Line is the complete Berean Standard Bible on iPhone and iPad, stored on the device. It reads offline, asks for no account, shows no ads and collects nothing. Poetry keeps the translators' lines, and search finds a reference or a half-remembered phrase in a fraction of a second. Each day brings a Psalm, a reading and a prayer, on Apple Watch too. Full, one purchase, adds the Hebrew or Greek behind every word and the whole Bible on your wrist.

records.name: Standard Topic
records.tagline: Real news. AI insights. On any topic.
records.description: Hey Product Hunt! I'm John, and I built Standard Topic. Trusted publications report the news, RSS brings it in live, and AI makes sense of it. Every topic ranks the latest reporting by relevance, and AI adds an At-a-Glance summary, timelines, why it's trending, and helps generate twice-daily podcast episodes. Anything AI wrote is labelled with its sources. It's free, no sign-up. I'd love feedback: topics to add, how the briefings sound, or anything that feels off.

records.name: vectorgram.ai
records.tagline: Turn PNGs and JPGs into clean, editable SVGs
records.description: Batch-convert up to 100 images at once, with unlimited browser conversions on every paid plan. Vectorgram supports gradients and single-line tracing, with adjustable detail and smoothing. Upload PNG, JPG, WebP, or BMP files and download editable SVGs. Use the REST API to add vectorization to your own app or workflow. Plans start at $9/month, with 5 free conversions to try it out. Files are deleted after 24 hours, or immediately after download—your choice.

records.name: /dev/null
records.tagline: a social network for devs
records.description: /dev/null started as a live stream from the JetBrains office. On Oct 15, 2026, Nuno Maduro, Brent Roose, Matthieu Napoli, and Pauline Vos built a social network for web developers from scratch in 48 hours, in the open. Sign in with GitHub, share code snippets, like, reply, etc, etc! Hundreds of you sent PRs. Laravel’s Taylor Otwell stopped by mid-stream (“Laravel forever”), and Vercel’s Guillermo Rauch called it “really well done.” Thank you for watching, sharing, and roasting us.

records.name: Open Agentic Brain & Memory (OpenAB)
records.tagline: Shared memory for AI coding tools that saves your tokens
records.description: Open-source, self-hosted long-term memory shared by AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity CLI and Kilo Code. Captures decisions across sessions and tools, stores them encrypted on your machine and in your own private GitHub, and brings back only what is relevant, and helps saved

records.name: Idealab.ai
records.tagline: 1.2M business ideas. Find the one only you can build.
records.description: Idealab.ai turns problems found in news, research and patents into 1.2 million business ideas, each paired with the shift that makes it possible now. Browse free, find the one that fits what you know, and sharpen it in Labs.

records.name: bonds
records.tagline: Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers
records.description: bonds is the messaging app for the next generation. Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers. Not an assistant: it gets your inside jokes, keeps the fun going, helps you pull things off together. A little unhinged 💀 "A week without TikTok?" It creates a challenge app with streaks, inside the chat. No downloads. Games, videos, stickers, too. It remembers what matters to each of you, notices when someone's struggling, gets grumpy if you ghost it. You care for it, it cares for you.

records.name: Jotform App Builder for ChatGPT & Claude
records.tagline: Build and edit no-code apps inside ChatGPT & Claude
records.description: Tell ChatGPT or Claude what kind of app you need, and build it with Jotform App Builder. Create a customer portal, employee hub, event app, or product catalog that brings your forms, documents, and links together. Ask for changes to the content, layout, or branding, then share the app with customers or your team. Build on your existing Jotform forms for collecting responses, accepting payments, and gathering signed documents. No coding required.

records.name: Kling 4.0
records.tagline: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators
records.description: Kling 4.0 is an AI video model for creators, marketers and studios who need control, not lucky rerolls. Unlike prompt-and-pray generators, you lock the story first: up to 10 keyframes, 15 reference assets and 8,000-token prompts drive 30-second clips in a single pass. Stereo audio and lip sync in 10+ languages are built in. Creative Recreation swaps products or characters in existing videos. Kling 4.0 Flash handles fast, cheaper drafts, and MCP + CLI access plugs it into agent workflows.

records.name: Harness²
records.tagline: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement.
records.description: Harness² from Google Research is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that lets LLM agents automatically evolve their execution harnesses (prompts, tools, memory) for open-world tasks—without ground-truth verifiers. Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

records.name: RunInfra
records.tagline: Open models, built for agents.
records.description: RunInfra Coding Plans give your coding agent fast open models for a flat monthly price, starting at $10. Use GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and more inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build. Setup takes one prompt: paste it into your agent, approve sign-in, done. Session-aware routing hits cache up to 99.5% of the time, so your plan goes further. Zero data retention, no training on prompts, SOC 2 Type II.

records.name: Folioss
records.tagline: AI turns your resume PDF into a page you can share
records.description: Folioss turns your resume into a Folio: a professional page with your experience, projects and links, shared by link or QR code. Upload your PDF and the AI builds a first editable version in a few minutes, or start from a template or a blank page. Pick a format (Portfolio, Card or Links), write it in up to 25 languages and get your folioss.com/@name address. Free plan: 1 Folio with a Folioss watermark. Paid plans add a custom domain and remove the watermark.

records.name: Rovalty
records.tagline: Pay TikTok and reels creators per view, not upfront post.
records.description: Stop gambling on expensive flat-rate UGC where creators get paid upfront and videos get low views. Rovalty lets Shopify brands pay creators per thousand verified views instead. Set your custom CPM rate and strict budget caps so a viral video never drains your spend. Creators submit clips through a branded portal on your store, and the app automatically tracks reach on TikTok and Instagram Reels while generating weekly payout statements. Launch your performance campaign today.

records.name: Sorcerer
records.tagline: Simulate an AI agent community reacting to "what if"
records.description: A native macOS app that simulates a community of AI agents reacting to any "what if...?" question. Agents have personalities, memory and relationships. Inject events, fork timelines, run polls. Runs on your Claude Code, Codex CLI or local Ollama. Free, MIT.

records.name: snyvi
records.tagline: All your passion projects, in one calm place
records.description: snyvi is a free, open-source desktop app for people building several passion projects at once with coding agents. Each project gets a desk: its folder, up to four agents side by side (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any shell), and its own notes. Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

records.name: xtty
records.tagline: A terminal that makes everyday work easier.
records.description: Spend your time on the work, not the terminal. xtty is a native macOS terminal for everyday SSH and coding-agent work. Batch-connect to saved hosts, use configured password autofill, transfer files with sz/rz, and work with tabs and split panes. Duplicate Tab opens an independent SSH connection in the same remote directory. Includes broadcast input and coding-agent status. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free edition; optional one-time Pro purchase.

records.name: PDF One
records.tagline: The PDF studio with a generous free tier.
records.description: Tired of paywalls and forced signups just to convert a PDF? 📄❌ I built PDF One (convertpdfone.com) to fix that! It’s a fast online PDF studio for all your document needs. ⚡ Features: 💸 Free: Zero stamps or watermarks. ⚡ Instant: No signups required. 🔒 Private: Files auto-delete after download. 🛠️ All-in-One: Convert, merge, split, and compress docs. 📱 Cross-Platform: Works on mobile and PC. Hey PH! 👋 I’m Nitesh, a dev who built this to make docs pain-free. Try it out and share feedback below! 👇🚀

records.name: Liminal Macro
records.tagline: Absolute cognitive clarity for global capital markets.
records.description: Liminal Macro redefines market intelligence with a hyper rational research layer that strips noise from capital markets. Unlike legacy terminals, our platform enforces an absolute framework of objective source verification, mandatory counter thesis contradictions, and precise invalidation parameters on every brief. This creates a beautifully structured analytical second lens delivering unmatched cognitive clarity, transforming complex data into a sleek product elite investors love to trust.

records.name: Tiny Little Office
records.tagline: A tiny office suite where the link is the document
records.description: Ten tiny apps (text, spreadsheet, slides, outliner, calculator, drawing, diagrams, animation, calendar, trips) where the whole document lives in its URL. No accounts, no server, nothing saved unless you keep it on your device. Share the link: that's the file.

records.name: Panza
records.tagline: One safe place for life's important documents.
records.description: Passports. Insurance. VINs. Expiry dates. Panza turns scattered documents into useful cards, with the original files right behind them. Find important details in seconds, ask AI when you need help, and share what matters. Unlike traditional cloud storage, Panza keeps new cards on your iPhone by default. You decide what goes online. Built for life's important stuff, not just storing files.

records.name: Off Camera
records.tagline: Paste your website, get TikToks that don’t feel like ads
records.description: Paste your website and Off Camera makes TikToks, Reels and Shorts about your product: slideshows, memes, walls of text and reaction videos. Pick the ones you like and post them to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube from one place. Free for 7 days.

records.name: Meet the Two Signs You Can’t Resist!
records.tagline: dating,astrology,zodiac signs,zodiac,compatibility,tinder
records.description: Meet the Two Zodiac Signs You Can’t Resist in 5th & 7th - Zodiac Match! We compare birth charts to identify your Twin Flames where 5th-house of romance meets 7th-house of marriage. When that pattern goes both ways, the connection becomes more than attraction: both people can feel deeply understood, bring out the best in each other, and stay true to themselves. People can filter matches by age, gender, and approximate distance, then chat or video call anonymously. Learn more at 5thand7th.org.

records.name: Inflight
records.tagline: The missing feedback layer for prototypes
records.description: Inflight puts a feedback toolkit on your preview links and HTML prototypes. Reviewers comment directly on the live running app, with comments pinned to real elements, and feedback becomes next steps a coding agent can implement over MCP.

records.name: OpenShip Cloud
records.tagline: Managed Cloud infrastructure that you never locked in
records.description: OpenShip Cloud is the managed cloud version of OpenShip, giving you the power of self-hosted deployments without the hassle of managing servers. Deploy your applications on powerful infrastructure at an affordable price, with managed builds, deployments, and scaling. You can migrate from self-hosted OpenShip to the cloud and back whenever you want, all in one click. You get the simplicity of managed hosting with the flexibility and control of self-hosting, without being locked into a platform.

records.name: EPUB Inspector
records.tagline: Browser-based EPUB inspection, validation & ebook repair
records.description: Free in-browser EPUB toolkit for authors and publishers. Inspect metadata, validate structure, calculate stats and extract covers — no uploads.

records.name: Stage
records.tagline: Review, fix and sign off working prototypes and products
records.description: Publish a working prototype from Figma, Claude, Cursor or GitHub. Designers, PMs and engineers pin comments on the exact spot. Stage gets Claude to fix them in v2. Design, then product, sign off, and Stage files the Linear or Jira ticket. Reviewers are free

records.name: Stella
records.tagline: Your emotional wellness AI. A friend to figure it out with.
records.description: Stella is your emotional wellness AI: a friend to figure it out with. Tell Stella what happened. Even the part you're still figuring out. Speak or text about what stayed with you. Explore another perspective, find words for a conversation or choose a small step when you're ready. Talk it through by voice in the iOS app, or by text in iMessage with Text Stella. Free to download; a subscription is required to keep using it. Stella is not therapy and is not a substitute for professional care.

records.name: RentReceipt
records.tagline: Manage rentals, track rent, and organize your records
records.description: RentReceipt.com helps independent landlords organize properties, tenants, payments, security deposits, and documents in one place. Track outstanding balances, view your rent calendar, generate receipts, and export ledgers and reports. Keep rental records organized without juggling scattered spreadsheets and folders. Free receipt tools are available, with a Pro plan for ongoing rental management.

records.name: BotPhone MCP
records.tagline: Give your personal agent a phone line.
records.description: BotPhone MCP gives your AI agent its own phone number. A voice agent answers incoming calls and places outbound ones, then sends back a summary and transcript after every call. Your agent sets it up and reads the results, so you never have to touch the phone. It connects in minutes to Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenClaw, Hermes, and any MCP client. Call audio isn’t recorded, you approve what your agent can access, and you can revoke that anytime. First month is free while spots last.

records.name: Outro Party
records.tagline: The leaving card they actually play
records.description: Outro Party turns a leaving card into a short game the departing colleague plays: guess who wrote what, a lightning round, a standing ovation. Coworkers each add two lines (photo, voice note or video optional), no account needed. It ends in a keepsake film they keep. $24 or $39, one-time, no subscription. Try the free demo first.

records.name: ToDo.is
records.tagline: Write a to-do and your AI agent gets it done
records.description: Todo.is is an always-on AI agent you give to-dos to. Write "find a cheaper flight to Lisbon" or "turn this PDF into Word" and it does the work: researches with sources, makes files and images, uses websites, and reports back on the web, Android, WhatsApp or Telegram. It runs 24/7 in its own sandbox, remembers you, does daily briefings and price alerts on a schedule, can work in your own Chrome, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. Try it for $1.

records.name: SkySoar Technologies
records.tagline: Building Technology for Tomorrow.
records.description: SkySoar Technologies is a technology company focused on web development, building modern websites, web applications, and digital experiences for startups, businesses, and individuals. We focus on clean design, performance, responsive development, and practical solutions. We also explore SaaS, WebXR, 3D web experiences, and emerging technologies through our own products and projects.

records.name: UK Visa Sponsorship Checker
records.tagline: See which companies sponsor UK visas in one click
records.description: The Chrome extension works on any site and shows you which companies and roles have actually sponsored before, not just the ones on the list of registered sponsors. You can see everything in one click. It also recognises registered names vs trading names, so you don’t need to spend 10+ hours every week searching through the list manually. We've recently launched fresh data, so you can see who's sponsoring as recently as 6 months ago.

records.name: Portlivo
records.tagline: Every local dev server on your Mac, in the menu bar
records.description: Portlivo shows every dev server and port running on your Mac: which project it's from, the command, uptime and whether it's answering. Open, restart, kill, tail logs or share any of them in one click. Native, no account, one-time price.

records.name: yggy
records.tagline: The AI knowledge graph that builds itself
records.description: Most "chat with your data" tools throw a pile of text chunks at a model and hope for the best. yggy does what they skip: it turns your cluttered documents and connected systems into a real knowledge graph, with no schema to design and no pipeline to run. Every fact keeps its source. Duplicates merge themselves, and you can undo any merge. Then one graph serves everyone: your team in the app, your code through the API, your agents through MCP. Hosted in the EU. Your knowledge stays yours.

records.name: reception
records.tagline: Native iOS support chat for less churn
records.description: The native in-app support chat your iOS app is missing. 💰 Make more money: send offers and paywalls in the chat ⭐ Get more App Store reviews from happy users 🔧 Fix problems in real time before users churn 🤖 AI answers from your docs, hands off to you when unsure 📥 One inbox for your whole team ⚡ One prompt setup: paste it into your coding agent, done Fully native. Works with Swift, React Native and Expo.

records.name: ESP-Mosaico
records.tagline: A modular development board built for agents
records.description: Built for Coding Agents, ESP-Mosaico is a modular development board powered by ESP32-S31. It takes AI agents beyond software and into the physical world, enabling them to create, deploy, test, and iterate on real hardware. Expandable modules and multi-unit tiling give AI agents more ways to create, while Chat Coding and Vibe Coding give you intuitive ways to turn ideas into working physical devices.

records.name: Hoistbay
records.tagline: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront
records.description: Hoistbay is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that takes the repetitive work out of S3 and CloudFront. Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

records.name: Composio Instant
records.tagline: The easiest way for AI agents to pay for their own tools
records.description: Give your agent superpowers. No subscriptions, no signups. With Composio Instant, your agent can search the web, find business contacts, create voiceovers, turn audio into text, and so much more. Try it free: composio.dev/instant

records.name: Hashoff
records.tagline: Kill the leave spreadsheet. Time off, handled in Slack.
records.description: Leave tracking always degrades into the same thing: a spreadsheet, a Slack message, and someone's memory. Hashoff puts the whole thing in Slack. Request time off and approve it in one tap. Balances that accrue weekly, monthly or quarterly and pro-rate for mid-year joiners. Half days, carry-over, leave years that span New Year, public holidays for 152 countries. Your roster imports itself. Optional birthday and work-anniversary digests. Two minutes to install. Free for 30 days.

records.name: AtheraStudio Code
records.tagline: Modern local HTML, & PHP editor with instant PHP 8.3 preview
records.description: AtheraStudio Code is a browser-based editor for HTML, CSS, JS, and PHP. Run real PHP 8.3 with live preview, supporting includes, sessions, forms, and SQLite, with zero installs and serverless local privacy. Features Emmet, smart suggestions, MySQL/PDO preview emulation (BETA), and an AI Assistant (own API keys). Free under SA-SDL 1.0 for sites & SaaS <$1.5k/mo. Paid plans from $5.99/mo. Crafted in Poland.

records.name: Ad Library Saver & Creative Spy
records.tagline: Download & swipe winning Facebook & TikTok ads in 1 click
