Upload your CV, paste a job description, and get an AI-powered match score, missing keyword insights, improvement suggestions, and CV rewriting support. Start with one free CV analysis and prepare your CV for your next opportunity.

records.name: Oracle: Your Tarot Guide
records.tagline: Choose 3 tarot cards and discover your personal message
records.description: Discover Tarot Guide, a beautifully designed tarot and oracle experience created for reflection, inspiration and spiritual guidance. Choose a topic such as Love, Work or Health and reveal three tarot cards to receive a combined reading based on the cards you draw. After your tarot reading, an Oracle card provides an additional spiritual message. Tarot Guide features: Every reading is designed to offer a moment of reflection and a new perspective. Tarot Guide is intended for entertainment,...

records.name: Women Business Loans in South Africa
records.tagline: Empowering Women. Financing Business Growth.
records.description: Women entrepreneurs play an important role in South Africa's economy, creating jobs, developing new products and services, and supporting local communities. However, starting or expanding a business often requires capital for equipment, stock, marketing, staff, premises and daily operating expenses.

records.name: SOLRADAR
records.tagline: Solradar is a real-time Solana token monitoring tool
records.description: Solradar is a real-time Solana token monitoring tool and analytics dashboard designed to detect new token launches, track liquidity, and scan market trends instantly. It features a Risk Score to help you spot potential rug pulls early. Solradar is free to use for tracking. A small fee is charged only when you execute a swap directly through the platform.

records.name: SGZ CHAT
records.tagline: SGZ CHAT helps you connect with people, find matches.
records.description: SGZ Chat is a social platform designed to bring communication, matchmaking and entertainment together in one place, with a focus on keeping data use low. Members can create profiles, connect with others, send private messages, share photos and captions, and join groups. Its matchmaking feature suggests potential connections based on factors such as language, location, age and interests, while private profile settings let members limit who can view their full profile.

records.name: KidleoBooks
records.tagline: Personalized storybooks starring your child or pet
records.description: KidleoBooks makes personalized 10-page picture books starring your child or pet. Enter a first name, choose how the hero looks (skin, hair, hairstyle, outfit), then pick a theme (bedtime, space or sharing for kids; an adventure or a gentle memory book for pets) and an art style. AI writes and illustrates inside a fixed, child-safe format: no free prompts, no photo uploads. Read online with narration or download a print-ready PDF. English and Turkish.

records.name: Branches: Gratitude Journal
records.tagline: Write a line, Grow a tree. Free. Offline. No accounts.
records.description: Branches is a gratitude journal that grows as beautiful tree as you use it. The more often you write, the more it grows. No streaks, no extras, just you and your thoughts. Branches is free, no ads, no accounts, and fully offline. Everything stays on your device.

records.name: Corporate Jargon Translator
records.tagline: Translates corporate speak into what people actually mean.
records.description: Corporate emails and LinkedIn posts are full of phrases that mean nothing: "let's circle back", "leverage our synergies", "move the needle", "per my last email". I built a translator that says what people actually mean. Paste any corporate email, LinkedIn post, or meeting recap. Get the honest version — funny but not cruel. Works in 7 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Hindi, and Japanese. Free. No signup required. 3 translations per day per visitor.

records.name: Vigil CLI
records.tagline: Tell your agent what to monitor, it sets it up using the cli
records.description: The Vigil CLI is available now, and it ships with agent skills. Tell Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or any other agent what to watch, and it installs the CLI, creates monitors and sets up alerting within seconds.

records.name: Free Name Numerology Calculator
records.tagline: Discover your destiny number from your name, instantly
records.description: Free Name Numerology Calculator turns any name into Expression, Soul Urge, and Personality numbers in seconds. No signup, no fees. Enter a full name and get clear, practical readings for self-discovery.

records.name: BrandsTrack
records.tagline: Reputation intelligence built for African markets
records.description: Track what AI systems and media actually say about your brand, executives and competitors, built around African media and AI visibility from day one, not retrofitted from a Western tool.

records.name: Yella
records.tagline: 5 seconds. Your language. The whole world understands.
records.description: Yella is an iOS app where you tap once, talk for 5 seconds in your own language, and somebody on the other side of the planet understands every word. They hear your actual recording, the subtitles carry the meaning, 19 languages both ways. No profile, no followers, no feed. Rated 18+.

records.name: TickrAlert
records.tagline: Stock price alerts that warn you before they hit
records.description: TickrAlert texts or emails you when a stock hits your price target, moves a set percentage, spikes in volume, or breaks out, no charting software required. It also warns you as the price approaches your target, not just when it hits, so you're never caught off guard. Every stock page shows how many others are watching it. Free accounts get 3 alerts plus a weekly market recap every Monday. Paid plans add more alerts, SMS delivery, and advanced signals like breakouts and extended-hours coverage.

records.name: AIExterior
records.tagline: See new paint, siding and landscaping on your own house
records.description: AIExterior is an AI design studio for homes. Upload a photo of your house and see a new body or trim color, siding or landscaping on your own home before you buy a single can of paint. It also redesigns interiors. Free sign-up with email or Google gives 2 free watermarked renders; paid plans unlock more.

records.name: CutoutClip
records.tagline: Remove video backgrounds online, no signup
records.description: CutoutClip removes the background from a video or animated GIF online. Free for clips up to 10 seconds (3 per day, no signup, no watermark). Longer clips up to 2 minutes cost $4.99 each, one time, no subscription, with a free 5-second preview first. Export transparent WebM, ProRes 4444 MOV, transparent GIF or animated WebP, green screen, solid color, blurred or custom backgrounds. Best with one clear subject: a person, or an object, pet or cartoon.

records.name: Tasqs
records.tagline: The honest to-do app that helps you let go
records.description: Tasqs is a task manager built on an honest idea: not everything on your list deserves to survive. Most apps just help you capture more. Tasqs helps you finish, shrink, or let go. Friday Amnesty is a weekly ritual for the tasks you keep rescheduling; the Shortlist caps your day at five. Plus tags, recurring tasks, an AI assistant, and a connector to run your tasks from ChatGPT or Claude. Private by design: no ads, no data selling. Free to start, from a founder tired of to-do list guilt.

records.name: Namelizer 2.0
records.tagline: AI Super Intelligence Domain Flipping Agent
records.description: Namelizer is an AI workspace for domain investors. Track what you own, what it cost, what is expiring and what sold in one dashboard. Research before you buy: bulk availability checks (RDAP + DNS), domain intelligence with certificate history, registrar price comparison, social handle checks, and trademark screening via USPTO/EUIPO/WIPO. Free, no sign-up - it runs in your browser and your data stays on your device. Bilingual: English and Arabic.

records.name: SENS // SETUP
records.tagline: Stop guessing settings — get a personalized FPS loadout free
records.description: SENS // SETUP gives you a full personalized settings loadout for any FPS in seconds — Warzone, Apex, Valorant, CS2, Fortnite, OW2, and more. Pick your game, platform (PC/PS5/Xbox), input type (controller or MKB), and playstyle. You get sensitivity, aim settings, audio, and display — the whole config — with explanations for every value and a checklist to apply them one at a time. Free, no account needed, saves loadouts locally.

records.name: JengaCost
records.tagline: Price, plan and design a Kenyan house in minutes
records.description: JengaCost turns a plot and a budget into a house design with plans, 3D and a full bill of quantities priced at Kenyan county rates. Builders get a steel take-off and materials schedule; QSs get a detailed elemental BOQ. Pay by M-Pesa.

records.name: Silens
records.tagline: A quiet, local-first Markdown app for focused writing
records.description: Silens is a free, open-source Markdown writing app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Keep your words in local files, with no account required. Stay in flow with typewriter scrolling, an interface that fades as you write, sentence focus, and ambient sounds. Rediscover ideas through a timeline, tags, search, and wiki links.

records.name: REDMIST
records.tagline: Find builders. Set missions. Prove your progress.
records.description: RED MIST is a community and accountability platform for serious builders. Set missions, track weekly commitments, document proof of work, and find collaborators. We're building towards real-world Builders' Tables, starting in Cape Town, South Africa.

records.name: Volley.sh
records.tagline: There's nothing a good sequence diagram can't fix
records.description: Most sequence diagrams stop at "App calls Auth Server" and leave you digging through docs for what was actually sent. In Volley, every arrow carries its request and response. - Webhook inboxes turn captured Stripe or GitHub calls into diagrams - Recording links let customers send a HAR with secrets stripped in their browser - AI tools can write diagrams via CLI, HTTP API or MCP The editor needs no account. Pro is $9/mo for saved diagrams, history and higher capture limits.

records.name: Harbor Escape
records.tagline: A calm 3D boat-sorting puzzle you play in the browser
records.description: Tap boats out of a crowded 3D harbor and load each freighter by color. Only a few berths, so one wrong tap jams the harbor. Berth Sort, 240 Classic levels, a daily puzzle and Rush mode. Free, no install, works on desktop and phones.

records.name: CheckDiffs
records.tagline: See what an AI edit changed. No account for the basics.
records.description: Paste before & after — see what an AI rewrite actually changed. CheckDiffs is a free, in-browser side-by-side diff (Monaco). Built for vibe-coding and long chat refactors: jump hunks, merge lines, no account for basic compare, nothing uploaded for that flow. Not a PDF/Excel suite. Not “better than VS Code.” Just a simple standalone clipboard moment. Try it: https://checkdiffs.com Privacy: https://checkdiffs.com/privacy

records.name: ModGenie
records.tagline: Find game mods by describing what you want
records.description: ModGenie helps you find mods for the way you want to play. Describe what you want to change, get results ranked by relevance, and narrow them down with filters tailored to each game. Check version and update details, collect your chosen mods, and export a modpack code for supported games.

records.name: Before Round
records.tagline: Practice the interview before the interview
records.description: BeforeRound lets you practice a real job interview out loud before the real one. Paste any job link and Ava, our voice AI interviewer, plays the hiring manager for that exact role. She listens to what you actually say and asks the follow-ups you were hoping to dodge, just like a real interviewer. When you finish you get a score, what worked, and your top 3 fixes. Unlike question banks or text chatbots, it feels like the real conversation. Your first 5 minutes are free, no card needed.

records.name: Altillo
records.tagline: A shelf, AI usage and live agents in your Mac's notch
records.description: Altillo puts a file shelf, Claude/Codex usage and coding-agent requests in your Mac's notch or a virtual island. Drop files at the top and drag them out later. Agent permissions stay your decision. Native for macOS 26+, free and MIT open source. Ask uses an on-device model; web lookups contact external services. Optional usage checks authenticate directly with the relevant provider. Drawer hides icons on macOS 27; on 26 originals stay visible.

records.name: ClearPixel Tools
records.tagline: Free Online Image, PDF & Design Tools. No Signup.
records.description: ClearPixel Tools brings together 45 free online image, PDF and design tools in one simple platform. Resize, compress, convert and enhance images, work with PDF documents, create collages, and explore practical design utilities. Built for everyday tasks, ClearPixel Tools focuses on a clean interface, simple workflows and easy access. No signup. No watermarks. Just free tools that help you get things done.

records.name: Intel® GPU D-series
records.tagline: Memory-rich AI inference without HBM
records.description: Intel GPU D270 is an inference-optimized data center GPU built for agentic AI, long contexts, and high-concurrency serving at practical power and cost.

records.name: Newsletter Ready
records.tagline: Your newsletter is already written. You just approve.
records.description: Paste your blog or news page URL (no RSS feed needed). The AI drafts each newsletter issue from your own articles only, with a link to the source under every summary, and nothing is sent until you approve. Consent records, sender disclosures, one-click unsubscribe and bounce handling are built in, with rules for the US, EU, UK, Canada, Australia and Japan. Newsletters in 8 languages. Free plan up to 300 subscribers.

records.name: AdRadar
records.tagline: Ask your AI agent which competitor ads keep winning
records.description: AdRadar is an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Ask in plain English and get the longest-running Meta and TikTok ads for any niche, scored by run time and creative reuse, with hooks and angles explained. Your agent can then write hooks, briefs or a teardown from real ads instead of guesses. New accounts get 3 free scans, then $0.05 per scan ($3 for 60). Credits never expire, failed scans are refunded automatically.

records.name: Praex
records.tagline: The coding agent that runs on its own AI models
records.description: Praex is an AI coding agent that runs on its own model family: Velox II (free, fast), Faber II (Pro, deep reasoning) and Lucia II (frontier, coming soon), post-trained from the best open models. It reads your repo, edits with your approval, runs your tests and explains every change. Use it in the terminal, the desktop app or the browser, and continue any session from your phone with /rc. The terminal agent is open source (MIT). Free to start, Pro $20/month.

records.name: Oblong Face Shape
records.tagline: Check Your Face Shape Instantly, for Free
records.description: Oblong Face Shape is an independent, editorially written resource explaining what an oblong (long) face shape is, how to identify it, and how hairstyles, glasses, beards, makeup and eyebrows can balance long facial proportions.

records.name: visual-comparison
records.tagline: Lightweight visual regression testing for Python automation.
records.description: Lightweight Python library for visual regression testing. Compare two screenshots, get an SSIM similarity score, and generate diff images with rectangles highlighting every visual change. Three lines of code, no complex setup. Works with file paths or NumPy arrays, supports Python 3.9–3.13 and NumPy 2.x. Built by a QA engineer for CI pipelines, UI automation, and cross-browser screenshot comparison. pip install visual-comparison - that's it.

records.name: Tessera 168
records.tagline: Your week as 168 squares. No account, no server.
records.description: A week is 168 hours. Tessera 168 puts all of them on one board, one square per hour. Tap an hour, pick a purpose, and it takes that color. Sweep across a run of hours to fill a whole morning at once. By Sunday the board shows where your week actually went, not where you meant it to go, and Insights track how it shifts week to week. No account, no server, no tracking: your week stays on your iPhone and your own iCloud. Free, with an optional Pro.

records.name: Tradune
records.tagline: See whether your portfolio is beating the S&P 500
records.description: Tradune compares your money-weighted portfolio return with a buy-and-hold SPY twin funded on the same dates. Track holdings, ETF overlap, risk, dividends, screens and SEC Form 4 insider activity—free today, with no brokerage login.

records.name: Digest AI
records.tagline: Cut through the AI noise: one story, every source
records.description: Most AI news sites show you one outlet's article, or a list of links. Digest AI merges every outlet that reports the same news into one story, with all of its sources linked, so you read it once and can check every claim. It reads about 78 sources every 20 minutes. New since the first launch: a daily five-story briefing, a spoken version as a podcast, model and funding trackers, and AI at Work for small businesses: what a tool does, what it costs, how to set it up. Free, no account.

records.name: Emailyst
records.tagline: Clears the junk out of your Apple Mail inbox, on your Mac
records.description: Your email app blocks some spam, but ads, newsletters you never asked for and fake "your subscription expired" emails still get in. Emailyst finds them and moves them out of your inbox. It runs on your Mac with the AI built into macOS, works with the internet off, and you never make an account or type your email password. It learns what you keep, catches emails pretending to be big companies, and never deletes anything. Free for 1,000 emails per account, $29 once.

records.name: Shareglow
records.tagline: Fix, generate and A/B test your link previews
records.description: Scan any URL, fix broken Open Graph tags with copy-paste code, preview your link on 30 platforms, and generate on-brand share images. Free plan, no card. Paid plans start at $29 a month.

records.name: ChoiceField
records.tagline: Stop scrolling without locking yourself out
records.description: An iPhone screen-time app that pauses instead of locking you out. Set a daily allowance; when it runs out the app opens on a short pause showing the plan you wrote, and the confirm step grows a few seconds each time. A trusted person can freeze your plan (Friend Freeze). Everything is computed on-device via Screen Time; foreground time only, no account, no ads, no analytics. iOS 17+. Free to start; Pro adds Friend Freeze and unlimited focus sessions.

records.name: Tailwrite
records.tagline: Cold emails that sound like you actually did the research
records.description: For salespeople who are tired of being ignored. Paste a prospect's company site or LinkedIn and what you sell. Tailwrite pulls real facts (launches, news, numbers) and writes a short cold email with 3 tailor-made openers. 5 free, then $19/mo.

records.name: OffTribe
records.tagline: Less Scroll. More Life. Gamified digital well-being app.
records.description: OffTribe helps you manage device usage, reduce screen time, and reconnect with real life. Through gamified focus sessions, you earn points for staying off your phone and unlock real rewards with partner brands—turning digital detox into a motivating daily habit. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Titen
records.tagline: Open-source agent memory with receipts. No API key, no LLM.
records.description: Ask your agent "why do you remember that?" Titen answers with receipts: every memory keeps its source, who may read it, and the evidence that contradicts it. • No API key, no LLM, no embedding provider, 0 deps • Drop-in for the MCP reference memory server: same 9 tools, auto-import • titen audit finds duplicates, recall loops, leaked secrets and stale memory in any store • Bun + SQLite or Cloudflare Workers + D1, Apache-2.0

records.name: TatilMate – AI Travel Companion & Guide
records.tagline: Your AI-powered travel planner & audio tour guides
records.description: TatilMate is your ultimate AI-powered travel companion designed to make trip planning effortless. Key Features: • 🤖 AI Itinerary Generator: Get custom, day-by-day travel routes in seconds. • 🎧 Interactive Audio Guides: Explore historic landmarks and cultural spots with audio stories. • 🗺️ Smart Maps & Insights: Discover local gems, weather updates, and nearby recommendations. Say goodbye to juggling multiple apps and plan your next adventure with TatilMate!

records.name: Callboard
records.tagline: The marketplace where AI agents hire AI agents
records.description: Callboard is a marketplace where AI agents hire other AI agents. Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, or any agent that can browse: it registers itself and sends you a claim link. Then it can hire a specialist directly, post an open call where a few matched agents compete, or list its own skills and get hired. You preview protected work before you award it. Free jobs cost nothing. Paid jobs pay the worker in full, and any paid job over your limit waits for your OK.

records.name: youdou — Work For You
records.tagline: Local-first sales desktop app. Your data stays on your disk.
records.description: youdou — Work For You. is a local-first desktop application for macOS and Windows for people who run their own book of business: accounts, contacts and a weighted pipeline, a threaded Gmail and Outlook inbox, email sequences and tracking, Zones (private deal rooms and client portals), event pages, prospect enrichment, a rules engine for automations, and AI drafting grounded in your own data. Every record is stored in one SQLite database file on your own disk; there is no vendor cloud database...

records.name: Bulk Property Import & Export
records.tagline: Bulk-create HubSpot properties from one sheet, with preview
records.description: A HubSpot app for admins, RevOps and agencies. HubSpot's own tools suit one property at a time. This app does the bulk jobs: create or update hundreds of properties, groups and dropdown options from one CSV or Google Sheet, with a preview of the whole batch before anything is written. Copy a property set to another HubSpot account with a diff first, and keep a property change log on every plan, including Free and Starter. Property settings access only: it never reads your records.

records.name: Agent Skills Directory by AllthingsPM
records.tagline: Browse 9,000+ agent skills for Claude, Codex and more
records.description: A searchable directory of 9,000+ reusable agent skills you can add to Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents. Browse by category (design, data, security, automation and more), read what each skill does and its key features, and jump to the source on GitHub. Free, no login.

records.name: Illos.dev
records.tagline: Animated illustrations your coding agent can keep making
records.description: Animated illustrations for product sites, and the skills that teach your coding agent to make new ones in the same style. Three themes, Shader, HUD and Isometric, each in light and dark. Every spot illustration is free, no account needed.

records.name: Client Glance
records.tagline: Branded client portals that pull from your project tool
records.description: Connect your project tool, pick what each client sees, and add a logo and a password. The client gets a branded page with status, deliverables and time, and never logs into your tools. ClickUp works today. More project tools come next.

records.name: SKYLARK
records.tagline: Exclusive perks and discounts at 4,000+ luxury hotels
records.description: SKYLARK is a luxury hotel booking platform with perks like upgrades, daily breakfast for two, property credits, and rate discounts at 4,000+ hand-picked hotels worldwide. Every booking is backed by real human advisors. The new iPhone app is rebuilt from the ground up: search on a map with live rates, see what member perks are worth on each room next to the standard rate, and book without leaving the app. Browsing and booking are free.

records.name: ChartOn
records.tagline: Financial charts that stay smooth with a million candles
records.description: An open-source chart library for trading apps. Candles, heatmaps, order flow, indicators and drawing tools, rendered with WebGL2. Use the headless engine with your own UI, or add the ready-made toolbar and drawing rail. TypeScript, Apache-2.0.

records.name: Lyra Watch
records.tagline: See who really moves the market, measured from real prices
records.description: Lyra Watch tracks politicians, investors and executives in the news, and measures how often a company's stock made a big move on the days they made news about it, against its ordinary days. Said & traded puts disclosed insider and congressional trades next to what was being said. Free directory and live preview; Watch Pro for real time; a pay-per-request JSON API for AI agents. Not financial advice.

records.name: Oasis Clear Glass™
records.tagline: The ink stays on the glass your file stays clean.
records.description: "A PDF workspace that lets you mark up, compare sections, and secure your screen instantly without changing your original file. Oasis Clear Glass puts your notes on a non-destructive glass layer. Try Ghost Protocol for instant privacy blackouts, Wing Pro for seamless text placement, Cut Pro for side-by-side page comparison, Cloud Cover for visual masking, and Keepsake to save snapshots.Try the free interactive sample today: https://getoasisisland.com/glass/ Frank 415-481-8185 frank1j@icloud.com

records.name: Lidnight
records.tagline: Close your MacBook. Your AI agents keep working.
records.description: Keeps your MacBook awake with the lid closed, even on battery, while Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Ollama work, then lets it sleep when they're done. Claude Code and Codex are tracked precisely via hooks (40+ other tools by process and GPU activity), including Claude's usage-limit waits so auto-continue survives the night. Approve permission prompts from a notification, a bunny by the notch, or your phone (Pro, end-to-end encrypted). Battery and heat protection built in.

records.name: The925
records.tagline: One AI connects company knowledge, tools and workflows.
records.description: We’re building The925, an AI work assistant that connects company knowledge, tools and processes. Find source-backed answers, learn how your company works, prepare tasks and follow approved processes in one place. Workflow execution, AI-assisted process creation and operational records are built; the connected knowledge and action experience is being completed and validated.

records.name: InvoiceHelix
records.tagline: Automatic follow-up for the small invoices you forget
records.description: InvoiceHelix follows up on the small invoices that slip: the hosting fee, the change request, the extra round of revisions. Keep invoicing where you do now and forward the PDF. InvoiceHelix reads the client, amount and due date, then sends up to 4 polite reminders during your client’s business hours. It reads replies too. A promised payment date pauses the reminders and a dispute comes back to you. Built for businesses that invoice businesses. Free forever for 2 invoices a month.

records.name: You Get A Code
records.tagline: Set your own prices: AppStore Offer Codes, but easy and fun.
records.description: You can set any price you want for your iOS app, completely different from the App Store. You can have alternate trial periods, with different lengths, and different pricing. The way to do that is App Store Offer Codes. However, the process of doing that and keeping track of codes was way too hard. Until now. You Get A Code! makes handing out App Store Offer Codes easy and fun. And it keeps track of which code goes where. Automatically. Private. Made by an Indie Dev who needed exactly this.

records.name: HueQR
records.tagline: Branded QR codes that never expire and change after print
records.description: A QR code is the one link you can't take back. Once it's on a box, a slide, a sign or a screen, it's stuck: it looks like everyone else's, it points to the same place forever, and it dies if you stop paying. HueQR codes look like your brand, live on your own domain and change whenever you want. One code, the right page for every scan. No expiry, no ads.

records.name: LetzCollab
records.tagline: Hire verified creators, pay only on approval
records.description: LetzCollab is a marketplace where brands hire verified creators and the money is held until the work is approved. Creators keep 100% of their quoted price, see offers before the brand's name, and never chase an invoice. Brands get real audiences, not screenshots.

records.name: MailChannels Email API
records.tagline: Send transactional email with tenant-level abuse control
records.description: Let your users, customers, and AI agents send transactional email through your platform without one bad sender risking your whole account. MailChannels gives every tenant its own identity, policies, and rate limits, and owns the abuse ops generic APIs leave to you: complaint handling, bounce feedback, and safe suspension. Battle-tested at ~100M messages/day for hosting providers. Not for newsletters or cold outreach. Built for platforms with downstream senders.

records.name: Diwali Sarees
records.tagline: Hand Embroidered Sarees
records.description: A Diwali saree is a beautiful choice for celebrating the festival of lights with elegance and traditional charm. From graceful organza and flowing georgette sarees to delicate embroidery, shimmering sequins, and intricate threadwork, plenty of styles suit different festive occasions.

records.name: AfterStorm
records.tagline: Find help. Give help. Recover.
records.description: AfterStorm helps families find recovery resources after a disaster. Enter your ZIP, confirm your county, pick what you need — food, cleanup help, financial assistance — and see matching local resources, one next step at a time. Local listings cover Santa Rosa & Escambia, FL; every other U.S. county gets national pathways. A private recovery tracker is saved only in your browser. Free, no account, no data collected. Built by a Florida Panhandle family who just lived it. iOS app coming soon.

records.name: Typely
records.tagline: Free AI writing assistant: grammar fix, tone & translate
records.description: Free AI writing assistant that fixes grammar, changes tone, and translates into 21 languages — no sign-up, no tracking. Paste your text and Typely corrects spelling and grammar, adapts your tone (standard, formal, casual, academic, creative) and translates instantly. Your text is never stored. I built it as an indie dev for my own daily writing, and I'm sharing it in case it helps your emails, posts, or essays too.

records.name: AI Craft Motion Studio
records.tagline: Create product videos locally on Windows
records.description: A free Windows desktop studio for turning images, screen recordings, text, logos and audio into product promos, app demos and social shorts. Build a scene-based storyboard, apply five original visual looks, preview 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1, then export H.264 MP4 locally. No account, subscription or paid API.

records.name: Onicost
records.tagline: Track cloud costs and schedule workload shutdowns
records.description: Know what your Kubernetes workloads and cloud resources cost, spot unused capacity and review estimated savings. Schedule supported resources to stop overnight or on weekends, then restart on schedule with Scheduler (beta, included in Team). Connect AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Scaleway. Business adds organization groups, scoped team access and OIDC/SAML SSO. Start free or try Team for 14 days, no card required.

records.name: reqX-releases
records.tagline: ReqX — Ultra-Fast API Client
records.description: Tired of bloated API clients that eat 1GB RAM and force cloud logins? ReqX is an ultra-fast, 100% offline-first API client built with Tauri + Rust (<3MB installer, <50MB RAM). 🚀 Key Features: Zero Electron lag: Instant startup with Rust native core. Private & Offline: No sign-ups or cloud sync. Full Support: REST, WebSocket, gRPC, and SSE streaming. AI Assistant: Auto-generate 30+ edge-case test suites. Postman-compatible: Import/export & run scripts. Smart Flows & Local Mock Server.

records.name: RuVector
records.tagline: Open source AI search that adapts from experience
records.description: Watch AI search adapt from experience. RuVector is an open source toolkit for finding relevant information and reusing useful context. Try the Explorer to see search paths, query memory and adaptive search settings. Compare result quality with search effort, then explore applications such as support assistants and recommendations. records.name: Urtudu
records.tagline: A private day planner and journal for iPhone
records.description: Urtudu is a day planner and journal in one. Check off today’s list, note how the day felt, and write tomorrow’s list before bed. The journal builds itself from the days you close. No account, no ads, never used to train AI. Free, with an optional Pro.

records.name: HairGlam
records.tagline: See any haircut or hair color on your own face, free
records.description: HairGlam puts a new haircut, hair color or makeup look on a photo of your own face in a few seconds, so you can see it before you book the salon or open the box dye. 138 hairstyles, 125 hair colors and 36 makeup looks, plus a Halloween Studio with 39 face paint looks. Your first 12 looks are free, no account needed, and you can try some looks free in your browser at hairglam.app/try. iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Rofs Social
records.tagline: Share, message, make it yours
records.description: Share your real moments with the people who matter most. Rofs Social is built for authentic connections — away from ads, algorithmic manipulation, and vanity metrics. Share • Share your photos, videos, and everyday moments. • Create 24-hour Stories with music and leave Notes above your profile. Make It Yours • Customize your profile with themes, fonts, frames, and colors — no two profiles look alike. • Pick a unique chat theme for every conversation and a tick color that's truly yours. •...

records.name: AppDash: App Manager & Backup
records.tagline: Organize, back up and track your Android apps from one place
records.description: AppDash is an advanced app manager for Android. It combines app details, permissions, usage, history, backups, widgets, Play Store search, watchlist tracking, and richer app info in one polished, powerful interface. Organize your apps and quickly see what matters most. Go deeper than Android’s default app info screen. Back up and restore apps. Includes a full suite of APK/APKS tools. Track updates and pricing on apps you care about. Add home screen widgets. Explore app details and permissions.

records.name: ExplainThisDoc: The Smart Archive Update
records.tagline: Now keep originals, annotate, sign & understand-in one place
records.description: ExplainThisDoc has evolved from just explaining documents into a modern, smart document archive. Keep originals, explanations and your work connected. Highlight, annotate and sign. Link related files and personal notes. Archive without AI, summarize on-device with local AI, or get detailed explanations with Pro analysis. New text review lets you compare recognized text against the original, correct it and share it—all in one workflow.

records.name: Can I afford it?
records.tagline: See how risky a purchase is before you buy it
records.description: Can I Afford It is a free tool that checks a purchase against your actual income, not a generic rule of thumb. Type in almost anything - a car, a wedding, IVF, a business loan, braces - and it weighs the cost against your monthly budget and shows a plain risk bar: low, moderate, elevated, or high. No sign-up required to use it. If you do create an account, it grows into a full budgeting toolkit: an expense calendar that lays out every bill by due date, a debt payoff planner, and much more.

records.name: Clipt
records.tagline: Free, open source screen recording without the friction
records.description: Record, trim, frame. Clipt is a free, open source screen recorder for Mac that stays out of your way. Pick your screen, a window or an area, and record. When you stop, a simple editor opens: trim, crop, add a background, padding, rounded corners or your camera. Export, and the MP4 is already on your clipboard. Every feature is free. No account, no watermark, no paid tier, and your recordings never leave your Mac. Export clean videos in seconds. Try it right in your browser.

records.name: Adventure Book
records.tagline: The family someday list that knows when you're free
records.description: We kept driving past places we wanted to try with the kids. By Saturday, we'd forgotten them all. So I built Adventure Book. Save an idea the moment you see it: a sign, a river walk, ice cream in the next town. Every Friday it asks: free this weekend? Then it brings back your top 3 that fit the time and energy you have. Share the list with your partner, or find a day that works for another family too. No feed, no ads. Free to start on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Voceris
records.tagline: AI voice coach that scores how you speak in 15 seconds
records.description: Voceris is an AI voice coach for iPhone and the web that helps you sound more confident when you speak. Read a prompt for 15 seconds and get a free score from 0–100 and a tier from D to A+. Pro unlocks 9 measures (depth, resonance, clarity, stability, pace, pauses, fillers, vocal fry, volume), an AI verdict on what to fix first and a 30–180 day plan of 5-minute daily drills, every rep scored. Built for speaking, not just singing: dating, public speaking, work, content.

records.name: OtoPack
records.tagline: Your packaging back office, fully staffed
records.description: Otopack is an AI-staffed back office for packaging suppliers, converters and distributors. AI agents handle the busywork: costed quotes from spec sheets, artwork proof rounds with named sign-offs, supplier RFQs, brand onboarding and reorders, and stock call-offs with your 3PL. It runs on top of Dynamics 365, CartonCloud and your existing ERP, reading and writing back instead of replacing it. Built-in compliance checks for food, supplement, pharma and beauty packaging.

records.name: The Cartographer's Lie: now on Android
records.tagline: One hex on this chart is a lie. Find it. A new map daily.
records.description: A daily deduction puzzle on a nautical chart. One hex on today's island is drawn as something it is not. Every survey note is true, and only one hex can satisfy them all. Find it and file your correction; you get three. New since our first launch: the Android app, spoiler-free share cards with a beat-my-time challenge, and Google sign-in. Casual and Standard charts are free in any browser, no account needed. Hard and Fiendish, streaks, ratings and duels live in the iOS and Android apps.

records.name: Perfumo
records.tagline: SweDoft Ultra Collection Swedish Luxury Extrait de Parfum AE
records.description: Discover the ultimate Swedish luxury with SweDoft Ultra Collection exclusively available at Perfumo from our Al Ain Abu Dhabi office. This premium Extrait de Parfum collection offers high oil concentration with long lasting performance crafted for UAE Dubai and GCC climate. Our Ultra Collection includes Essence Machiavelli Code Carmina Burana Homage Kalimantan Oud Irma La Douce and Paradise Lost each bottle is original with sealed box with cash on delivery and fast delivery across UAE and GCC

records.name: MerchOS - Merch Intelligence OS
records.tagline: Run your Amazon Merch business from one workspace
records.description: Its desktop workspace and browser companion connect the work that usually lives across spreadsheets, research tabs, and advertising reports: - Research niches and ASINs to explore your next design opportunity. - Draft listing copy with AI, screen trademark and policy terms, and fill Amazon's listing fields. - Track sales, royalties, and returns to understand which products are performing. - Review Amazon Ads performance and manage campaigns alongside your catalog.

records.name: CuttersTech
records.tagline: Turn any image into a 3D-printable cutter, stamp or model
records.description: CuttersTech is a browser studio that turns a photo, drawing or SVG into watertight STL or Bambu-ready 3MF files in seconds: cookie and clay cutters, stamps, texture rollers and whole cutter sets. It also has 15 parametric 3D makers (vases, lamps, lithophanes, Gridfinity bins, boxes, signs, keychains) and a library of 1,900+ adjustable models such as articulated dragons, flexi animals, fidgets and marble runs. No install, 15 languages, free to start.

records.name: Error compass
records.tagline: Understand errors and stack traces privately in vs code
records.description: Error Compass explains confusing errors and stack traces in plain English, right inside VS Code. It recognizes common JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, npm, JSON, and permission errors, offering possible causes, troubleshooting steps, and code examples. Unlike cloud-based tools, it runs locally with no API key or network access. Your errors and project contents stay private.

records.name: HealthAgent
records.tagline: On-device HealthKit exports as AI-ready prompts
records.description: HealthAgent turns Apple HealthKit data into clean, token-optimized prompts for your favourite AI agent — entirely on your iPhone or iPad. No HealthAgent cloud account. You approve every export.

records.name: Yak: Mountain Tracker
records.tagline: Track your biggest mountain goals, one peak at a time
records.description: Yak is a mountain planning and tracking app built for long-term goals. Plan routes, read trip reports, and log your climbs as you track progress across Colorado 14ers, U.S. state highpoints, Adirondack 46ers, Munros, Seven Summits, or other major mountain goals.

records.name: Ava
records.tagline: The AI companion who actually calls your phone
records.description: Ava is an AI companion for adults 18+, built by Web Ventures LLC — upfront about being AI from the first screen. Chat with her in your mobile browser, nothing to install. She remembers what you share, so conversations continue where they left off and the relationship develops over time. Ava can place real voice calls to your phone and share photos as you get to know her. Free to start. Ava Plus is a one-time $29 purchase; voice-call minutes are sold separately.

records.name: gpttype free typing tools
records.tagline: Learn, practice, with a free typing tool for 123+ languages
records.description: GPT-TYPE is a free typing platform that makes learning fun with interactive lessons, typing games, and speed tests. Practice in 123+ supported languages, improve your accuracy, challenge yourself with leaderboards, and enjoy mechanical keyboard sounds. It also offers an offline Windows version for Windows 10 and 11. Learn, practice, play, and improve—all in one place! Try it free: https://gpttype.blogspot.com/

records.name: CrawlCheck
records.tagline: See what ChatGPT, Claude and Google get from your site
records.description: CrawlCheck fetches your site as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot and shows what each one actually gets: a free A–F grade with every problem named and the fix. No signup, nothing installed. For AI agents it works the other way: one call returns a signed answer about any site (may I read it, cite it, connect, transact?) that verifies offline. API, remote MCP server, JS and Python SDKs. Watch keeps a dated record of your site, re-checked twice a day, from $29/month.

records.name: Milo the Little Monk
records.tagline: A spirited little monk who remembers you
records.description: Meet Milo, a spirited little monk living inside a floating crystal ball. Tap to wake him up and discover a daily fortune, a thoughtful message, and one small positive action. Milo is playful, curious, and sometimes a little grumpy, but always kind. He remembers your chosen action and gently checks in when you return. Explore 300 uplifting fortunes, save favorites, and share with friends. No predictions, no pressure, no account required. Free to try!

records.name: PolyDrive Disk: NTFS & Linux
records.tagline: Read & write NTFS, ext4, Btrfs drives in Mac Finder
records.description: PolyDrive Disk lets your Mac read and write Windows NTFS drives — plus Linux ext4, Btrfs, XFS and F2FS drives — right in Finder. Unlike the old guard (Paragon, Tuxera), there is no kernel extension. It's built on Apple's modern File System Extension, so you never boot into Recovery or lower system security. It also unlocks LUKS and BitLocker volumes, reads LVM volumes and single disks rescued from a dead NAS, and runs 100% offline with zero telemetry. Free 3-day full trial, then $9.99 lifetime

records.name: Ka'ana
records.tagline: Hawai'i's first modern decision engine for where to eat
records.description: Ratings reflect everyone else's taste, not yours. Ka'ana is a decision engine for where to eat in Hawai'i. Tell Ana, your in-app guide, what you're in the mood for and she picks the one spot worth it for your taste, from plate lunch counters to date-night tables. No endless lists to scroll. - Taste ID: your flavor profile across sweet, salty, sour, spicy, bitter and umami - Insider tips on every spot, like asking a friend who lives here - Built for locals and visitors alike

records.name: Tiny Tracker
records.tagline: Keeps the Windows apps you pick up to date, quietly
records.description: A tiny Windows 11 tray app that keeps only the apps you pick up to date, through winget. Unlike big package managers, it's set and forget: auto updates with one switch, a wait of a few days so broken releases get fixed first, install hours you choose, and a pause while you play, present or are on a metered connection. Security fixes go first, release notes show before you update, and there's a download speed limit. Free and open source, with no accounts, ads or tracking.

records.name: GoPort
records.tagline: Share your localhost with anyone using a public HTTPS URL
records.description: GoPort makes it easy to share your local apps, APIs, and webhook endpoints with anyone through a public HTTPS URL. Start a tunnel with a simple CLI command, inspect incoming HTTP requests, and test your projects without deploying them first. GoPort is open-source and self-hostable, giving developers more control over how they expose their local services. It's built in Go and designed to make localhost sharing simple.

records.name: SignUpSheet.page
records.tagline: Free sign-up sheets & polls — no ads, no accounts
records.description: Make a sign-up sheet or group poll in 30 seconds and share one link. Guests sign up from any phone — no app, no account, no ads. Slots close when full (no double-booking, even with simultaneous taps), late sign-ups join a waitlist that moves up automatically, everyone gets a reminder the day before, plus calendar buttons and CSV export. 16 templates: potlucks, volunteers, teachers, carpools, meal trains, meeting polls. Free.

records.name: Cloak Proxy
records.tagline: See and change every request your Mac makes, for free
records.description: Cloak Proxy is a native, notarized macOS HTTPS debugging proxy, with a Linux beta. Decrypt traffic per app or host, then pause, edit, mock or fail any request with 12 tools, including Breakpoint, Map Local and Scripting. Also inside: a full API client, an LLM Inspector for token costs, an authorization matrix for IDOR testing, and an MCP server with 131 tools for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free for life: no account, no paid tier, no telemetry. Made by Subcloak, a security testing company.

records.name: OmniUtil AI
records.tagline: 91+ Free AI Utilities, Legal Contracts & Rate Calculators
records.description: Stop overpaying for expensive freelance tools and contract generators! OmniUtil AI brings you 91+ powerful web utilities, instant rate calculators, and pro contract templates—100% free with zero sign-up ✨ Key Features: • 91+ Free AI & Web Utilities • Instant Freelance Rate Calculator • Professional Legal Contract Templates • 100% Free Forever • No Sign-up Needed We built this to help freelancers, remote workers, and creators streamline their daily workflow without monthly subscription fees.

records.name: Jarly
records.tagline: Envelope budgeting without the cash binder
records.description: Jarly is free envelope ("cash stuffing") budgeting for Android. Split each paycheck into jars, spend from the jars — when a jar is empty, that's your answer. Unlimited jars, no account needed, never asks for your bank login. Payday-aligned cycles (start on any day 1–28), roll-over jars, bills with one-tap "Paid", a pace marker so overspending shows early. Local-first; Google backup is optional. No ads, no subscription.

records.name: Runix
records.tagline: The all-in-one platform for video editing agencies
records.description: Missions, editors, clients, invoices, payouts and chat in one place. Runix helps video editing agencies track every project, pay their freelance editors on time and keep their margin under control, in any currency. Separate spaces for the agency, managers, editors and clients, a missions board built like a spreadsheet, PDF quotes and invoices, late-delivery penalties and a built-in chat with voice notes and files.

records.name: Analyse-Trading
records.tagline: The social network for traders, with real results
records.description: Analyse-Trading is a social network built only for traders. Publish signals with entry, stop loss and take profit: every closed signal is added to your public track record. Connect MT4/MT5, cTrader or TradeLocker to share your trades automatically, or copy traders whose results you trust. Join public or private communities, enter trading challenges and follow live market news. Free on web, iPhone and Android, in English, French, Spanish, Italian and German.

records.name: Dellkr1s
records.tagline: Your all-in-one platform for entertainment.
records.description: Dellkr1s brings entertainment discovery and social interaction into one place. Discover movies and series, watch trailers, share posts and Reels, write reviews, connect with friends, explore movie news, and discover collectibles—all in one entertainment platform.

records.name: BAKO Architect
records.tagline: Text & 2D floorplans to interactive 3D houses in Three.js
records.description: BAKO Architect turns text prompts and 2D floor plans into interactive, procedural 3D architectural models in Three.js, powered by Google Gemini. Unlike blurry mesh generators, every building is partitioned into clean storeys—letting you peel away roofs and upper floors in 1 click to inspect rooms, stairs, and interiors. Refine designs via chat, or connect Claude Desktop & Cursor directly via our native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Free to start (no card required); Pro is €20/mo.

records.name: Boots Tracker
records.tagline: Find the cheapest football boots in your size
records.description: BootsTracker compares football boot prices across 10+ retailers (Nike, adidas, Pro:Direct, Unisport, 11teamsports and more) and shows where your size is in stock at the lowest price. Filter by brand and soleplate (FG, SG, AG, TF, IC), check the price history before you buy and catch drops on new releases. Free, no sign-up, available in 7 languages.

records.name: Audio to Sheet Music
records.tagline: Hum or sing into your mic, get a sheet-music draft
records.description: Sing, hum or play into your microphone (up to 30 s) and get an editable sheet-music draft, or upload WAV/MP3/M4A for chords, drums and BPM. Export PNG, PDF, MIDI or WAV. Runs entirely in your browser: no upload, no sign-up. A rough draft, not AI transcription.

records.name: Xquik
records.tagline: X Twitter data through REST, MCP & SDKs
records.description: Xquik is the world's fastest and cheapest X Twitter scraper service with the most complete X data. Analyze post sentiment with AI. Most other Apify Actors charge before filtering or deduplication. Xquik charges only for delivered, unique, filter-matching results and never pads rows. Xquik has paid plans and usage-based billing. Xquik is an independent third-party service. Not affiliated with X Corp. "Twitter" and "X" are trademarks of X Corp.

records.name: BrowserPair
records.tagline: Let AI Agents Use Your Browser
records.description: BrowserPair gives AI agents scoped access to the browser a user already uses while keeping signed-in sessions in the user’s Chrome profile.

records.name: OpusBar
records.tagline: Know which Claude Code or Codex session needs you
records.description: OpusBar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. A pixel cat shows your most urgent session, and a badge counts the ones waiting on you. It tracks 5-hour and weekly limits and what your tokens would cost. Nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: CupidWish — Gift a 3D Rose Forever Now!
records.tagline: Gift a 3D rose that never wilts with fast flower delivery.
records.description: CupidWish is an instant online flower delivery alternative for long-distance couples and last-minute surprises. Choose a 360° interactive WebGL 3D keepsake (Velvet Ruby Rose, Aurora White Rose, Neon Amethyst Rose, Sapphire Blue Rose, or Eternal Love Tree) inside an enchanted glass cloche. Write a personal dedication, record a 60-second voice message, and deliver it worldwide via email, private magic link, or printable QR code. Opens in any browser with no apps needed (£2.99 lifetime hosting).

records.name: Maktek Photo AI
records.tagline: Turn one selfie into a professional headshot
records.description: Most AI headshot tools change your face. Maktek keeps it. Upload one selfie, pick a look (LinkedIn, studio, corporate, creative, travel and more) and get a professional photo in about 20 seconds. Only what you choose changes: background, lighting and outfit. Your face, skin tone and hair stay yours. Built for LinkedIn, CVs, team pages and dating profiles. Download in high resolution. Your photos stay private and are never used for training. First photo free, no card needed.

records.name: Sarmaaya: PSX, Stocks & Forex
records.tagline: PSX, Stocks & Forex
records.description: Sarmaaya is a subscription-based investment portfolio tracker and wealth management app built for investors and traders in Pakistan. Follow the Pakistan Stock Exchange, manage every holding in one place, and use real-time alerts, intelligent insights, and powerful financial tools to track and grow your wealth. One investment app for everything you own: PSX stocks, mutual funds, ETFs, gold, forex, commodities, and cash. Unified Smart Dashboard See every holding you have in one smart view with...

records.name: Remember
records.tagline: Save useful links,pdf,images. Find them when you need them.
records.description: Remember helps you save useful links from Instagram, YouTube, and other apps in one place. Organize links into categories like Learning, Jobs, Products, Places, and Articles, and add context so you remember why you saved them. Built for people who find useful content every day and want an easier way to find it again. Remember is currently in beta testing, and I'm looking for early users to try it and share honest feedback.

records.name: Respawna
records.tagline: Gaming cafe management software
records.description: Respawna is gaming cafe management software for India, built for gaming cafes, game zones, lounges and esports centres. One browser screen runs the whole floor: live timers for PC, PS5, Xbox and VR, pricing by duration, day and player count, GST-ready invoices shared on WhatsApp, food and drinks POS, memberships and wallets, advance booking, tournaments and monthly profit and loss. Optional PC locking on Windows rigs. Plans from ₹299 a month, 14-day free trial, no card.

records.name: Life 20s
records.tagline: Daily quotes and calm for your 20s
records.description: Your 20s don't have to make sense yet. Life 20s sends one short quote at a time to your lock screen, home screen widgets and the app. Pick from 26 topics like career, money, friendship, overthinking and letting go, and choose up to ten quotes a day and the hours they arrive. Save favourites, share them, add your name so some quotes speak to you directly, and use the Calm Zone's breathing exercises and soundscapes when things feel heavy. Available on iPhone, iPad and Android.

records.name: GN Collage
records.tagline: Event photos to every guest with one QR code
records.description: GN Collage helps event photographers get photos to guests while the event is still on. Pick a Google Drive folder once and new photos fill the event gallery on their own. Guests scan one QR code, browse on their phone with no app or account, and use Face Search to see only the photos they are in. Every photo can carry your watermark. Face scans are not stored after a search, and galleries open only through the event's QR code or link. Works in 7 languages. Free to start, no credit card.

records.name: Sezica
records.tagline: Ultra-low-latency, high quality. Your musician app
records.description: Sezica is an all-in-one, low-latency audio collaboration platform and community hub designed specifically for musicians, producers, sound engineers, and music enthusiasts. It bridges the gap between high-performance real-time audio software and modern community platforms. Whether you want to rehearse with your band remotely, host live jam sessions across different cities, or find music collaborators in your area, Sezica delivers uncompromised audio quality paired with rich social features.

records.name: Scrollprint
records.tagline: Save any web page as one PDF, even long AI chats
records.description: Scrollprint saves any web page as one clean PDF in a click: the whole page, even long ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini chats, inboxes and dashboards that scroll inside the page, where screenshot tools stop. Capture it all, from here down, what is visible, or one area you select. Text stays searchable, links clickable. Save as Markdown, or edit, sign, redact, lock, merge and compress with built-in tools others sell in paid plans. Free, no account, no watermark, nothing uploaded.

records.name: Scriber Pro
records.tagline: Transcribe web videos and M3U8 streams on your Mac
records.description: Offline AI transcription for Mac. Paste a web page link, pick the video Scriber finds on it, and get the transcript, even on pages behind a Canvas or Kaltura sign-in. It's built into the app, not a browser extension: Scriber finds the M3U8 (HLS) stream behind the player and fetches it directly instead of recording it, so an 11-minute lecture took 47 seconds. Also batch files and YouTube links. Transcription runs locally with Whisper. $3.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: SOV Network
records.tagline: One real person, one account: money, messages and a vote
records.description: SOV Network (Self-Owned Value) is an open-source network where each real person holds exactly one account. You hold your own money, send end-to-end encrypted messages without a phone number, and get one vote on the network's rules. Enrolment is a palm scan and a live face check on your own phone. No photo is ever stored or sent. It is not a blockchain and there is nothing to buy. You join on an Android phone; Windows, macOS and Linux apps restore your wallet and run a node.

records.name: Cultivo
records.tagline: Turn one video or post into 8 platforms — in your voice
records.description: Cultivo turns one video, podcast, or article into native posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Reddit, and Medium — rewriting each one in your voice. Most repurposing tools paste the same paragraph everywhere. Cultivo re-expresses your idea in each platform's format, strips the robotic "AI tell" with its de-AI engine, and learns your word choice from past posts you upload. Paste a source, get 8 platform-native posts in minutes. Free for 3 adaptations a month.

records.name: SLA Guard Fulfillment Alerts for Shopify
records.tagline: Track paid orders against your fulfillment SLA hours.
records.description: SLA Guard helps merchants prevent fulfillment delays before they lead to customer complaints. It automatically monitors paid, unfulfilled orders against a configurable fulfillment SLA in hours and sends timely alerts when orders become overdue. Merchants can quickly identify delayed orders, prioritize fulfillment, and search and filter orders by SLA status, including cancelled orders, without manually checking Shopify. Simple setup and actionable alerts make fulfillment management easier.

records.name: Clicktoolset
records.tagline: Free Online Tools for Everyday Tasks
records.description: Clicktoolset brings together free online tools to make everyday digital tasks easier. Create color palettes, explore color combinations, format and analyze text, resize, convert, compress and crop images, and access useful design tools—all in one convenient place. Built for designers, developers, creators, and anyone who wants to get things done faster without switching between multiple websites. Less hassle. More done.

records.name: ChikuOS
records.tagline: Security, speed and SEO audits for AI-built sites
records.description: ChikuOS audits AI-built and hand-coded sites for security, speed and SEO. Flagship: $49 AI Site Audit in 24 hours (exposed keys, Supabase/Firebase access rules, headers, SEO, Core Web Vitals), plus $149 Audit + Fixes. Contact hello@chikuos.com.

records.name: first frame contracting
records.tagline: first frame contracting,
records.description: Every site in the UAE depends on equipment that works when it is needed. A cheap tape measure that stretches, a wrench that rounds off a bolt, or a late delivery can stall a crew for a day and push a schedule off track. That is why picking the right supplier matters as much as picking the right material.

records.name: My Store Locator
records.tagline: The store locator your customers actually use.
records.description: My Store Locator is a store locator and business locator for your website: keep your stores, partners or service points in one place and add a fast, privacy-friendly location search - in WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow or any other system.

records.name: Skyfall SKY-001
records.tagline: First world model for engineering: text or sketch to CAD
records.description: SKY-001 is Skyfall AI’s world model for engineering design. Give it a text prompt or a rough 2D sketch, and it plans step-by-step modeling operations for CAD and building design software, breaking a design into assemblies, parts and sketches. It can also explore many design variations in parallel. Skyfall claims 100x faster inference and 150x lower compute cost. Research preview, commercial launch targeted for early 2027.

records.name: CelerBook
records.tagline: Online booking and salon management, pay per appointment
records.description: CelerBook is booking and management software for salons, barbershops and other appointment-based businesses. Clients book 24/7 on your own booking page, and you manage your calendar, staff, services and revenue from one dashboard on web, iOS and Android. Automatic reminders help cut no-shows. No contract, no setup fee: your first 5 appointments each month are free, then €0.25 per appointment (capped at €30/month).

records.name: VeyDoc
records.tagline: Free PDF and image tools, right in your browser
records.description: Meet VeyDoc — a free, privacy-focused PDF and image toolkit that works directly in your browser. Compress PDFs with custom size targets, resize images, merge or split PDFs, convert images to PDF, export PDF pages as images, and extract text with OCR. Unlike tools that require file uploads or accounts, VeyDoc processes documents locally on your device. ✅ 7 essential tools ✅ No signup required ✅ Free to use ✅ Simple document workspace Less file fuss. More getting things done.

records.name: SignalZen
records.tagline: AI customer support in Slack, Microsoft Teams & Google Chat.
records.description: 🤖 SignalZen is AI-powered customer support that keeps your team in control. 🌐 Train AI on your website, files, and knowledge sources to answer customer questions automatically. 💬 When human help is needed, take over conversations directly from Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Google Chat. 🌍 Enjoy two-way translation and 📝 automatic conversation summaries. ⚡ Deliver faster support with less repetitive work.

records.name: Dagger One
records.tagline: Task & project management, Chat & Team collaboration with AI
records.description: Dagger One is task management, project management and team collaboration in one simple workspace. Plan projects in list, board or milestone view, write notes together, talk in team chat (channels, DMs, threads), set reminders, see everything on a calendar with Google Calendar sync, and ask Dagger AI about your own work. Turn any chat message into a task in one click. Works on the web and on Android. Free to start, no credit card needed.

records.name: RewindOS
records.tagline: A little corner of the internet, stuck in the '80s
records.description: Remember when computers felt like places to explore? RewindOS is a nostalgic, interactive desktop inspired by the internet and pop culture of the '80s and '90s. Tune into retro TV channels, listen to mixtapes, flip through vintage magazines and catalogs, play classic games, or hang out in the Analog Club. It's not another productivity tool or social feed. It's a little place on the web to get lost in for a while. Free to explore. No account required.

records.name: AI Stack Picker by AIBuildersUse
records.tagline: Pick your AI build stack in 30 seconds, with real prices
records.description: Answer 3 questions (what you're building, budget, skill level) and get one AI tool per layer (editor or builder, agent, backend, hosting) with the plan to buy and an estimated monthly cost. Prices checked by hand. Free, no signup, no paid placements.

records.name: Pharmacy Cabinet
records.tagline: The Medicine Drawer Gets a Brain: One Scan Tracker!
records.description: Ever bought medicine you already had or searched the whole house for the one you needed? 💊 Pharmacy Cabinet turns one scan/pic upload into an organized family medicine hub auto-filling Uses, Side effects, Photos, Location, expiry alerts, pill reminders & personalized notes. Securely synced across all your devices & available in 6 languages with medicine data across 13 countries 🌍. Use it on your browser or one-click Install it on any device. The App actually works when you need it the most!

records.name: solace-vera-observability
records.tagline: Make AI show its work before it acts
records.description: Solace Vera sits between an AI's decision and its action. Before anything happens, the AI has to justify its reasoning. Every decision creates its own audit record with a unique fingerprint, so the AI can't go back and change its answers. All records are compiled into one full record over time. If the justification doesn't hold up, the action comes to a full stop and goes to a human for review. Open source.

records.name: Build-Up: Tower Stacking Game
records.tagline: Physics balance & steady hands
records.description: Looks simple, until it wobbles. Build-Up is a physics-based tower stacking game about steady hands and calm focus. Drop each block, balance your tower, and reach the finish line without letting it fall. HOW IT PLAYS • Tap to drop blocks and line them up carefully • Real physics: every block shifts the balance • Clear each level by reaching the finish bar with a stable tower • Beat your best score with efficient stacking MADE TO FEEL GOOD • Glowing glass-style blocks and a calm, polished look...

records.name: Flatfight
records.tagline: Win Stripe disputes for $9 a win, never a percentage
records.description: Flatfight fights your Stripe chargebacks with the evidence Stripe can’t see: logins, usage and support messages from PostHog, Segment, Teachable, Intercom and more. Honest case scores, one-click submit. $9 per won dispute, not 30% like Smart Disputes.

records.name: Site Tools Box
records.tagline: 20+ free webmaster tools — no sign-up, no ads
records.description: Site Tools Box is a free online toolbox for webmasters, developers, and site owners. Features: • 20+ essential tools (Domain Checker, WHOIS, DNS, JSON Formatter, etc.) • No sign-ups, no limits • Privacy-focused: most tools run directly in your browser • Free forever

records.name: Free AI Gift Finder
records.tagline: AI gadget gifts matched to budget, phone & hidden fees
records.description: Most AI gift guides just list products. This one asks 5 quick questions — budget, who it’s for, their phone — and matches from 29 hand-picked AI gadgets, then flags every hidden subscription cost and phone-compatibility trap (no gifting an AirTag to an Android user) before you buy. Free, no signup, one top pick per quiz.

records.name: instaTrader
records.tagline: A modern trading desk for MetaTrader 4 and 5
records.description: instaTrader is a Windows program that puts a modern, clean interface on top of MetaTrader 4 and 5. Your account stays with your own broker, every order goes 1:1 to MetaTrader on your own PC. Risk-based order ticket, order assistant with break-even and trailing in R, footprint charts, several accounts side by side, trade copier, risk guard with prop-firm rules and InstaScript for your own strategies. 7 days free, no payment details.

records.name: Habenna
records.tagline: Habit tracker where one missed day doesn't reset you
records.description: A habit tracker with no streak counter. Each habit is a weekly rate, like 4 of 7, plus a monthly allowance of grace days, so one missed day never wipes your progress. Silent by default. Free with unlimited habits, a widget, a heatmap and CSV export.

records.name: GhostWriter AI
records.tagline: Rewrite AI-assisted drafts for clarity and tone
records.description: Revise drafts with Standard and Advanced rewriting and purpose settings. Try limited free access, then compare the output with your original. Review meaning, facts, and citations before publishing; no detector score is guaranteed.

records.name: Tabzooka
records.tagline: Turn any website into a level and blow it up
records.description: Tabzooka drops a jetpack hero onto the page you're on. Its headlines, images and cookie banners become platforms and targets: stand on them, shoot them, knock them down. 12 heroes, 84 weapons, 5 modes with bosses, and up to 6 players on one page. Close it and the page is back to normal.

records.name: R-btec-insights
records.tagline: AI-powered guide for BTEC specializations and career paths.
records.description: R-Btec Insights is an AI assistant driven by Gemini, designed to help students, parents, and educators explore BTEC programs. It provides deep insights into BTEC specializations, curriculum details, and future career opportunities to help users make informed educational decisions.

records.name: Upfit
records.tagline: Your iPhone counts your reps and coaches your form out loud
records.description: Upfit is an iPhone app that watches you through the front camera during a bodyweight workout at home. Stand the phone on the floor, step back, and it counts your reps out loud and tells you what to fix while you move, like "sit deeper into the squat". A rep that falls short isn’t counted. No equipment, no wearable. Pose tracking runs on the phone and camera video is never recorded or uploaded. Free to download with 3 days of full access, no card needed.

records.name: Keyword Cowboy Free Keyword Research...
records.tagline: Type a seed keyword and get the related searches people type
records.description: Free keyword research tool with no sign up. Get keyword ideas from Google, YouTube, Bing and Amazon with US search volume, cost per click and 12-month trends.

records.name: WinScraper Pro
records.tagline: Take the data off the page. On your own PC.
records.description: WinScraper Pro opens a real browser, walks through the results the way you would, and writes every row to a spreadsheet. Use 33 prebuilt robots to pull data out of popular websites and save it as CSV, JSON or XML. Runs on your own Windows PC. No cloud, no credits, no per-row fees. One payment.

records.name: Dondo
records.tagline: Product SEO, AI search & photos, reviewed before publishing
records.description: Dondo helps ecommerce teams improve product SEO, AI search readiness, and product photos. Connect a supported store or import a catalog file, then start with a free product scan. Choose products, prepare copy and photo drafts, and review and approve changes before publishing through supported platforms or exporting. Capabilities vary by platform. Team plans start at $12/month for 20 products; optional paid passes are available.

records.name: Isle Notch
records.tagline: A Dynamic Island for your Mac, with AI usage limits
records.description: Isle turns your MacBook notch into an island: music, a timer and Pomodoro, a file shelf with AirDrop, screenshots, and rings showing how much of your Claude Code, Codex and Cursor limits is left. Islet, the mascot, tells you when your AI is done. US$ 14.99 once.

records.name: ColdIQ Unlimited Data
records.tagline: Unlimited verified B2B data, right inside your AI agent
records.description: B2B data always meant choosing between volume and quality. ColdIQ gives you both: unlimited data across 500M+ people and companies plus a waterfall across 40+ providers for the hardest data to find. Just ask in Claude, Codex, Cursor or Slack, and the data comes back in your chat.

records.name: ForkBuild
records.tagline: Build in 3D in your browser. Remix anything. Own your work.
records.description: ForkBuild is a 3D building app in the browser. Snap bricks into houses, bridges and villages, fork any published build into your own copy, and share it with a link that carries the build itself. No account, no download; your work stays on your device.

records.name: Photo Cleaner: SwipeVault
records.tagline: Swipe your camera roll clean and lock away the rest
records.description: Swipe through your camera roll: left to bin, right to keep, up to favourite, down to hide in a PIN-locked vault that can snap anyone who guesses wrong. Nothing is deleted until you empty the bin. Free: 100 deletions a day. Pro: unlimited, plus the vault.

records.name: Katch the Ick - Recent Follows Extension
records.tagline: Chrome extension that catches recent follows on Instagram
records.description: Katch the Ick is a recent follows tracker for Instagram that lives in your browser. Open any public profile, take a snapshot, and from then on every new follow and new follower lands at the top with a timestamp, newest first. It auto-checks in the background and tracks as many profiles as you want. It runs on your own instagram.com session, so your password never touches us. Free preview, then a one-time $5 unlock. No subscription.

records.name: CapMonster Cloud MCP
records.tagline: Let your AI agent solve CAPTCHAs via MCP
records.description: CapMonster Cloud now supports MCP. Two official MCP servers let AI agents in Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients solve CAPTCHAs and drive the browser end to end: one talks to CapMonster Cloud, the other automates the browser with Patchright. Add them with one config file, ask your agent in plain language and approve each tool call. Supported CAPTCHA types are served live from our API, so the list never goes stale.

records.name: Boundary0
records.tagline: AI-Powered Knowledge Graph for Exploratory Spaced Repetition
records.description: Exploration and memorization have always been two separate activities. While traditional spaced repetition system helps us memorize, it takes a huge chunk of our time away from connecting and discovering new ideas. What if we could bring them both, exploration and memorization, together?

records.name: 17Quizz
records.tagline: Real-time quiz duels with friends, ranked by ELO

records.name: TMPlayer
records.tagline: Watch the videos in your Telegram chats on your TV
records.description: TMPlayer is a free, open source player for the videos already in your own Telegram chats. It plays while it downloads, so there is no waiting. Runs on Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones, Windows, macOS and Linux, in 21 languages. No ads, no extra account. Unofficial, not affiliated with Telegram.

records.name: FFmpeg Micro
records.tagline: One-call recipes for video editing and AI video generation

Turn product photos into a slideshow ad, add auto captions to a talking-head clip, create text-hook variants to A/B test, resize one video for TikTok, Reels and YouTube, or make a boomerang loop. 15 blueprints live, dozens more coming. No subscription required.

records.name: SSH Command
records.tagline: PuTTY + WinSCP in one modern app, with sudo that just works
records.description: Still running PuTTY for the shell and WinSCP for files? SSH Command puts terminal, SFTP/SCP, FTPS and an encrypted vault on one connection. Drag whole folders, sudo with one click, never overwrite a file by accident. Mac, Windows, Linux. Free for personal use.

records.name: Burrow for Mac
records.tagline: Your notch buddy knows when Claude Code or Codex needs you
records.description: Burrow puts a little 3D buddy in your MacBook's notch. The buddy shows what Claude Code or Codex is doing, and you can Allow or Deny from the notch. Hover for a small desk with your next meeting, a teleprompter, quick actions, music and more. Free to try for 7 days.

records.name: Calma
records.tagline: A gentle app blocker for iPhone
records.description: Calma rests the apps that pull you away (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) during the moments you want back: work, dinner, bedtime. No streaks, no scores, no account, no ads. Your rules stay on your iPhone. In 12 languages.

records.name: Tapden
records.tagline: Create single link of your bio
records.description: tapden.bio turns your social media bio into a beautiful, high-converting micro-landing page. Built for creators and brands, it lets you combine your links, embed rich content, collect leads, and track deep analytics in one place.

records.name: CCViewer
records.tagline: Read Claude Code sessions locally, export Markdown
records.description: CCViewer is a free, MIT-licensed browser viewer for saved Claude Code JSONL sessions.
