Files are processed locally. The hosted site loads Microsoft Clarity analytics and recordings; offline copies do not. No account or API key required.

records.name: Mobile Interview Room
records.tagline: Senior mobile interview prep, written from the hiring side
records.description: Interview prep for experienced iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native engineers. Each guide follows one round the way it runs: the question, a first answer, the follow-up that changes the constraint, and what the interviewer writes down. iOS and Android have books and interactive practice; Flutter and React Native have question banks, and each page says exactly what exists. Written by a staff mobile engineer with 500+ technical interviews from the hiring side.

records.name: QUAY
records.tagline: Freight quotes in a minute, from your phone
records.description: QUAY is an offline Android app for freight forwarders: chargeable weight for air (IATA 6000), express (5000 per piece) and LCL (W/M), buy costs per kg with minimums, margin or markup kept apart, and a client-ready PDF quote in about a minute. The PDF never shows your buy cost or margin. 15 currencies, no account, data stays on the phone. Free calculations and 3 PDFs; QUAY Pro for unlimited PDFs.

records.name: loweef
records.tagline: Get part of your crypto futures trading fees back in USDT
records.description: loweef returns part of the trading fees crypto futures traders pay, daily in USDT. Link your exchange UID - no deposit, no API keys, funds stay on the exchange. Works with AlphaX, BingX, MEXC and OKX (up to 65%, higher in the first 2 weeks). Also free: a payback calculator and the Crypto Futures Fee Index - VIP 0 taker/maker fees for 8 exchanges with check dates, official sources and a CSV download.

records.name: Money Browser
records.tagline: One button. Endless lesser-known money ideas.
records.description: Most money advice is the same ten tips. Money Browser deals the rest, one card at a time: unclaimed refunds, forgotten accounts, government programs people never claim, consumer rights and how money really works. Each card has real first steps, a payoff range and an effort rating, filtered by country. A second AI pass fact-checks every card. 20 ideas free, then $1 for lifetime access.

records.name: RankBotAI 2.0
records.tagline: AI fills the SEO fields Rank Math and Yoast only warn about
records.description: Rank Math and Yoast tell you a page has no meta description. RankBotAI writes it. The free WordPress plugin generates SEO titles, descriptions and unique focus keywords in each post's language and saves them where your SEO plugin expects them. Run it on one post from the editor, or on a whole WooCommerce catalog in the background at about 700 items an hour. Every change is snapshotted, so you can roll back one item or the whole site. Also builds llms.txt and Schema JSON-LD.

records.name: Cue
records.tagline: Turn rough thoughts into better AI prompts.
records.description: Cue turns rough thoughts into precise, context-aware prompts. It gives you unlimited prompts completely free, letting you bring your own key or use fast free models from OpenRouter without paying a dime. Instead of jumping between tabs, a floating orb sits right inside your AI interface, turning your raw thoughts into master prompts in one seamless click.

records.name: LamTik – Free TikTok Tools
records.tagline: Free TikTok and creator tools in one place
records.description: Free online LamTik offers free online tools for TikTok creators and digital content workflows. records.name: Meeting Meo
records.tagline: Live meeting notes and your next line, on Mac and phone
records.description: Meeting Meo listens to your video call on your Mac and shows three things as you talk: the gist of what the other side just said, a line you can say next, and plain explanations of new terms. Open it on your phone with a QR code and it becomes a prompter. When the call ends you get decisions, to-dos and a follow-up email draft. Transcription runs on your Mac, so audio never leaves it. The interface is Korean for now and it handles English and mixed meetings.

records.name: Taska
records.tagline: GTD you can keep going — see only what you can do now
records.description: A GTD task manager for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Capture with no name and no place, clarify one question at a time, then see only what you can do where you are right now. Alarms when you arrive, delegation with no read receipts, and no priorities to reset.

records.name: Collabrun
records.tagline: TikTok Shop affiliate outreach that you approve

Connect with one URL (remote MCP, OAuth) or pip install. Free tier, no card required.

records.name: Lexicodex

Open packs with no sign-up, duel other players on themes like "the biggest drama queen" (scored by an AI referee), trade with friends, bid at auctions and spin the nightly wheel. Designed for freelancers, web designers, studios, and agencies looking to present a polished before-and-after comparison or enhance their portfolio, as well as for creators who need a launch video (Product Hunt, social media, landing). No capture tool or editing software required.

For digital products, SaaS, services and e-commerce. One-time $49; most stations run on free plans.

records.name: Ściežka

records.name: Memoria
records.tagline: Your passwords. Your privacy. No cloud in plain text.

No subscriptions, no ads — just a personal project built around privacy and control.

records.name: StoreRoaster

You get a score out of 100 and a list of fixes ordered by impact, each with a concrete solution. Changed something? Hit "Rescan" and see if your score goes up. Reports in English and Spanish.

records.name: Snipster
records.tagline: Snipster — Turn long videos into clips that hit.

records.name: Aysogen

records.description: Make pictures, video, voices and music, and talk to the best AI models, in one place with one balance of credits.

records.name: ZoomFlow

records.name: Tesla Roadster AI Video Generator

records.tagline: Create natural Oropus 322+ voices with, 75+ languages, audio

records.name: Genexti

records.name: Lokstack

Git worktrees only separate the code; lanes also give each agent its own port and database. Plus every project, port and version on your Mac, why a project won't start, and servers agents left running. Free plan; lanes are Pro.

records.name: 64 Types
records.tagline: The 16 personality types, extended to 64 with real science
records.description: 64 Types rebuilds the 16 personality types on research-grade traits. Two letters the 16 types leave out, Emotional Stability and Honesty-Humility, make 64 types (e.g. INTJ-CM). Borderline scores are flagged, life-area pages cite research, and compatibility has no fake %. Free, ~8 min, no signup, in 33 languages. Optional $14.99 Deep Report.

records.name: NightOwl PDF
records.tagline: Privacy-first browser PDF editor, Hindi/Marathi OCR & DSC

Redaction removes the words, not just covers them. Private mode keeps every file on your computer. Most tools are free; plans are one-time payments.

records.name: saveas.md
records.tagline: The missing "Save As Markdown" button for Microsoft Word
records.description: Your boss demands adocx. Your documentation lives inmd. Here is the elegant treaty: saveas.md gives Microsoft Word the single command it should have shipped with 20 years ago. Every time you hit Cmd+S, Word saves yourdocx and instantly writes or updates a pristine GitHub Flavored Markdown (.md) file with clean pipe tables. 100% on-device, zero cloud uploads. Special Product Hunt Launch Deal: First 28 users get 50% OFF ($4 lifetime) with code PRODUCTHUNT

records.name: massCode 6
records.tagline: Snippets, notes and an HTTP client in one local workspace
records.description: massCode started as a snippet manager and is now a desktop workspace for developers. Keep code snippets, Markdown notes and API requests together and link them to each other. It includes a full HTTP client with GraphQL, WebSocket, scripts, tests and a runner, an AI assistant that uses your own provider or a local model, and offline search by meaning. Everything is stored as plain Markdown files on your disk. Free, open source, no account.

records.name: StakeNerds
records.tagline: Real math and live numbers for every Stake slot
records.description: StakeNerds reads the public provably-fair data behind every Stake Engine slot and turns it into tools for players: the real RTP, max-win odds and payout spread of 5,000+ games, live player counts on Stake.com and Stake.us, the biggest multipliers, new bonus codes, and a map of every slot by how it actually pays. Check your bet archive for real luck or see what an hour of play costs. Free, no sign-up, never predicts results. 18+.

records.name: Registro Course Bidding by EDTEX
records.tagline: Points-based course bidding for business and law schools
records.description: Registro Course Bidding allocates scarce seats in electives, study tours and exchange programmes through transparent bid-point rounds. Students spend a points budget across bidding and add/drop; the programme office sets capacities, prerequisites and credit rules, and tracks every round live, from demand estimation to waitlists. Used by more than 50,000 students at SDA Bocconi, ISB, IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, IIM Calcutta and other leading schools.

records.name: An ebook related to money flow guidence.
records.tagline: Master Your Money by Mastering Your Mind.”
records.description: The Psychology of Money – Short Description The Psychology of Money by Morgan Housel explores how our emotions, habits, and mindset influence financial decisions. Through real-life stories and practical lessons, it explains the importance of saving, patience, long-term thinking, and building wealth. The book teaches that financial success is not just about how much you know, but how you behave with money.

records.name: Job Hunter Agent
records.tagline: AI agent that finds fresh jobs across portals scored for you
records.description: Unlike job boards that show one site at a time, Job Hunter Agent sweeps Google Jobs, LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri and iimjobs at once, keeps only fresh postings (24h to 30d), removes duplicates, and scores every job 0-100 against your profile or CV. See matched and missing keywords, read the full job description, apply in 1 click, and get top matches on Telegram. Free, open source, and no setup or API keys needed.

records.name: Comseat Chairs for Events
records.tagline: Explore reliable event seating solutions from OMG Jump
records.description: Looking for durable Comseat chairs for events, parties, and rental businesses? OMG Jump offers Comseat plastic folding chairs featuring a sturdy steel tube frame, flexible polypropylene seating, and powder-coated metal parts. Designed for convenient storage and easy handling, these chairs are ideal for weddings, banquets, and gatherings.

records.name: BlackMusic (RavenSyntha)
records.tagline: Your music, your way. One player for everything.
records.description: A music player designed to deliver an unparalleled audio experience. BlackMusic brings your music together in one place, combining a rich music catalog with powerful playback capabilities, real-time audio effects, offline lyrics transcription, and intelligent library tools. Enjoy your local music, explore online sources, and experience your music your way.

records.name: True13
records.tagline: See the real 13 tags behind any Etsy listing.
records.description: True13 is a lightweight Chrome extension for Etsy sellers. One click pulls the authentic 13 tags from any competitor listing, and the keyword frequency analyzer shows which phrases the top sellers actually repeat. Unlike legacy extractors that scrape Etsy's page DOM and silently break on every Etsy frontend update — showing 0 tags or 250 junk words — True13 parses Etsy's structured listing data deterministically with Manifest V3, so your tag research is always built on real data.

records.name: SnapDance
records.tagline: Turn one selfie into an AI dance video
records.description: Pick a dance template, upload your selfie, and let AI make you dance. Creators can upload their own TikTok dance templates and earn when people use them. Event planners run it at weddings and parties as a live AI dance booth. Available on web, iOS and Android.

records.name: Wend Answer Hub
records.tagline: Daily LinkedIn Wend & Crossclimb answers, spoiler-free
records.description: Wend Answer Hub is a free daily companion for LinkedIn word games. Every day it publishes the newest Wend puzzle with a full solved board, word breakdown and spoiler-free reveal buttons, so players can take a nudge without the full solution. It also covers LinkedIn Crossclimb with every trivia clue and the complete answer ladder, keeps a searchable archive of past puzzles, and offers Wend Unlimited for endless browser practice. No account needed.

records.name: Leaddit
records.tagline: Find Reddit buyers and draft a reply worth posting
records.description: Find Reddit conversations asking for what you sell. Leaddit scores each match from 0–100 for buyer intent, explains the score, and drafts a helpful reply. You review, edit, and post it yourself. Your first scan and first reply are free, with no card needed.

records.name: Klient
records.tagline: WhatsApp-native client & invoice manager for freelancers
records.description: Klient helps freelancers and small businesses manage clients, create PDF invoices & quotes, and send instant WhatsApp reminders. Features full Arabic & French (RTL) support, payment tracking, and offline sync.

records.name: Bid Spotlight
records.tagline: Pay-to-rank leaderboard — every spot ships a promo video
records.description: A monthly pay-to-rank leaderboard for websites and apps. Every paid spot ships an auto-made 45-60 second promo video (9:16, yours to keep), and the top 3 are featured in the daily YouTube and X posts. Every placement is openly paid and labeled Sponsored; every listing is halal- and safety-screened before it can rank.

records.name: FLUX 3 Klein Free
records.tagline: Generate images with FLUX 3 Klein — free, no signup
records.description: FLUX 3 Klein Free is the fastest way to try Black Forest Labs' newest open-weight image model. The official demo runs right on the page — no account, no credit card, no queue-jumping upsells. Browse a curated prompt gallery, learn how to run the 5.6B model locally on 8GB of VRAM, and read plain-English answers to every "is it really free?" question.

records.name: NoteLyn AI
records.tagline: AI note taker for lectures, meetings and PDFs
records.description: NoteLyn AI is an AI note taker for students and professionals. Record a lecture or meeting, or import a PDF, YouTube video or link, and get structured notes, a full transcript, flashcards, quizzes and mind maps. On web, iOS and Android. Free to start.

records.name: DevCheck: CPU Info & Benchmark
records.tagline: Battery health, monitor & test
records.description: How fast is your iPhone or iPad? How healthy is it? DevCheck puts benchmarks, detailed hardware information, battery monitoring and hardware diagnostics in one powerful, easy-to-use app. BENCHMARKS: run full CPU, memory, storage and GPU benchmarks and compare your scores with hundreds of device models in the DevCheck rankings. DASHBOARD: live CPU load across cores, battery, thermal state, memory pressure and other stats. With PRO, track battery, network, storage and thermal history.

records.name: Launchify AI
records.tagline: Find the right business to start, with verified local facts
records.description: Tell it your skills, budget and country. Launchify AI compares several business ideas, then builds a full report: market, competitors, costs, a financial model and a 30-day launch plan. Every claim is labeled verified (with source), estimated or assumption. For the 6 GCC countries it adds Ground Truth: curated local facts like licence fees and who is allowed to run which business. $3 per report, Arabic & English.

records.name: DuoPane
records.tagline: Two-pane file manager for Mac that opens 5 GB logs instantly
records.description: Keyboard-first, Total Commander-style file manager for macOS: F3 viewer that opens multi-gigabyte logs instantly, F4 editor, SFTP/FTPS and iCloud Drive as ordinary panels, archives browsed like folders, a built-in REST client and iCloud sync of settings. Native Swift/AppKit, Apple Silicon + Intel, notarized, no Electron, no tracking. 14 days free, then a free tier; Personal $19/year or $59 lifetime.

records.name: Squad Dance
records.tagline: Make 3D characters dance and export vertical videos
records.description: Pick a dance and a squad of 3D characters performs it right in your browser. Style each dancer's outfit, height and look, choose the place, formation and camera, or drop in your own rigged GLB character (Mixamo, Ready Player Me, VRoid). Then export a 1080x1920 video for TikTok, Reels or Shorts, made on your own device. Free, nothing to install, no account needed.

records.name: Boundrix
records.tagline: Task-scoped execution boundaries AI agents and coding agents
records.description: Give autonomous AI agents enough authority to complete a task—without giving them unrestricted authority to act. Enforcing task-scoped, dynamic least-privilege execution boundaries across all autonomous agents—from AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin) to production agentic pipelines and bots (e.g. Grok bot, support triage bots, autonomous data/ops workflows).

records.name: Match me by Remotejobify
records.tagline: Your CV, matched to remote jobs you can actually get
records.description: Most "remote" jobs only hire in some countries. Match me reads your CV and picks open remote jobs you can apply for from where you live. Each one says why it fits you and shows the line from the post that proves it. It runs on Remotejobify, where every remote job is checked for who it's really open to. Free to try, no account needed, and we don't keep your CV.

records.name: Top Betting App Development Companies
records.tagline: Explore leading firms for sports betting app development.
records.description: Sports betting app development companies help businesses establish digital betting platforms aligned with their market goals and operational needs. FireBee, Addus, and Krytobees are names to consider when exploring development partners for sports betting software. Compare their development expertise, project experience, and business approach to identify a suitable partner for building and launching your sports betting application.

records.name: Code Specimen
records.tagline: Free CSS inspector, font finder and color picker for Chrome
records.description: Code Specimen is a free CSS inspector, font finder and color picker for Chrome and Firefox. Click its icon on any website, point at a heading, button or card, and its fonts, colors, spacing and CSS open in the side panel beside the page, each with a copy button. It lists every typeface and color on the page, exports the palette as CSS variables, a Tailwind config or JSON, checks text contrast against WCAG AA, and downloads the page's images. No account, analytics or ads.

records.name: Costura
records.tagline: Self-hosted AI spend attribution by person and API key
records.description: Costura turns every AI bill into one ledger: who spent what, why it moved, and which key has no owner. Connect read-only billing keys for Anthropic, Claude.ai, OpenAI, Codex, OpenRouter, Cursor and GitHub Copilot (experimental). Open source, self-hosted, provider keys stay encrypted on your infrastructure, no telemetry. A live demo is available.

records.name: Wick
records.tagline: Light a candle, name one intention, and do deep work
records.description: Wick turns focus into a ritual. Light a candle, name one honest intention, and start a Pomodoro, Flowtime or plain timer while a small flame burns beside you; put the phone face down and it keeps the time. Turn on the Shield to keep distracting apps behind a gentle wall, with an exit always available. Wick only counts the focus you really gave, so your history reflects real work, not padded numbers.

records.name: HList
records.tagline: AI tools directory with China-access data & MCP endpoint
records.description: HList: a 4-language (EN/中文/日本語/한국어) directory of 386+ AI tools, updated daily. What makes it different: (1) China-accessibility data for every tool (ok/unstable/blocked/unknown) — the field no other directory publishes; (2) AI-agent native exits: llms.txt, tools.json API, and a public MCP server your agent can call with no key; (3) honest, not affiliate — no sponsored slots, pricing verified against official pages. Every listing goes through a daily verification gate.

records.name: tfm
records.tagline: A modern GUI like terminal file manager
records.description: tfm brings the comfort of a GUI file manager straight into your terminal. Handle your files the familiar way, click through folders, drag files where you want them, preview photos and videos, and undo mistakes etc, all without leaving the terminal. It makes managing files feel effortless. Fast, intuitive, and fully customizable,

records.name: Vibe Talk
records.tagline: Free browser-based random chat & video call alternative
records.description: Vibe Talk is a free browser-based platform for random chat, text chat, video calls, groups, and meeting new people online. Built as a clean, respectful, and female-friendly Omegle alternative, it allows users to meet strangers globally instantly. No app downloads, no registrations, and zero login required—just open and start chatting!

records.name: DunkSim
records.tagline: Simulate any NBA game. Public accuracy record.
records.description: Run any NBA matchup — tonight's game, a 1998 replay, or two eras that never met — through a possession-level Monte Carlo engine with your insights. Win probabilities, projected scores, player projections. Accuracy measured on 1,230 real games and published. Web, iOS, Android.

records.name: NoSignPDF
records.tagline: 100% Free Local PDF Tools. No Sign-Up, No Server Uploads
records.description: NoSignPDF is a privacy-first, web-based PDF utility that runs entirely in your local browser. While alternatives force you to upload sensitive contracts and invoices to cloud servers, NoSignPDF processes everything directly on your device's RAM using WebAssembly. It is 100% free, GDPR-compliant, and features no watermarks, no file-size limits, and absolutely no registration. Features include merging, filling forms, page removal, and built-in metadata stripping for maximum security.

records.name: College Design Architect in India
records.tagline: college design architect in India
records.description: IMK Architects delivers thoughtful college architecture with functional academic spaces, efficient campus planning, and sustainable design solutions.

records.name: BetterPPT
records.tagline: Beautify your existing PowerPoint, slide by slide.
records.description: BetterPPT is an AI design agent for decks you've already written. Upload apptx and it redesigns each slide individually — layout, hierarchy, imagery and photo treatment — with three text modes: keep every word, light editing, or restructuring. You get an editable PowerPoint plus an HD image version. See your first 3 slides redesigned after a $2.90 refundable deposit; pay $39 per deck only when you download.

records.name: SpringDesk
records.tagline: Your Windows 11 desktop, sorted
records.description: Translucent boxes for your desktop icons that snap into place. New files sort themselves by type, press Space to preview anything, and type on the desktop to find it. One-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: 1PropertyMarket
records.tagline: AI receptionist & outbound AI calling for real estate
records.description: Real estate teams lose deals to voicemail. 1PropertyMarket answers every call 24/7 with an AI receptionist in your branding — and its done-for-you outbound AI calls your leads back. Live proof: 609 calls, 133 warm transfers, zero missed. From $25/mo.

records.name: VOLIXTA Database Manager for WordPress
records.tagline: Manage your WordPress database safely, all in one place
records.description: Meet VOLIXTA Database Manager, a free, open-source WordPress plugin that makes database management easier, safer, and more intuitive. Explore and edit database tables, manage WordPress options, clean unnecessary data, and optimize your database from one modern dashboard. Preview cleanup operations, schedule maintenance, detect orphaned data, and protect sensitive information with built-in safeguards. Everything you need to manage your WordPress database, all in one place.

records.name: Wink & Woobble
records.tagline: games, pngtuber, animation
records.description: Animate PNG characters for PNGTubers and visual novels with layers, expressions, motion presets and transparent exports.

records.name: Chorus
records.tagline: All AI, One Place
records.description: Chat across models with your own API keys, compare replies, and keep projects, notes, and prompts together. Android app; verified Chorus account and provider key required for cloud AI. Provider costs and limits apply; sponsored cards support free use.

records.name: Studyle
records.tagline: Study library management app for abhyasikas & study halls
records.description: Studyle is a study library management app built for modern self-study libraries, reading rooms, and abhyasikas in India. Unlike traditional book-cataloging software, Studyle automates workspace tracking, shift management, and digital desk allocation.Features:• Interactive visual seat mapping & shift allocation • QR & location-verified attendance check-in • Automated fees, dues tracking & digital receipts Download our Android app on the Google Play Store for a 30-day free trial!

records.name: Mnemorenna: Memory Games
records.tagline: Memory games without cards, ads or internet
records.description: Mnemorenna is a set of small memory games with no cards to flip. Each game shows you something, hides it and asks you to bring it back: a string of characters, a path across the field, a list of words, the order of tiles. Difficulty follows you: get it right and the next round is one step longer, miss and it is one step shorter. No ads, no account, no internet: the app asks for no permissions at all. Every game is open from the first launch.

records.name: SynerSpice - Matchmaker
records.tagline: Model any two herbs, graded by confidence
records.description: Pick any two herbs and see how they actually interact — amplify, gate, or cancel out — graded by confidence and backed by real citations. Free to browse, native on iPhone/iPad/Mac. SynerSpice models each herb as a set of biological "connectors" — the channels, enzymes, and pathways its active compound acts on. Educational, not medical advice.

records.name: ARSA AI Box
records.tagline: Edge AI video analytics for the CCTV you already own
records.description: A sealed edge box that plugs into your existing IP cameras (ONVIF/RTSP) and runs AI on site: PPE and hazard-zone alerts, footfall and conversion, vehicle counts, screen audiences. Runs offline; video stays on your network. Up to 3 or 25 cameras.

records.name: Nitpick
records.tagline: Agent-first feedback for iOS and Android apps.
records.description: I'd get a negative App Store review with no idea what had gone wrong and no proper way to log the problem. I built Nitpick, agent-first feedback for iOS and Android apps. Your users point at an element and leave a comment. A marked screenshot shows your coding agent what to fix. It finds the element in the code and fixes it, so you barely have to handle the feedback yourself.

records.name: CheckATS
records.tagline: Free ATS resume checker that shows its work
records.description: Paste your resume and a job description. CheckATS shows which JD keywords you're missing, scores the match with a formula printed on the page, and can rewrite it with AI. Free, no signup.

records.name: Systron Tools
records.tagline: Free developer, webmaster, server admin & office tools
records.description: Systron Tools is a free, browser-based toolkit for developers, webmasters, server admins and office work. A privacy-first approach keeps processing local in many tools, while live diagnostics use network requests. Check DNS, SSL and email security; convert server configs; build Docker stacks and backup scripts; and handle SEO, images, PDFs and invoices. Practical tools with copy-ready outputs—no registration or installation.

records.name: AiTraderView
records.tagline: Free crypto charts, screener and portfolio in one web app
records.description: AiTraderView combines a crypto charting cockpit (50+ indicators, liquidation heatmap), a 30+ coin screener and a portfolio tracker in one free web app. Available in 59 languages. Analysis only, no trade execution.

records.name: Retrn · Personal CRM
records.tagline: Never lose track of anyone you meet.
records.description: Retrn exists to turn the people you meet into relationships you actually keep. In a world where networking has become transactional — a LinkedIn add, a forgotten follow-up, a business card that never gets a second look — Retrn is built to slow that down. We help you remember not just who someone is, but how you met them, what mattered to them, and when it's time to reach out again — so that every connection has the chance to become something real, not just another name in a database.

records.name: avanot Beta
records.tagline: Send an AI avatar to your meetings. Get the notes via email
records.description: Stop attending meetings. Send your AI representative instead. Avanot sends an AI avatar to your Zoom, Teams or Google Meet calls. It joins as you, speaks in a voice you choose, and appearance depends on your choice a list of avatars or simply clone yourself. draws on the notes you prepare, and writes up what happened, and send the summary to your email.

records.name: Lefover
records.tagline: Know what's left. Spend what's right
records.description: Most money apps show your bank balance and a budget to keep up with. Lefover shows one figure: what’s safe to spend. You tell it how often you receive money and when the next day is. It holds back the bills due before then, what your budgets still cover and what you set aside for goals, and shows what is left. Arithmetic, not a prediction: nothing is guessed. Bills found from your transactions. Share a bill with people who bank elsewhere. Ask Nemo, an AI that never does the math.

records.name: Free Connect Four Game
records.tagline: Four in a row vs a friend or 3 AI levels. Free, no signup
records.description: The classic Connect Four, right in your browser. You can play a friend on the same device, or challenge the computer on Easy, Medium or Hard. Unlike most online versions, it has no ads in the way, no app download and no signup. Click a column or use keys 1-7 to drop a disc, press U to undo and N to start a new game. A move counter and stats track wins for each player, draws and total games. It loads fast and works on desktop and mobile.

records.name: ShuttleScience
records.tagline: Your Game. Your Science. Your Edge.
records.description: ShuttleScience is your all-in-one badminton training companion. Explore 200+ exercises, shots, footwork drills, 76 ready-made workouts, coaching articles, and a badminton handbook. Build better technique, improve movement, develop fitness, and play smarter—from learning the fundamentals to sharpening competitive skills.

records.name: Subcanvas
records.tagline: Whiteboards inside whiteboards, with notes in every box
records.description: Paste a public GitHub repository, or connect GitHub for private ones, and Subcanvas draws a box for each main folder, with that folder's README inside. Double-click any box or arrow to open the whiteboard or page inside it, as deep as you need. Add asubcanvas file to say what connects to what, put a public diagram in your README, or let an AI agent like Claude Code edit it with you. It works for class notes and plans too. Open source, and free for one person; Pro is $5 per editor a month.

records.name: Weekly Anime
records.tagline: Weekly anime release calendar with IMDb & MAL ratings
records.description: I built Weekly Anime because I wanted one simple page showing which anime episodes come out each day of the week, with ratings next to them so I can decide what to watch. It shows the weekly schedule of airing anime with IMDb and MyAnimeList ratings, keeps an archive of past weeks, and is multilingual. It's free, no signup, a side project made with Next.js.

records.name: $700 Gift Card: Free Giveaway End Oct 31
records.tagline: Win a $700 Gift Card: Free Giveaway Ends Oct 31
records.description: Enter our free giveaway for a chance to win a $700 gift card to spend on anything. No purchase needed. Takes a minute. Ends October 31, 2026.

records.name: AdventurePath
records.tagline: Turn every walk into an RPG adventure
records.description: AdventurePath is a privacy-first walking RPG for iPhone. Real steps, distance, cycling, and swimming from Apple Health move your hero through handcrafted fantasy, sci-fi, and post-apocalyptic campaigns. Choose a 15–60 minute Adventure Walk, hear narrated story beats, complete quests, meet companions, craft gear, and build your Base Camp. No ads, accounts, social feed, or analytics SDKs; Health data stays on device.

records.name: CosmiRoNex AI
records.tagline: AI sales & support agents grounded in your business content
records.description: CosmiRoNex AI helps businesses turn their product, service and policy content into AI-powered sales and support experiences. Deploy across websites and QR touchpoints with chat and voice to help customers discover products, get instant answers and submit enquiries. Each assistant is grounded in the business’s own knowledge, so responses stay relevant and brand-specific.

records.name: Free Subnet Calculator
records.tagline: IPv4/IPv6 subnets, VLSM and binary view. Free, private
records.description: Most subnet calculators only show the basics. This one gives you everything from one IP and mask: network, broadcast, host range, usable hosts, wildcard mask, class, IP type, reverse DNS, and a binary breakdown of network vs host bits. It also includes a Subnet Divider, a VLSM Planner, an IP-in-subnet checker and an IPv6 prefix calculator. Use the slider or quick presets, and copy all results in one click. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded. No signup.

records.name: Use This Skill
records.tagline: See what a skill does, and scan it, before you install it
records.description: A directory of 1,409 agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Every skill is scanned for the nine patterns a skill should never need, with the file and line shown. Seventeen are proven: the same brief run with and without the skill, three times each, all results open. Run the same scan on your own repo in one command or on every pull request, free for public repos. Teams scan private repos for $29 a month. A free MCP connector lets your agent search, check and install from the chat.

records.name: hologram
records.tagline: Put your teammates in any picture, right inside Slack
records.description: A Slack app. Type /hologram, mention a teammate and say the scene; about fifteen seconds later you get two pictures of them, only for you, and send the better one to the channel.

records.name: Accent Letters for Chrome
records.tagline: Every accented letter, one click away, in your toolbar
records.description: Typing é in a browser means leaving whatever you were doing — a search, a copy-paste site, Character Map. Accent Letters is a free Chrome extension. 682 accented letters in your toolbar, A to Z, each with its Alt code, keyboard shortcut and HTML entity. Click one and it is on your clipboard. Search by the letter itself, by its Unicode name, by language, or in plain words: "two dots", "squiggle", "hat". Works in Brave, Arc and Opera too. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: The Galloway Prediction Index
records.tagline: We graded Scott Galloway's predictions — 1,124 and counting.
records.description: Scott Galloway makes bold calls every week on Pivot. We pulled 1,124 of them from 751 episodes going back to 2018 and graded each one against what actually happened. His hit rate so far: 47%. AI finds each prediction in the transcript, keeps the exact clip, researches the outcome on the web, and cites its sources. Open predictions are rechecked as events unfold, so new verdicts land within days.

records.name: Productivo
records.tagline: The all-in-one eBay selling tool
records.description: Run your eBay business from one workspace: research products, publish listings in bulk, improve them with AI, reprice within your limits, and track orders and profit. Import your existing listings whether you dropship, buy wholesale or sell your own stock. Connect ChatGPT or Claude to ask questions about your store and take action with your permission.

records.name: TradeBo
records.tagline: Swing trading on autopilot for the stocks you already own
records.description: TradeBo runs a buy-low, sell-high ladder on stocks you already hold in Robinhood or Interactive Brokers: small buys as the price dips, small sells as it rises. What's different: a desktop agent on your computer holds the broker session and places every order. Your broker login never reaches our servers. Try it first: backtest any stock over the past year for free, no account needed, and see how it compares with just holding.

records.name: BeeForm
records.tagline: Forms that look like your brand, not like a form
records.description: Beeform is a free form builder for creators who want forms that look like their brand, not like a form. Pick from colorful, creative themes or design your own, then save and reuse them across every form. Perfect for newsletter creators, artists, and small online shops. Start free with a generous plan and export responses to Google Sheets or Excel. Built by an indie maker who started with a Google Forms add-on. Would love your feedback!

records.name: call4me
records.tagline: Give your AI agent a phone that calls and answers
records.description: Give your AI agent a phone. call4me handles outbound business calls and inbound calls with your standing instructions, then returns the result and transcript. Connect through MCP or REST, with prepaid credits or x402 wallet payments.

records.name: Gift Card
records.tagline: "Unlock the Joy of Gifting: Big Savings on Every Gift Card!"
records.description: "Unlock the Joy of Gifting: Big Savings on Every Gift Card!" 🎁✨ To give you the perfect fit for your campaign, here are a few more tagline options broken down by vibe: Catchy & Promotional (Great for sales): • "Small Card, Big Rewards—Grab Your Gift Card Offer Today!" • "Give the Gift of Choice and Get More for Less!" • "Don't Miss Out: Bonus Value on All Gift Cards. Full Link: https://surl.li/wknamvk

records.name: Docu-Flowai
records.tagline: Fast, offline-first developer suite to format JSON & ZIPs
records.description: Hey everyone, I got tired of bookmarking five different sites just to clean up Markdown sheets, analyze workspace ZIP assets, or handle JSON structures while keeping my data private. I built Docu-Flow AI to solve this. It's completely local, lightweight, and lives right in your tab. Try it out here: https://docu-flowai.netlify.app Would love your raw feedback on the layout or any tools you want added!

records.name: Crisp
records.tagline: Fast, calm habit tracking
records.description: Crisp is a habit tracker built for one job: show you what’s due today, let you check it off in a tap, and get out of your way. No social feed, no points economy, no pressure to “keep a streak or lose everything.” Just clarity. I built Crisp because most habit apps slowly turn into a second social network or a game I didn’t ask to play. I wanted something that feels as fast as marking a paper list — but lives on my phone, respects offline life, and doesn’t require an account to start.

records.name: Langegg
records.tagline: Learn any language with AI, TTS, and YouTube — 87 languages
records.description: Langegg supports 87 languages with AI word lookups, text-to-speech, and YouTube transcript integration. Learn vocabulary from real videos, explore image galleries, and contribute to a community dictionary. Built by a solo developer. Free to use, no install needed. AI features have a daily limit per user (beta).

records.name: airys
records.tagline: Answer every support question once. Never again.
records.description: Written once, answered forever. You write the questions you keep answering as short help articles, in plain language, like an email. Point your support address at airys and it starts replying right away. Website chat is one line of code later, and WhatsApp is on the way. There's no training, no flow builder and no technical skills needed. Setup takes an afternoon.

records.name: PDFBetter
records.tagline: The AI-native PDF editor. Just tell it what to do.
records.description: PDFBetter is an AI-native PDF editor, not an add-on: just tell it what to do. Change text, fill a form with your info, redact, translate or merge files from one prompt, then review every change before it's saved. Answers cite the page they came from. Signed PDFs are sealed and time-stamped. Agents connect through MCP (Claude Code, Cursor), apps through Zapier and Make. On the web, Mac, Windows, iPhone and iPad, with a real free plan: no card, no end date, no watermark.

records.name: WebIntake
records.tagline: Ask Once, Get Everything.
records.description: WebIntake helps freelance web designers and developers collect everything they need to start a client project. Create a request for files, written answers, links, dates, and other project details, then share one link with your client. Clients can respond without creating an account and return later to finish. Track what has arrived and what is still missing from one dashboard. Reuse ready-made templates for future projects, set due dates & download uploads together with a summary of the answers.

records.name: All Roofing Calculators
records.tagline: 18 free roofing calculators for area, pitch & cost
records.description: All Roofing Calculators is a free set of 18 roofing and siding calculators for homeowners, DIYers and contractors. Estimate roof replacement and inspection costs, measure roof area and pitch, size rafters and trusses, and work out shingles, metal, tiles, sheathing, vents, gutters and siding. No sign-up, works in the browser, and every tool explains its formula step by step.

records.name: ZeraOS
records.tagline: Autonomous Agentic AI Operating System and Sovereign
records.description: ZeraOS is an Autonomous Agentic AI Operating System for secure, real-time enterprise workflows. Built with a robust web-based sandbox editor, it features zero-trust multi-tenancy, multi-agent AI swarms with automated Saga rollbacks for transactional stability, and strict financial telemetry governance. Designed specifically to overcome reliability roadblocks in FinTech and high-stakes SaaS operations, ZeraOS bridges the gap between generic AI orchestration and mission-critical automation.

records.name: iamworking
records.tagline: Look busy with realistic AI chat screens
records.description: Free tool that makes your screen look like you're hard at work with AI. Choose from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Doubao, or a hacker terminal style. Questions, thinking, and streamed answers play on loop automatically. You can also type real messages to keep the act going. Includes scenes for coding, office work, slides, spreadsheets, and more. Fullscreen mode, no account needed, and nothing is sent to any AI model. Open it and instantly look busy.

records.name: Cashflow by ATMLAB
records.tagline: Forecast balances and cash gaps on any future date
records.description: Cashflow models how money moves between your accounts: salary, rent, savings, mortgage. Each flow has its own schedule. Run the simulation to see balances, profit, cash gaps and goals on any date years ahead, adjusted for inflation or in another currency. Free.

records.name: Palworld Breeding Calculator
records.tagline: Find breeding combos, parents, and offspring in Palworld
records.description: Palworld Breeding Calculator is an online tool designed to help Palworld players discover breeding combinations and plan their perfect Pal teams. With an easy-to-use interface, players can explore breeding possibilities, find the right parents for their desired Pals, and discover potential offspring. Key Features Find Child Find Parents Chain Breeder Pal Information Breeding Combinations this tool helps make breeding research and planning easier.

records.name: SwitchMyFile
records.tagline: The file converter that never sees your files.
records.description: SwitchMyFile converts PDFs, images, audio and more right in your browser. Files never leave your device, no sign-up, no limits, no ads. Free forever. 31 conversions and tools so far, from PDF merge to EXIF stripping and QR codes.

records.name: My Clip
records.tagline: Turn photos from every age into one AI growing up video
records.description: Turn photos from different ages into a seamless AI growing-up video. Create your first transition free with 2 photos. No editing skills required.

records.name: SPOE | Private Vibe Coding AI
records.tagline: Speak. Prompt. Own. Export.
records.description: Speak Describe an app and SPOE builds a real one: Next.js, Fastify and Postgres, with the pages, the database and a protected owner's page from the first build. Pick the model that writes it (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6, Gemini or a private one), and a second AI from another family checks every change. Change the whole look in one click. Export it signed: one command proves the code is yours and runs anywhere with docker compose up. Free daily credits, plans from US$15.

records.name: DVLA Check Code
records.tagline: Get, Share & Check Your Driving Licence
records.description: Get a DVLA check code, share it with someone who needs your licence details, or check someone else's driving licence.

records.name: DejaVu
records.tagline: A private screen memory for Mac. Nothing leaves your Mac.
records.description: Type a word, find the moment you saw it. DejaVu remembers what was on your screen and reads its text on-device. No cloud, no account, no audio, no keystrokes. Encrypted, with Touch ID to look back. Free to start; Pro is a one-time purchase.

records.name: Amplistay
records.tagline: Your rental property website and bookings
records.description: Amplistay is the website of a vacation rental, built to take payments directly from guests without the Airbnb or Booking commission and to manage the bookings from every channel in one dashboard. It takes about 10 minutes to set up, no coding needed. Simpler and cheaper than channel managers in the market, and customized support to get your vacation rental going!

records.name: Lumo AI Translation for WPML
records.tagline: Translate WordPress in WPML with your choice of AI
records.description: Translate WordPress posts, products, strings and Elementor templates inside WPML. Choose OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek or Mistral with your own API key. Custom instructions preserve brand terms and tone; background queues support retry and resume. Re-translate a title, selected content or a batch. Independent paid add-on by LumoWP. WPML is required; AI usage is billed separately by your provider.

records.name: CropShrink
records.tagline: Crop, resize & compress images fast, right in your browser
records.description: CropShrink crops, resizes and compresses images in one place, entirely in your browser. FAST. And nothing gets uploaded. What Sqoosh doesn't do: - Crop (freeform or fixed aspect ratios) - Compress to a target size (e.g. under 100 KB) - Presets for 1080x1080, 1200x630, YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn - Strip EXIF/GPS data and show what the file contained Exports WebP, AVIF, JPEG and PNG with a live before/after preview. Free, no signup, no watermark.

records.name: Ribbit
records.tagline: Describe it. Get a working form in minutes.
records.description: Write one sentence and get a working form: AI drafts the questions, you edit them by hand, then share one link. Unlimited forms and responses on the free plan.

records.name: Lumo Pro Toolkit
records.tagline: Build dynamic WordPress sites with Elementor Free
records.description: Build headers, footers, dynamic listings, forms, popups and WooCommerce templates with Elementor Free. Lumo Pro Toolkit combines theme building, custom post types, meta fields, dynamic tags and 28 optional widgets in one modular WordPress plugin. Enable only the tools your project needs. A paid, independent LumoWP add-on; not affiliated with Elementor.

records.name: SEO By TechWebster
records.tagline: Catch SEO and sharing issues before you launch
records.description: A free, no-signup SEO analyzer for developers, founders and marketers. Check a public URL for metadata, indexing directives, canonicals, social cards, discovery files, headings, image alt text and JSON-LD. Get a scored report with suggested fixes. Use it before launch and rescan after changes. Scores highlight checks to review; they do not guarantee indexing or rankings.

records.name: Refract
records.tagline: Rewrite what you type for the app you’re in
records.description: Refract rewrites text where you already type. Tap the prism to polish an email, message or AI prompt, then review and send. Free for macOS, Windows and Linux. Use your ChatGPT plan, an API key or a local model; provider limits apply.

records.name: Mixtura
records.tagline: Create lyrics and Suno-ready music prompts with AI
records.description: Mixtura turns your ideas into song titles, lyrics, and Suno-ready Style prompts. Choose your genre, mood, tempo, and language, or start from 15 editable templates. Create in English, Portuguese, or Spanish, save and refine your work, and connect compatible AI agents through MCP and a dedicated skill. Audio generation happens separately in Suno.

records.name: Ghost Filter
records.tagline: Add ghosts and spooky effects to videos in your browser
records.description: Turn everyday clips into ghost videos in your browser. Add animated ghosts, motion trails, CRT, glitch, and film effects. Your source videos stay on your device. Create and preview for free; unlock watermark-free exports with a one-time Pro purchase. No subscription or account required. Product Hunt offer: $7.99 (normally $9.99) at ghostfilter.app/?offer=producthunt.

records.name: The Lost Pint
records.tagline: Comedy point-and-click adventure about a stolen beer recipe
records.description: A comedy point-and-click adventure about a stolen beer recipe, two old friends, and the small brewery where everybody drinks for free. The free demo is the first chapter: fifteen minutes in the brewery with Yiannos, Giorgos and a key that isn’t where it should be. Built solo in about 60 hours with Unity, PowerQuest, Claude Code and a custom AI Asset Studio. Windows, macOS and Linux.

records.name: Things To Do Near Me
records.tagline: An AI local guide that finds things to do near you, now
records.description: Things To Do Near Me is an AI guide for the moment you think "what should we do right now?". Tell it what you're in the mood for and where you are, and it searches the web for real, currently open places nearby: a short list with why each is worth it, price level, today's hours and a map link. One-tap ideas for open now, tonight, with kids, rainy day and top sights. Works in 9 languages. Free to try, no sign-up.

records.name: Gallerya
records.tagline: Back up your iPhone photos to a USB-C drive you own
records.description: Gallerya copies only what's new from your iPhone or iPad photo library onto any USB-C drive, checks every file with SHA-256, and browses the drive as a gallery. No iCloud, no account, no server. The archive is plain dated folders any computer can open. New in 1.1: Trips finds your past trips on the phone, without sending any location anywhere. Free for 200 items, then $4.99 once.

records.name: Behavly 2.0
records.tagline: Your users act. Your agents follow up.
records.description: Behavly 2.0 puts AI agents on your follow-up emails. One snippet shows what each person does on your site. Describe the follow-up in plain words and Behavly lays out the path: who enters, the emails, the waits and the branches. It finds patterns like “viewed pricing, didn’t upgrade”, starts paths from product events like a failed payment, and writes every email from what that person did. Heatmaps, a reply inbox with drafted answers, and Claude and ChatGPT access are built in.

records.name: FOUNDRY
records.tagline: AI launch drafts that keep your facts and your final click
records.description: A desktop launch workspace: enter your facts once, get research and a package per channel (Gumroad, Product Hunt, LinkedIn…), approve each one, then hand it to ChatGPT or Claude in Chrome to fill the page. It stops before Publish. Bring your own AI. Windows 10/11; Mac with Apple Silicon, macOS 15+. Free trial on a sample product; $49 launch price until Nov 15, then $79, one-time.

records.name: Art Licence Studio
records.tagline: art, marketplace, comission, licence,
records.description: Art Licence Studio is a UK and US marketplace where buyers commission independent artists or license ready-made art. Every deal records usage, territory, term and exclusivity, and buyers get a licence record and receipt. Artists set their own terms and keep copyright. Payments run through Stripe. Free to join: sellers pay 15% commission, or 7.5% with ALS Pro, payment processing included.

records.name: Aniq UI Bundle: 10 Next.js Templates
records.tagline: 10 Next.js templates with APIs, dashboards and Arabic RTL
records.description: Ten Next.js 16 templates in one purchase. Seven are full-stack apps with NestJS APIs: e-commerce, an LMS with live classes, real estate, restaurant ordering, vacation rental, fitness coaching and an admin dashboard with an AI assistant. Plus a financial dashboard and two landing pages. All ten ship in English and Arabic with right-to-left layouts, with docs, a live demo, free updates and a licence for unlimited client projects.

records.name: OptionsHub
records.tagline: US & crypto options analytics, strategies and portfolio risk
records.description: Analyze US and crypto options in one workspace. Compare implied and realized volatility, skew and modeled dealer positioning; build multi-leg strategies and explore P&L scenarios; track positions, Greeks and portfolio risk. Social Studio turns market snapshots into shareable visuals. Built for understanding options—not placing trades or promising returns.

records.name: Chiptune
records.tagline: Write 8-bit video game music on iPhone and iPad
records.description: Chiptune is a simple app for writing songs that sound like old NES games. Tap notes into a grid using the same four sounds the NES had, then chain the loops into a song. Export a WAV that loops cleanly for your game, video or sampler, or a MIDI file for your music app. Every sound is made live, the way the console made it. No ads, no account, and it's open source on GitHub.

records.name: Puzzory - Jigsaw Puzzle Maker
records.tagline: Turn your own photos into custom, offline jigsaw puzzles
records.description: Puzzory turns your own photos into custom jigsaw puzzles. Pick any picture from your gallery, choose your grid size from 3x3 up to 15x15, and start solving. It features an optional Rotation Mode for extreme difficulty, 31 achievements, and daily streaks. Built for total privacy, all processing happens locally—your photos are never uploaded to any server, making the game 100% secure and fully playable offline. Supports 74 languages across Android, iOS, iPad, and Mac.

records.name: PDFRilo
records.tagline: Online PDF editor — fast, simple & free. No signup needed
records.description: PDFRilo is a free online PDF editor that lets you edit text, add images, annotate documents, and manage PDF pages directly in your browser. No signup or software installation required. Your PDF files stay on your device.

records.name: Model Stack
records.tagline: The right AI model for every task your team does
records.description: Describe a task and Model Stack picks the best of 72 AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini and more) to do it. Work that needs different strengths is handed between specialists: Gemini researches, Claude writes. Every answer shows which model did it, how long it took and the exact price. Pages it builds are tried in a real browser before you see them. For teams: one bill, per-person spend caps, and owners see spending, never prompts. Your tasks never train models. $2 free to start.

records.name: MiPrep AI
records.tagline: Turn interviews into offers
records.description: Your résumé got you the interview. MiPrep helps you own it. This AI interview copilot turns your experience and target role into personalized answers, sharpens your delivery through realistic mock interviews, and offers live support when pressure hits. Technical challenges, behavioral curveballs, unexpected questions, show them what you can do.

records.name: Tangled Analytics
records.tagline: See which stylists, days and hours make your salon money
records.description: Upload your GlossGenius, Vagaro, Square or Phorest export and see profit by day, stylist and weekday after payroll, plus peak hours, revenue per labor hour and a schedule builder built on your data. Works for W-2 and commission teams.

records.name: AshToolbox Web Utilities Platform
records.tagline: The Ultimate Suite of Free In-Browser Web Utilities
records.description: Discover smarter ways to work with ASH ToolBox 🚀 Explore powerful AI tools, free online utilities, content creation solutions, productivity tools, and digital resources—all in one place. From AI writing and image generation to video creation, SEO, and everyday online tasks, find the tools you need to save time, boost creativity, and work smarter. ✨ Explore. Create. Automate. Achieve more with AI. 🌐 Visit: https://www.ashtoolbox.com/

records.name: JSON Translate
records.tagline: Translate JSON i18n files without breaking keys
records.description: JSON Translate is a developer-focused translator for i18n locale files. Paste or upload an i18next, next-intl, React Intl, Vue I18n or Chrome extension messages.json file and get translated JSON back with every key, nested path and placeholder ({name}, {{count}}, %s) intact. Protect brand names with protected words, review changes with diff highlighting, and validate the output in CI with the free npm CLI @json-translate/check. Free tier, plus Basic and Pro plans.

records.name: TempBox
records.tagline: Free temporary email, Keep your real inbox clean and secure.
records.description: TempBox is a free temporary email service that allows you to receive emails at a disposable email address that self-destructs after a certain time. It is designed to keep your primary inbox free from spam, promotional clutter, and potential security risks. Unlike traditional email services, TempBox requires absolutely no signup or registration. Just click to generate a temporary inbox and start receiving emails instantly.

records.name: AntiAdBlock Core
records.tagline: Detects ad blockers in real time with 99.7% precision
records.description: The anti adblock script for publishers: detect uBlock Origin, AdGuard and Brave with 99.7% precision and recover lost ad revenue. Free plan, one-line install.

records.name: Lustrei
records.tagline: AI photo studio for jewelry
records.description: Lustrei is a specialized AI platform for jewelry photography and retouching. It enables brands to generate high-quality product images and realistic on-model photos instantly. Transform your jewelry visuals with professional AI tools designed for precision and stunning aesthetic results.

records.name: MGRAM
records.tagline: Monetize your Telegram bot audience with advertising
records.description: MGRAM connects Telegram bot owners with advertisers. Bot owners can monetize their audience through advertising, while advertisers can reach people inside Telegram bots. Campaign reporting helps distinguish delivery from clicks: a delivered message is not the same as a read, a lead, or a sale.

records.name: Learn Agentic Patterns 2.0
records.tagline: Learn agentic AI, then get interviewed on it. Free.
records.description: A free course on agentic AI: 43 lessons, four job paths (AI Engineer, Agent Engineer, AI Evals Engineer, AI PM), a daily broken agent to fix, and a real interview with a voice interviewer, graded by a real model run. No account needed to read.

records.name: GlassChat
records.tagline: Your favorite AI models, right at home on Mac
records.description: A native macOS AI chat app built with SwiftUI and Liquid Glass. Bring your own key for OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama or LM Studio. You get streaming Markdown, highlighted code, LaTeX, file attachments and MCP tools. Chats stay on your Mac.

records.name: Cubepals
records.tagline: Minecraft servers your friends join with an address
records.description: Make a Minecraft server in three decisions. Send friends its address, like duels.play.cubepals.com, and they join from the normal game. It sleeps when nobody plays, wakes when someone joins. Java Edition, open source. Try arcade.play.cubepals.com, no sign-up.

records.name: Whole AI
records.tagline: Your all-in-one agentic coding studio on phone
records.description: AI-powered agentic coding workspace to build apps, websites and full-stack projects, review code, hunt bugs, modernize code, and scan for security issues. Every feature is agentic, all in one coding workspace on your phone.

records.name: Legent AI
records.tagline: Meet Legent AI country & job specific resume optimizer.
records.description: Upload your CV, add a job description, pick a country. Legent AI rewrites it with the right length, sections, photo and personal-data rules for 10 markets, matches the job’s keywords honestly, and flags the gaps. ATS-safe download. Free to try.

records.name: AutoPMO
records.tagline: AI-assisted project and portfolio management
records.description: AutoPMO brings project plans, timelines, tasks, budgets, resources, RAID, documents, user stories, and portfolio reporting into one workspace. Its AI Project Assistant helps draft charters and plans, surface delivery risks, answer questions from project data, and prepare status updates—while keeping suggested changes under user control.

records.name: Cairn — a companion for cancer treatment
records.tagline: A companion for cancer treatment, and the person beside you
records.description: Cairn keeps the ordinary things between cancer appointments — mood, reminders, calendar, a private journal — and lets the patient choose, switch by switch, what the person beside them can see. Plus a companion for 3AM, with limits it never crosses.

records.name: Fall Asleep Fan
records.tagline: Fan sounds, rain and sleep tones that work fully offline
records.description: Can't sleep without a fan running? Fall Asleep Fan turns your phone into the steady, soothing fan you grew up with — no electricity bill, no cold breeze in winter. Three fans, each recorded from a real machine: Every fan has three speeds: Low, Medium, High. Pick the exact tone that puts you to sleep. Layer in the sounds of a calm night: Binaural delta and theta tones designed to accompany you into deep sleep. Best with headphones. Play multiple sounds at once and balance each one with its own...

records.name: FeedPulse
records.tagline: Free embeddable widgets + SEO checkers, no paid tier
records.description: 18 free embeddable widgets (flag counter, live traffic feed, GitHub stars, npm downloads, visitor globe + more) and 12 free SEO tools — 10 checkers (DA, DR, SERP, backlinks, Lighthouse) plus 2 generators. One-line embed. No cookies. No signup.

records.name: MochiMockup
records.tagline: Turn any screenshot into a device mockup in 30 seconds
records.description: Putting a screenshot into a device mockup still means opening a PSD, hunting for the Smart Object and re-exporting it by hand. MochiMockup does it in the browser in about 30 seconds: your design is warped onto the device with a homography, so it follows the real angle of the screen instead of sitting flat on top of it. 545 templates across iPhone, MacBook, iPad and Apple Watch. Exports up to 4K, runs as a Figma plugin too, and the free templates export without an account.

records.name: Moonwalk Trivia
records.tagline: Moonwalk Your Way to MJ Trivia Glory 🌙🏆
records.description: 👑 From trivia site to competitive MJ game Started as 54 questions. Evolved into something bigger. 54 Qs across 5 eras: Jackson 5 (12) Thriller (15) Bad (10) Dangerous (8) HIStory (9) 🔥 Fire streaks = +12% pot weight per streak 🏆 Live leaderboard — real-time top streaks 💰 Daily pot split 50/30/20 — 80% of $5 entries feed pot Not just trivia. A competitive arena for real MJ fans. 🎮 moonwalktrivia.com

records.name: FreelanceOS - Executive Notion Dashboard
records.tagline: All-in-one Notion workspace for freelance business
records.description: FreelanceOS is an executive Notion dashboard built for freelancers and creators. Easily track active projects, manage client relationships (CRM), organize daily tasks, and monitor cash flow—all from one clean, powerful workspace. Stop the chaos and run your business with confidence.

records.name: The Diagnostic Lab Hub
records.tagline: Forensic conversion leak audits & technical debt diagnostics
records.description: Free interactive calculator suite designed to detect technical conversion debt, mobile render blocking (NO_FCP), and missing trade schema in web funnels.

records.name: Voco Speech
records.tagline: Free forever. Unlimited TTS & voice cloning. No signup.
records.description: Voco Speech is a completely free, unlimited AI text-to-speech and voice cloning tool that runs entirely in your browser. No subscriptions, no credits, no signup, and no cloud audio processing. Generate natural AI speech, clone your own voice, and download audio without limits. Your recordings and generated speech never leave your device. Free forever.

records.name: DiskInsight
records.tagline: See what’s eating your Mac — free. Clean it once.
records.description: DiskInsight is a 100% local macOS disk analyzer. Scan any drive free and see every file in nine visualizers — treemap, sunburst, flame, mind map, age map and more — with instant search, large-file lists and a live monitor. Pro is a one-time unlock (no subscription): content-hash duplicate detection, a Dev Cache Cleaner for Xcode DerivedData/npm/CocoaPods/Gradle, and a full app uninstaller. No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry.

records.name: SAT Owl
records.tagline: Digital SAT practice that explains why you got it wrong
records.description: Digital SAT prep. Take a free full-length adaptive practice test or a 24-question diagnostic, then practice 640 original questions across all 29 skills. When you miss one, Owl, the built-in tutor, explains the mistake behind the answer you picked.

records.name: General Marketing Intelligence
records.tagline: Evidence-led marketing decisions inside your AI tools
records.description: Connect GA4, Search Console, ads and CRM evidence to Claude or Codex. GMI provides 62 decision tools, deterministic calculations, account learning and human-approved actions in one open-source MCP system.

records.name: Approve flowchart before Claude builds
records.tagline: Plan your app as a flowchart before Claude Code builds it
records.description: Virtuv is a app for building with Claude Code. Left: your Claude Code terminal. Right: your idea as a flowchart with short, testable requirements, checked by an independent reviewer. You comment, move blocks and answer open questions. Only when you click Approve does Claude build exactly that version in the same terminal: code, independent review, test, commit. New wishes go back to planning. Uses your own Claude Code setup.

records.name: Sonotype
records.tagline: Private, offline audio & video transcription for Windows
records.description: Sonotype turns recordings, meetings, lectures, interviews and videos into text on your own Windows PC. Nothing is uploaded: it works offline, in 99 languages, with the time of every line. Click a timestamp to hear just that line, double-click to fix a word, replace a misheard name everywhere at once, and save SRT/VTT subtitles, a Word document or plain text. Free for files up to 5 minutes; a one-time purchase unlocks any length. No account, no subscription.

records.name: ExpenseFlow
records.tagline: Track expenses. Understand your spending. Control the budget
records.description: Professional, mobile-first personal expense tracking web application with light-mode-only interface, budget tracking, purchase planning, and local data persistence.

records.name: AlbuSOL
records.tagline: Launch a Solana token from your terminal, key never leaves
records.description: Open-source command-line launch desk for Solana: create a token with revoked authorities, open a Raydium pool, burn LP to lock liquidity, mint Metaplex Core NFTs one by one or a whole folder. Your key stays encrypted on your own machine. MIT.

records.name: IntervuMate AI
records.tagline: AI Interview Copilot for Live Interview Support
records.description: AI Interview Copilot for real-time interview guidance and preparation. Practice mock interviews, prepare personalized answers, and get real-time AI guidance for behavioral, coding, technical, and system design interviews.

records.name: Stage Heat
records.tagline: Turn any concert setlist into a playlist
records.description: Setlist in, playlist out. Find a show's real setlist and export it to Spotify or Apple Music for free. Switching services or using both? Stage Heat Plus (paid) syncs any playlist, concerts or your own, across your apps. YouTube coming soon.

records.name: Boundary
records.tagline: Write down unspeakable feelings  find peace  simple choices.
records.description: A minimalist web app to write out silent thoughts, embrace inner emotions, and gently guide your choices when you feel lost.

records.name: equallto

records.description: Equallto provides professional Payroll Outsourcing services to help UK accounting firms and businesses manage payroll processes efficiently. By outsourcing payroll tasks, accounting practices can save valuable time, streamline their workflows, and focus more on client relationships and business growth.

records.name: Factline
records.tagline: Check a supplier before your AI agent pays the invoice
records.description: Official-records checks for AI agents: EU company registers, sanctions and PEP, VAT, IBAN, Peppol and the sender's email in one call, with one verdict and the source of every answer. MCP server, REST API and n8n node. Free trial, then pay per call.

records.name: RateKit — Smart Calculators 4 Startups
records.tagline: Free SMART calculators for founders and freelancers
records.description: Free business calculators: freelance rate, SAFE equity, burn rate, LTV:CAC, break-even, Stripe fees, VAT, ROI. Built for founders, startups and freelancers.

records.name: CareDesk360
records.tagline: Clinic management and growth for Indian clinics
records.description: CareDesk360 is clinic management software for clinics and small hospitals in India. Front desks book appointments by time slot, doctors write prescriptions from the clinic's own medicine list, and patients get a branded, e-signed PDF on WhatsApp. Reception creates OPD bills and GST invoices, and hospitals manage beds, admissions and IPD bills. Our team also runs each clinic's Google profile, social media and reviews. Free for the first year.

records.name: PDF Text Tools
records.tagline: Free PDF & Text Tools Online – No Signup, No Watermark
records.description: PDF Text Tools is a free collection of 10 browser-based tools: Merge PDF, Split PDF, Compress PDF, JPG to PDF, PDF to JPG, Delete/Rotate PDF Pages, Word Counter, Character Counter, Case Converter, and Remove Duplicate Lines. All processing happens on the user's device — no files are uploaded, no signup, no watermark. Includes free step-by-step PDF guides on the blog.

records.name: Sticker Banner
records.tagline: Animated TikTok sticker banner from one photo or video
records.description: Upload a photo or video and get 3, 6 or 9 sticker videos that line up into one picture on your TikTok profile. records.name: IS IT A HOLIDAY MOVIE?

records.name: Maybe Day

Free entry available to everyone. Full sweepstakes rules ( https://maybe.day/rules )

Free, open source, and browser-based, with SVGs generated locally and no third-party image services.

Brands can claim their page for free.

records.name: Robotic Jobs
records.tagline: Find your next role in robotics and physical AI
records.description: Find robotics careers across autonomy, perception, hardware and physical AI. Search employer-sourced vacancies by discipline, location, experience and disclosed salary, save roles, and follow links to employers’ application pages. Explore company profiles, career guides and engineering tools.

records.name: AI Parabellum 3.0
records.tagline: Find the right AI tool fast, or list yours in 24 hours
records.description: AI Parabellum 3.0 is a full redesign of our AI tools directory. Browse 1,000+ reviewed AI tools by task, with a quick summary, screenshot, pricing and an honest verdict on every tool page. New in 3.0: free, freemium and paid filters in every category, a "What's new" bell for tools and AI news added since your last visit, likes synced to your account, and daily AI news. Makers get a new dashboard and are listed within 24 hours, or get a full refund.

records.name: Stars Organizer
records.tagline: Sort your GitHub stars into Lists that sync back to GitHub
records.description: Hundreds of GitHub stars and no way to find anything? Stars Organizer gives you search, tags, ratings and notes on top of your stars, and sorts them into GitHub Lists that sync back to GitHub. A health score per repo to let you remove dead projects from your lists. Run it with one command (npx github-stars-organizer) using your gh CLI login. Open source, no telemetry, and it backs up your Lists before every launch.

records.name: ClonePeek
records.tagline: Review hidden repo hooks before running unfamiliar code
records.description: ClonePeek is a free, MIT-licensed, offline Python CLI and GitHub Action that inventories commands configured to run through npm lifecycle scripts, VS Code folder-open tasks, devcontainers, Cursor and Claude Code hooks, and local MCP server launches.
