A heuristic checklist, not a malware detector or sandbox.

records.name: Ouroboros Apps
records.tagline: MCP plugins that keep AI assistants on your saved facts
records.description: https://ouroborosapps.com — MCP plugins so assistants stick to facts you saved. Continuity (story bible) is in ChatGPT's app directory and works in Claude, Grok, Cursor, and more. Desk, Claim, Scope, Invoice, Deposit, Milestone, and Rank are early access by connector URL. 14-day free trial, then Pro. Built by Ouroboros Apps / Lawrence Hutchins.

records.name: The Idea Court
records.tagline: Put your idea on trial: AI lawyers, 12 jurors, one verdict
records.description: Type any idea: a business, a purchase, a plan. Two AI lawyers argue it point by point, twelve AI jurors with different points of view vote blind, and a judge rules: guilty, not guilty, or not guilty with conditions. You get the biggest risk, what to do first and the jury's best fix. Watch a full sample trial free, no sign-up.

records.name: Requstory
records.tagline: Map how any organisation works, from its website
records.description: Enter a company's website and get a map of how it works in about 30 seconds: teams, processes, handoffs and the customer journey, each with proof from its pages. Check if AI agents can use the site, research 150 pages, share the map. Free to start.

records.name: Orbits
records.tagline: Finds people asking for what you built. You answer them.
records.description: Orbits reads your site, then searches Reddit, LinkedIn, Hacker News, Indie Hackers, X and Threads every day for people asking for a tool like yours, and drafts your reply. You post it from your own account, so it stays up instead of getting removed as bot spam. New since our first launch: Orbits is rebuilt around finding real buyers first, with content posting as an extra on Scale. Free for 7 days.

records.name: Earful
records.tagline: Know what to fix first in your app reviews
records.description: Paste an App Store or Google Play link. Earful reads up to a year of reviews, ranks the problems by how many people they hurt and tells you what to fix first, what's growing and why people leave. Every claim is backed by counts and quotes. Start with $1.

records.name: AVCompari
records.tagline: Compare antivirus suites by real prices and lab results
records.description: Free antivirus comparison site: 18 products side by side with official first-year AND renewal prices, devices, extras (VPN, password manager) and AV-Comparatives results. No scores we invented, no sign-up. Available in 24 EU languages.

records.name: Color Drain
records.tagline: A cleaning puzzle game with a villain, free on Android
records.description: Baron Blank drained Rainbow City gray. Drag a vacuum nozzle over his googly-eyed paint Blots until they pop, and watch each object bloom back into color. 200 levels across two worlds, two bosses. Free on Android, with ads and optional purchases.

records.name: FoodHome
records.tagline: Your AI food companion for meals, labels, recipes and more
records.description: FoodHome is an AI-powered food companion designed to make everyday eating easier. Take a photo of your meal to analyze it, scan product labels, track your meals and hydration, discover recipes from ingredients you already have at home, save recipes from videos, organize your pantry, and keep everything in one place. FoodHome combines practical food tools, artificial intelligence and everyday organization in a simple app built for real life.

records.name: MenuFix
records.tagline: Free Uber Eats page score for restaurants, in 2 minutes
records.description: Free tools for restaurant owners on Uber Eats. The page score asks 10 quick questions about your photos, descriptions, menu order and rating, then gives a score out of 100 and your 3 most important fixes. The photo checker tests a dish photo against Uber's size rules and crops it to 5:4. The description checker flags length, ALL CAPS and vague words. Everything runs in your browser, no sign up. Made by MenuFix, who make Uber Eats pages over for independent restaurants.

records.name: OwlStat MCP
records.tagline: Ask Claude about any Instagram or TikTok account
records.description: Instagram and TikTok analytics for agencies, now inside Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. Add your API key and ask things like "how did @nike do this month?". The answer comes straight from OwlStat data. Free plan with 2 accounts, no card needed.

records.name: Flusia
records.tagline: CRM, sales automations and newsletters for growing SMEs
records.description: Keep customer history, sales pipelines and follow-ups in one shared CRM. Flusia combines visual workflow automations and a newsletter module with quotes, calendars and operational tools, so small teams can connect sales and customer communication. Available in Italian and English, with a 30-day free trial and no credit card. Automations and newsletter availability depend on the plan and add-ons.

records.name: Synteq Apps & Serverless Functions
records.tagline: DevOps handled so you don't have to.
records.description: Synteq Apps & Serverless Functions let developers deploy full-stack apps straight from a repo. Autoscaling, HTTPS, logs, and secrets are built in, so you write the code and Synteq runs it.

records.name: GrowthPilot
records.tagline: Simple digital marketing tips for small businesses
records.description: Simple digital marketing tips for small businesses — SEO, Google, social media & AI in plain words.

records.name: ArthNow
records.tagline: Financial & Market News, Around you
records.description: Every morning in India starts with chai and one question: what's happening with my money? ArthNow answers it calmly. We bring stock market, RBI, IPO, gold and economy news from 50+ trusted publishers into one personalised feed. Read short summaries, open full articles without pop-ups, track live Nifty and Sensex, and listen on your commute. Follow what matters to you, and your feed slowly becomes yours. Built by a small team who just wanted money news to feel less tiring.

records.name: VolumeBooster+
records.tagline: A system-wide volume booster with an equalizer and AutoEQ
records.description: VolumeBooster+ makes most apps louder at once: music, video, games and voice messages. It adds a 5-band equalizer with 9 free presets, bass boost, a floating panel and AutoEQ for 2,456 headphone models. Free: up to +10 dB, 60 min a day, with ads. Pro: +15 dB, no limit, no ads.

records.name: DotDog
records.tagline: A little desktop dog to pet, play fetch with and befriend
records.description: A little dog that lives beside you while you work. Pet it, play fetch, give it a name and build a friendship. The basic pet is free with no time limit or account required on Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+. Optional paid Windows features add customization, to-dos, focus tools and supported coding-agent notifications.

records.name: Focusity
records.tagline: Your study plan, built around your real timetable
records.description: Import your timetable, exams and Moodle deadlines, and Focusity fits study sessions into the hours you actually have free. Miss one and it re-plans the week. Free on iPhone, Android and web, in English and Hebrew.

records.name: Look Launcher
records.tagline: Free, open-source launcher for Mac, Windows & Linux
records.description: Look is a free, open-source launcher for macOS, Windows and Linux, with every feature free. Find apps, files, folders, clipboard history and open windows as fast as you type. Install from Homebrew, AUR, nixpkgs or Scoop, or grab the installer from GitHub Releases.

records.name: Lightbulb
records.tagline: Your team and your AI employees, in one place
records.description: A team workspace where AI employees work in your channels. Mention one, it does the work, and the result comes back where everyone can approve it or pick it up. Message and orchestrate every agent your team runs, Lightbulb's, Claude Code or Codex, from one place. Any model. $50 a month for up to five people.

records.name: Your First 5 AI Moves

Answer four quick questions (your work, your AI experience, what you want help with, phone or computer) and AI picks five moves for you from a library of 18 we checked against OpenAI and Google help pages: two starters, two everyday time-savers and one power move. Each takes 2 to 15 minutes, works with a free ChatGPT or Google account and links to the official source. Free, no signup, and we don't store your answers.

records.name: Glov Box V1.0
records.tagline: AI warranty auditor that exposes fine-print traps
records.description: Overview GLOV BOX is a specialized consumer-protection software application designed to empower everyday car owners by auditing, translating, and managing automotive warranties. Whether dealing with an original manufacturer warranty, a certified pre-owned agreement, or a complex third-party aftermarket protection plan, Glov Box eliminates confusing legal jargon to deliver total coverage transparency.

records.name: FindDepth
records.tagline: Deep research reports with sources read and figures checked

Reports include tables and charts, are written in the language you ask in (8 languages) and export to PDF, Word or Markdown.

records.name: Baton
records.tagline: Maestro + RN apps + worktrees, with no collisions.

records.description: WiseOCR reads receipts and invoices and returns structured JSON: vendor, date, line items, tax and total. Try the live demo on wiseocr.com without signing up.

records.name: Vilora

records.name: Trainix

records.description: Trainix goes beyond logging workouts. Track exercises, sets, reps, weight and session time, then turn your training history into actionable insights. records.name: VidoGrid

records.description: Meet VidoGrid — your AI video creation hub. Create stunning AI videos with **Veo 3.1 and Grok Video 1.5 for free**. records.name: INSPECTA

records.name: Plastic Detox

records.description: Reduce your family's exposure to microplastics, PFAS, and heavy metals. Every product checked five ways: formula, packaging, lab results, lawsuits, and recalls. records.name: Curiworld

Explore everything!

records.name: fanlygen

Every post waits for your approval. 300 free credits to start.

Most tools process the file on your device, so it never leaves it. A tool that needs a server says so on its page. The result of one tool goes straight into the next.

records.name: Glance for Mac
records.tagline: Your MacBook notch, now a live, cinematic island

records.name: Ahed

records.description: AMLTrace helps people check TRON wallets and USDT TRC-20 addresses before sending or receiving funds. AMLTrace focuses on TRON and USDT TRC-20; it provides an on-chain risk assessment, not identity verification or a guarantee that funds are safe.

records.name: Condivio
records.tagline: find people, place and possibilities for rent rent and buy
records.description: Verified listings, private numbers, and data-backed decisions. Rent, buy, and find flatmates across 34+ cities — the smarter, spam-free way.

records.name: Sticky Wall
records.tagline: A sticky note billboard for indie makers Copy tagline
records.description: Sticky Wall is a public billboard for indie makers to pin their startups and side projects. Standard notes cost $2 once. Newer notes can bury older ones, but their history stays discoverable. A live bidding center spot adds a little competition.

records.name: featurd
records.tagline: The link that works for you. Sells, books, follows up.

Free for good.

records.name: Gnosis
records.tagline: Construction contracts that do their own paperwork
records.description: Gnosis administers civil construction contracts under NZS 3910, AS 4000, AIA and EJCDC. Claims net against the certified position, certificates issue through an approval gate and every statutory clock is counted. Invited parties free. Open sample, no account.

records.name: Moralo
records.tagline: The dating app with one rule: one conversation at a time
records.description: Most dating apps spread attention thin: everyone talks to ten people and chats die mid-sentence. On Moralo, when two people like each other they go straight into a chat - no accept button - and while they talk, both are invisible to everyone else. When the chat ends they rate each other and others see the average, so kindness pays and ghosting doesn't. In the browser and on Android, no ads, no selling data, no password. Free to use.

records.name: LaunchProof
records.tagline: Pre-launch QA checks for paid media campaigns
records.description: LaunchProof checks a paid media campaign before it goes live. It validates UTM parameters, URL structure, and ad copy limits, then returns a scored readiness report where every flagged issue comes with a specific fix. Built by a marketing operations practitioner for the setup errors that usually surface after spend starts. Free beta run, $29 per run, $79/mo Pro.

records.name: Bilin Translate
records.tagline: Free PDF & Word translation with bilingual review
records.description: Translate PDF, DOCX and DOC files with free model options. records.name: LearningOS
records.tagline: AI course creator: docs to courses, roleplay and video
records.description: Turn PDF, Word and PowerPoint files into online courses, AI roleplay practice and narrated training videos. Publish a link or export SCORM 1.2. Start free.

records.description: Free up valuable iPhone storage in minutes. KEY FEATURES - Find & Delete Duplicate and Similar Photos - Screenshot Cleanup - Clean Up Videos and Live Photos - Remove Large Files - Photo and Video Compression - Merge Duplicate Contacts

records.name: Simple Ruler
records.tagline: A screen ruler you can calibrate with any credit card
records.description: Most of us have a ruler app we have never checked against a real ruler. Simple Ruler fixes that in seconds with any credit card, then measures length, gaps, width x height and angles. Lay a screw or a SIM tray on the screen and read it in millimeters. Free with ads, offline, no account.

records.name: Pro Gineous
records.tagline: Domains, hosting and VPS that just work, in one place

records.name: OmniDoc
records.tagline: Free AI office suite with layout-keeping PDF translation
records.description: OmniDoc is a free office suite for Windows, macOS and Ubuntu: open, edit and export Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and Markdown with no sign-in. Claude, Codex and Cursor can create, check and export documents on your computer through its MCP interface, and any document can be published as a web link in one click.

records.name: 2 Minute Drill Game
records.tagline: Call the plays in real NFL endings. Beat the real coach.
records.description: A free NFL strategy simulator that runs in your browser. Every day everyone gets the same real late-game NFL drive: the real score, clock, timeouts, quarterback and receivers. You call every play, the tempo and the timeouts, and a Monte Carlo engine built on every NFL play since 2016 grades each call on win probability before the result is revealed. Then see how the real head coach's calls grade on the same scale. Practice, Survivor and friend challenges included. No sign-up.

records.name: VibeGuard
records.tagline: A real pentest for your AI-built app. From €59.
records.description: Free scanners read your headers in 60 seconds. A real pentest costs €5,000 and six weeks. VibeGuard is the middle: an autonomous agent attacks your live app for 1 to 18+ hours, from the outside, with no access to your source. Give it a throwaway test account and it goes behind your login, where the expensive bugs live. Every finding arrives in plain English, with the request that proves it and a fix prompt for your coding agent. A free re-check confirms the fix worked. From €59, one time.

records.name: LyfeHubX Launch

records.name: Tugas

Message text, sender names, attachments, and deadlines never leave your device and are never sent to any server.

records.name: Gleam
records.tagline: Swipe your camera roll clean in two minutes a day

records.name: Decision Tree Builder

records.description: A tool for comparing options and making decisions you can explain. Build a tree of choices, add costs, pros and cons, flag blockers and track which goals each path covers. records.name: VocxAI

records.name: Ranxii
records.tagline: AI visibility reports for SEO agencies
records.description: Track how often ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention each client and its competitors. Weekly, per client, with every answer stored as evidence and a branded monthly report your agency can send as it is.

records.name: WordCairn v1.0.0
records.tagline: Word counts for the manuscript you already have.
records.description: Point WordCairn at your folder of chapters. See your total, every chapter against your target, today's words, your pace and your streak. No account, no cloud, no new writing app to learn. For only $4.99 but dduring October and November I am offering a 50% discount.

records.name: Ninho
records.tagline: Ninho — Menos cobranças. Mais tempo em família.
records.description: O Ninho reúne tarefas, compromissos e compras em um só lugar para toda a família. Com responsabilidades compartilhadas e avatares que tornam as tarefas mais divertidas para as crianças, organizar a casa vira um trabalho em equipe.

records.name: Handro
records.tagline: Field service software for small crews, from US$14.99/mo
records.description: Handro is field service software for small crews: plumbers, HVAC, electricians, landscapers and cleaners. Schedule jobs, send good/better/best quotes customers sign on their phone, turn the finished job into an invoice with a payment link, and get paid by card through your own Stripe or Square. QuickBooks Online sync on Solo and Team. Free Starter for 1 person and 10 jobs a month; Solo US$14.99/mo; Team US$49/mo flat for up to 10. Web, iPhone and Android.

records.name: Spekra Doctor
records.tagline: 60-second operational reliability & audit CLI for web apps
records.description: A zero-dependency CLI that audits codebases in under 500ms across 8 critical operational failure modes: database table locks, missing disaster recovery rehearsals, CDC stream divergence, zombie cloud assets, and unmanaged security leases. Features: • Zero dependencies & zero configuration (runs directly with `npx spekra doctor`) • Cryptographic SHA-256 attestation seal for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audit proofs • Composite GitHub Action (`uses: subash-thiruppathy/pulseOps@v1`) for PR CI/CD merge gating

records.name: OpenTokenMini
records.tagline: Fix your AI Spending with OpenTokenMini
records.description: Nobody knows what their AI agents are spending money on. OpenTokenMini collects the data, shows it to the people paying and the people building, and feeds it back to the agent. Free and open source.

records.name: Hookgap
records.tagline: Turn a prospect's security gaps into a sales conversation
records.description: Hookgap checks any domain's email, website and SSL security from public data in under 60 seconds: DMARC, SPF, DKIM, MTA-STS, certificates, security headers and registrar lock. It turns the gaps into a plain-English, graded report with your MSP's logo, plus a ready outreach email. What's different: passive checks only (no port scans), no AI in the reports, weekly change alerts to Slack/Teams, and $39/mo for one-person MSPs. Try 3 free checks a day with no sign-up.

records.name: ProfiVault
records.tagline: Save and copy all your professional links in seconds
records.description: Save and quickly copy your LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, resume, and coding profile links with ProfiVault, a simple Chrome extension built for job applications and professional workflows.

records.name: Smart China Trip
records.tagline: Explore China and build your day-by-day itinerary.
records.description: Smart China Trip helps international visitors explore China destinations and plan sightseeing by day. Browse cities and suggested routes, organize sights, and review displayed time and cost estimates. Practical guides cover entry, payments, internet, transport, accommodation, and cultural context.

records.name: Life Cheat Shop
records.tagline: 36 cheat codes for your life. You only have 100 coins.
records.description: A free browser game, no signup. You get 100 imaginary coins and 36 cheat codes for your life: more time, more luck, a better memory, a slightly nicer personality. You cannot afford them all. Your basket becomes a painfully honest receipt that says what you actually value. It takes about a minute and nothing is stored. It was built and is run by an AI agent.

records.name: Mailaura
records.tagline: AI newsletters and email marketing for teams and agencies
records.description: Create, automate, and analyze email campaigns with Mailaura. Turn website content into newsletters, draft and translate copy with AI, and build campaigns with a drag-and-drop editor. Visual automations support recurring workflows; agency features help manage multiple clients. REST API, MCP server, and CLI access connect your tools and AI agents. Available in German and English, with a free plan to get started.

records.name: Impulse
records.tagline: Dictation for Windows that never leaves your PC
records.description: Hold a key, talk, release. Impulse transcribes on your own machine and pastes the text wherever your cursor is. No cloud, no subscription. Free for 14 days, no card, then $29 once.

records.name: Team Name Factory
records.tagline: Names your team will love without the brainstorming pain.
records.description: Team Name Factory is a fast, brand-ready team name generator designed to eliminate brainstorming pain. Skip the endless back-and-forth and move from a blank page to a confident shortlist in seconds. 🚀 Key Features: • Instant shortlists: Generate names tailored by category and vibe (Work, Gaming, Sports, and more). • Collaborative: Save your favorites and easily share a shortlist with your team to vote. • Frictionless: 100% free with no signup required.

records.name: Stashwell — Web Media Downloader
records.tagline: Collect, download and reuse assets from webpages
records.description: Stashwell turns webpages into a reusable asset library. Scan a page from Chrome’s side panel to collect images, SVG icons, fonts, links, direct media, and files. Preview, search, bookmark, and download resources individually or as a ZIP. Convert supported assets or prepare them for Figma, Canva, Photoshop, and other design apps. After a manual scan, the collection updates as the page changes. Everything stays local, with JSON backup and no account.

records.name: Setu
records.tagline: From conversations to real-world actions.
records.description: Meet SETU by Klevora, AI that doesn’t just answer, it acts. SETU turns natural-language requests into business actions through APIs, enabling workflows like order tracking, returns, and cancellations. With structured execution, input validation, and outcome verification, SETU bridges conversational AI and real-world business operations. We’re also developing VAYU, our proprietary semi-autoregressive AI architecture for agentic workflows. Klevora is a member of the NVIDIA Inception Program.

records.name: PDFtoGrid
records.tagline: PDF tables to Excel or CSV, without uploading the file
records.description: PDFtoGrid pulls tables out of text-based PDFs, such as bank statements, invoices, receipts, price lists and financial reports, and turns them into Excel (XLSX) or CSV. The PDF is read by JavaScript in your browser and never uploaded to a server. Check the editable preview, adjust column spacing, pick a page range or combine pages into one table, then download. Free, with no signup, page limit or watermark.

records.name: Online GIF Maker
records.tagline: Create and resize GIFs to fit your file size limit
records.description: Turn videos and photos into GIFs without signing up or adding a watermark. Preview the estimated file size before converting, or choose a target size and let the tool adjust the output. Trim, crop, add captions, change speed, and record your screen for demos, tutorials, and reactions. Export as GIF, WebP, MP4, or APNG.

records.name: Aesthetic Quiz
records.tagline: Find your aesthetic in 12 picture questions
records.description: Answer 12 quick picture questions about palettes, fabrics, shoes and rooms and get one of 10 aesthetics, like cottagecore or dark academia, with a mood board of its colors and key pieces. About 2 minutes, free, answers stay on your device.

records.name: SeeRanked
records.tagline: See and improve your brand's visibility in AI search
records.description: See Ranked shows you exactly where your brand appears when people ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok and Perplexity for recommendations in your industry, and what it takes to rank higher than everyone else. * Your AI Visibility Score * Which platforms mention you (and which don't) * How you stack against competitors * What to fix to get recommended first * Real user sessions, not API calls to get 100% Accurate Results * Results from the cities you serve (For Local Ranking)

records.name: Reges Town
records.tagline: A living 3D city where AI citizens live, work and talk
records.description: Reges Town is a 3D city in your browser where AI citizens live, work, drive and talk to each other. Three small cities linked by roads and flights, with weather and a full day and night cycle. The world runs on a server around the clock, so every visitor sees the same town, and it keeps going when nobody is watching. Walk in, take a car or let it drive itself, and talk to anyone you meet. Some of the citizens are the AI agents that work for our company. Free, no download.

records.name: Free Google AI Course: 30+ Tools
records.tagline: Gemini, NotebookLM, Flow, Veo & More for real work
records.description: Start using Google AI beyond Gemini with this free 2026 course covering 30+ tools for research, productivity, automation, AI video, agents, and app building. Learn what to use, when to use it, and how Gemini, NotebookLM, Flow, Veo, Stitch, and AI Studio work together through practical workflows for real work. 🎁 Apply coupon code 48HOURFIV when enrolling to get the course free. Learn to research faster, create AI videos, automate work, build agents, and turn ideas into working apps.

records.name: Sturdy: Strength on GLP-1
records.tagline: Five-minute strength sessions for people on GLP-1s
records.description: Sturdy helps people on GLP-1 medications keep up strength work on low-energy days. Quick Movement sessions take about five minutes with a guided player, timer, rep guidance and rest. Flag a sore area and those movements are swapped. There are 35 movements with easier and harder options, a weekly plan built around your days and equipment, protein logging and a 30-day PDF summary you control. Private, no account, never suggests doses. Check with your clinician first.

records.name: ThoughtNets
records.tagline: Turn short thoughts into a network of connected ideas
records.description: ThoughtNets is a network of short public thoughts connected by meaning. Write a thought in 200 characters or fewer, discover related ideas through AI-powered connections, and explore how different perspectives connect. Use Explore to discover the public thought network and My Mind to visualize your own contributions. Anyone can browse the public network. Create an account to contribute your thoughts. The platform offers Free and Pro plans, with Pro priced at $5/month.

records.name: PDFowo
records.tagline: Free online tools for PDFs, QR codes, calendars and more
records.description: PDFowo is a free collection of online tools for documents, file conversion, printing, and everyday productivity. Everything is available in one place, directly in your browser, without installing software or paying for subscriptions. - PDF and document tools - File conversion - Printable calendars and productivity tools - QR codes and barcodes - Document templates and practical guides - Free and browser-based Available in multiple languages.

records.name: PDFKettle
records.tagline: Compress, merge & convert PDFs without uploading
records.description: Free online PDF tools: compress, merge, split, rotate, crop and convert PDF to JPG and back. Everything runs in your browser, so files are never uploaded.

records.name: SelfieForge
records.tagline: AI headshots and Halloween portraits from one selfie
records.description: Most AI headshot tools charge $30+ upfront or return a face that is not yours. SelfieForge gives you two free previews a day, no card, and its core promise is identity preservation: the styling changes but the face stays recognizably you. Upload one selfie, pick a professional, LinkedIn, dating or Halloween look, and get a labeled result in 10-40 seconds. Clean full-resolution files start at $9 for 20 images.

records.name: Orfeo Ayuda
records.tagline: Remote assistance so your kids can help you use your phone
records.description: Orfeo Ayuda flips the usual remote-support model: instead of controlling a device, your kids see your screen and guide you with on-screen pointers while you stay in control and tap everything yourself. Built for parents and grandparents who get stuck on their phone and want patient, visual help from family without giving up control of the device.

records.name: Agentmetry
records.tagline: A local-first endpoint sensor for AI coding agents
records.description: Agentmetry is a local-first endpoint sensor for AI coding agents. It records each tool call Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others make, in a hash-chained trail on the laptop, and can forward it to the SIEM you already run. The difference is the MCP listing. It hashes tools/list per tool and records when it moves while the config stays the same: the MCP rug pull (ATLAS AML.T0109). It stores the hash, not the text. Apache-2.0. No install needed: uvx agentmetry demo. Sees only agents with hooks.

records.name: DrinkMe
records.tagline: Minimalist desktop app that automatically compresses videos
records.description: DrinkMe is a minimalist desktop app that automatically compresses videos into smaller files—no manual settings or technical know-how required. Just pick a file, click Shrink, and save space. Although it varies depending on each file, it aims at reducing between 80-90% of the original size.

records.name: CPS · Control Panel Suite
records.tagline: Visualize and manage deep Windows internals from one console
records.description: "CPS · Control Panel Suite" is a Windows administration suite that makes hidden system structures visible, understandable, and safely manageable. It hosts classic management tools inside a unified interface, extends them with property pages and PowerShell actions, and builds new modules where Windows lacks them. From USB and network topology to firmware setup, boot paths, storage health, and crash analysis, CPS helps you diagnose and act with evidence and deliberate safeguards.

records.name: Floviu
records.tagline: A focus app that helps you understand your mind
records.description: You sit down to focus. Then one notification becomes one scroll, one more tab, and somehow 30 minutes are gone. Floviu helps you break that cycle without turning productivity into pressure. Start a focus session, quiet distractions, and discover the patterns that help you focus at your best. Every session grows your Focus World, turning small moments of attention into visible progress. No productivity hustle. Just a calmer way to build your focus.

records.name: Leadspotr
records.tagline: See which companies visit your website
records.description: Leadspotr turns anonymous B2B website traffic into leads for Dutch companies. See which companies visit, what they read and when they return, with Chamber of Commerce (KvK) details. Get alerts on hot accounts, let visitors ask for a callback, appointment or WhatsApp chat via the widget, and push leads to your CRM. Free for the first 100 companies per month.

records.name: Notification Tracker & Alarms
records.tagline: What is deleted is not forgotten
records.description: Keeps a history of your notifications so deleted messages stay readable. Set alarms and reminders on any notification, and dismiss annoying ones for good. Android only, 33 languages, dark and light mode, minimal permissions. Free with ads, with an optional premium plan and a 7-day trial.

records.name: Scrapevia
records.tagline: Find Instagram business leads, then check their emails
records.description: Collect the accounts a public Instagram profile follows, filter them, get the public business emails they list, and check which emails work (Passed, Failed or Unknown). Pay per credit from $5, no subscription, credits never expire, and Unknown email results are free. 100 free credits to try. Free tools need no account: a bounce rate calculator and a single email checker. Only public information is used. Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

records.name: LocalReputeapp
records.tagline: AI-powered reputation management for local businesses.
records.description: Meet LocalReputeApp — your partner in local business reputation growth. Simplify review management, monitor customer feedback, and build trust with potential customers. Designed for local businesses and marketing agencies, LocalReputeApp helps you take control of your online presence and make reputation management easier. We're launching on Product Hunt to connect with early adopters, hear your feedback, and build a better way for local businesses to grow. 🚀

records.name: Pipe IDE for Visual Programming
records.tagline: Build, run and debug visual apps in your browser with Python
records.description: Other visual tools are too simple or domain-specific, so devs stay on code. Pipe is general-purpose and blends visual logic with Python built into the diagram – visual where it’s clearer, code where it’s precise. The diagram is the running program: build, run, and debug it live. A test bed sends inputs and inspects results; a signal-flow log shows how data moves; reusable templates and structured data domains keep programs organized. Browser-based, no install, no account – your data stays local.

records.name: Math in Colors
records.tagline: Math lessons, drawn while you watch
records.description: Short math lessons for children, drawn while they watch, grade by grade. Each lesson is a hand-drawn board that builds one sentence at a time and stays on the screen at the end to explore, presented by Stuart, a fuzzy pink brain with round glasses. Stuart was created by Niki, my 7 seven-year-old daughter

records.name: Is Our $700 Gift Card Giveaway Legit?
records.tagline: Is Our $700 Gift Card Giveaway Legit? How It Works
records.description: See how our giveaway works: no fees, a random draw, a public winner announcement and clear rules. Enter free if you’d like to join.

records.name: Private SuperIntelligence
records.tagline: Private AI concierge for enterprises and family offices
records.description: Private SuperIntelligence is an AI concierge from Mitosis Labs for enterprises, family offices and private clients. It works across a client's own email, documents and data with cited answers, and treats privacy at six layers: retention and deletion, communication, access and actions, model inference, data storage and deployment. Powered by Mitosis Labs (https://mitosislabs.ai).

records.name: Dear Ever
records.tagline: Cinematic wedding photo slideshows, made in your browser
records.description: Dear Ever turns your photos into a cinematic wedding slideshow for the reception screen. Upload up to 40 photos, set the order and pick a style; Dear Ever directs camera movement, pacing and music. No editing skills needed, and your original photos are never altered or AI-regenerated. Preview as often as you like for free, then pay once (US$39) for a watermark-free 1080p MP4 only when you love it.

records.name: Tab Discarder
records.tagline: Free up Chrome memory at will, without closing your tabs.
records.description: Manually discard inactive Chrome tabs and tab groups to free memory while protecting tabs you choose.

records.name: Actium
records.tagline: Your marketing team, already working.
records.description: Actium is an AI marketing team for small businesses and agencies. It scans your website to build your brand kit, then Search Studio drafts SEO content and Social Studio creates posts for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and X. You approve everything before it goes live. Agencies get a separate workspace for each client. Try it free: 3 posts for your business, no signup or card.

records.name: Pulse
records.tagline: AI Business Assistant for Freelancers
records.description: Pulse — The AI Business Assistant for Freelancers. Invoices, Quotes, Taxes, Clients, Projects etc. — All in one.

records.name: NotchDesk
records.tagline: Your next meeting and clipboard, one hover away in the notch
records.description: NotchDesk turns the MacBook notch into a countdown to your next meeting, with one-click Join (or Ctrl-Cmd-J from any app), and a private clipboard history you can search, even text inside screenshots. It works with the calendars already in macOS Calendar. No account, nothing leaves your Mac. Native app for macOS 14+.

records.name: Witaro.io
records.tagline: Instant clarity on who owns and knows every asset
records.description: Witaro maintains a living record of who owns and who knows each asset and service, organised by location. Optional notifications prompt people to confirm their details every six months, helping keep information accurate and up to date. Integrated with Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Copilot, Witaro lets you search for the right people directly inside Copilot simply ask, “Who looks after this?”, “Who can help me with this?”, or “Who owns this application in the Melbourne office?”

records.name: Venue Inquiry Tracker Lite
records.tagline: Free Notion lead tracker for wedding venue owners
records.description: A free Notion template that keeps every wedding venue inquiry in one place: couple, date, guest count, source, status, tour date and next follow-up. Duplicate in one click and stop losing leads in your inbox.

records.name: DomainExchange
records.tagline: Premium .si domains from verified owners, sold via escrow
records.description: The curated marketplace for dot si, the domain of superintelligence. As AI labs and startups race toward SI, short dot si names have become the new premium address for AI brands. Every seller is hand-approved, every listing is ownership-verified and every sale closes through Escrow.com or Spaceship SafePay. We also publish every verified dot si sale: 255 so far, over $1.4M. Real prices, no fake listings, no squatter spam.

records.name: Zivooo
records.tagline: MCP-first & no-subscription SEO & GEO all-in-one platform
records.description: Zivooo is a full service no-subscription and MCP-enabled SEO and GEO platform for marketers, founders and agencies to run their entire SEO, GEO and content operations and grow organic traffic from Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity and more on autopilot. 30+ modules and automation designed to build your product and search visibility in Google search, ChatGPT, Claude & Perplexity, all in one single dashboard at pay-as-you-use pricing. Run marketing on your own pace. Start with 1000 free credits.

records.name: FullReviews 2.0
records.tagline: Reply to Google reviews automatically
records.description: FullReviews is back with even more to help small businesses and franchises handle Google Reviews automatically. ✅ Reply automatically in your tone ✅ Monitor every stat: reviews, rating, insights, ranking ✅ Enjoy a bunch of free tools to help you achieve more on Google Maps

records.name: Leadpoet
records.tagline: Find interested buyers. Start conversations.
records.description: Leadpoet now takes you from finding interested buyers to starting conversations. Our AI sales agent spots buying signals across the web, turns that context into personalized outreach, and handles sending + follow-ups across LinkedIn and email. You review the messages and set the schedule. When someone replies with interest, your team takes over and books the call.

records.name: SpendLock
records.tagline: Red-team your AI agent's spend authority before it ships.
records.description: An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses from public seed phrases, asked itself whether spending was ethical, and did it anyway. SpendLock is the pre-deploy drill for that failure mode: 7 spend-authority red-team scenarios, a FastAPI eval harness with hard 402 spend cutoffs, a programmable-spending-limits checklist, and a disclosure template. Find the boundary violation in the lab, not in production.

records.name: Kilnframe
records.tagline: Animated inserts and music for Premiere and Resolve
records.description: Kilnframe is a free, open source plugin for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve Studio. Mark a range, pick one of eleven styles: it listens to what you say, writes an animation in HTML, CSS and Three.js, renders it on your own computer and places it above the range with its sound effects. New in 0.2.0: Resolve Studio on Mac and Windows, and a Music tab that scores your timeline with Google Lyria, ducked under your voice.

records.name: QuantiMeet
records.tagline: Team scheduling at one flat price, never per seat
records.description: Booking pages, round-robin team events and video calls on our own servers in Canada, at one price for the whole team, unlimited users. Sign up from October 20 to November 20, 2026 (Pacific Time) and pay CA$5/month for your first 6 months, then CA$10/month.

records.name: $700 Gift Card Giveaway and How to Enter
records.tagline: $700 Gift Card Giveaway Rules and How to Enter
records.description: Everything about our giveaway in one place: the prize, who can enter, how the winner is chosen, delivery time and key dates.

records.name: CodeOtter
records.tagline: Self-hosted AI code review with calibrated PR scores
records.description: CodeOtter reviews your pull requests on your own hardware. A small deterministic engine scores every PR on 6 calibrated gauges (Quality, Blast Radius, Risk, Tests, Readability, PR Hygiene) and 9 yes/no merge gates, while an LLM (local GGUF or your own key) writes the review and one-click GitHub suggestions. Works with GitHub, Forgejo and Gitea. No telemetry, no per-seat billing. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

records.name: IDIRA.chat
records.tagline: Your Marketing Analyst Assistant
records.description: CMOs lose hours reconciling Google Analytics 4, Google Ads and Meta Ads data that rarely agrees, and decisions wait on it. IDIRA.chat connects all three, validates the data across platforms, and gives you answers in seconds

records.name: Digitala
records.tagline: Automatic delivery for digital products, no commission
records.description: Digitala delivers your digital products (ebooks, courses, templates, software, license keys) the moment a payment is confirmed. Signed links that expire, download limits, stamped PDFs. Works with Tiendanube, WooCommerce, Jumpseller and Mercado Pago. You keep 100% of the sale.

records.name: Apply Germany
records.tagline: Free ATS resume checker for jobs in Germany
records.description: Applying for jobs in Germany? Make sure your CV is ready. Apply Germany helps job seekers check their resumes for ATS readability, missing keywords, and job-specific relevancefor free. Unlike generic resume tools, we're focused on applications in Germany. Want to go further? Unlock AI-powered CV optimization, tailored cover letters, recruiter insights, and 8 professional resume layouts with a one-time payment. No subscription required.

records.name: Monocurve
records.tagline: Fair launches on Solana, with bundles tagged
records.description: Monocurve is a bonding-curve launchpad on Solana. Bundled launches get a red tag, dev and linked wallets are shown on every coin, creator fees are held in escrow until the coin bonds, and every trade funds buyback and burn. It also has sandwich protection, Radar for trending news, and Copilot built in.

records.name: Yala Zaker
records.tagline: Dev Darking Team
records.description: يلا ذاكر — منصة تعليمية تفاعلية للكتاب كاملًا، بشرح عميق ومراجعة وأسئلة وإحصائيات، من تطوير Dev Mohamed Samir. قيد التطوير
